globaltix_product_data.summary: River Wonders Singapore is a unique river-themed wildlife park located at Mandai Wildlife Reserve, Singapore. This nature attraction showcases freshwater ecosystems inspired by the world’s most iconic rivers, including the Amazon, Nile, and Mekong. Visitors can explore immersive exhibits featuring g...
globaltix_product_data.description: River Wonders Singapore is a unique river-themed wildlife park located at Mandai Wildlife Reserve, Singapore. This nature attraction showcases freshwater ecosystems inspired by the world’s most iconic rivers, including the Amazon, Nile, and Mekong. Visitors can explore immersive exhibits featuring giant pandas, manatees, and diverse aquatic species. It offers an educational and engaging experience for those interested in wildlife and river habitats. The recommended duration is approximately 2–3 hours, depending on your pace and selected activities. The experience is self-paced, allowing guests to explore various zones and exhibits at their convenience. Duration may vary depending on crowd levels, weather conditions, and optional activities such as the Amazon River Quest boat ride. Guests can enter directly using a e-ticket for seamless admission or redeem tickets at the counter if required. Upon entry, visitors can explore themed zones representing major rivers, with highlights including the Giant Panda Forest and Amazon Flooded Forest. Guests may also opt for the Amazon River Quest boat ride (if included or purchased separately). The park is easy to navigate, allowing visitors to move from one exhibit to another while enjoying educational displays and wildlife encounters throughout the visit.
highlights: Explore a river-themed wildlife park featuring ecosystems inspired by the Amazon, Nile, Mekong, and more.
Encounter giant pandas and rare aquatic species in immersive zones like Giant Panda Forest and Amazon Flooded Forest.
Perfect for families, students, and nature lovers seeking an educational and relaxing attraction.
Includes access to all exhibits, with optional Amazon River Quest boat ride for a scenic wildlife adventure.
Ideal for visitors of all ages looking to discover river habitats and diverse wildlife in one destination.

globaltix_product_data.description: Why you should go? Immerse yourself in a historical attraction that served as a work place for some of the greatest artists of the early 20th century. Skip the lines and observe the art works of Rodin at your own pace with a ticket valid for 6 months. Lay your eyes on one of the most famous and iconic sculpture "The Thinker" among all the other precious works of Rodin. View paintings and photographs of Rodin's personal collection. Your Experience The Rodin museum is located near the "Les Invalides" and is a place of renowned importance. It has severed as a work place for artists like Henri Matisse and August Rodin. Currently it house the art works of Claude Monet, Vincent Van Gogh and August Renoir. Your visit will allow you to lay your eyes on the several complete and incomplete works of August Rodin, which has been provided by the Marble Gallery since 1971. You will be allowed to walk through the famed "Garden of Sculptures". Boasting a 7.4 acre, the lush green garden is home to Rodin's precious works like "The Gates of Hell", "the Thinker" and "The Burghers of Calais". Make your way through the garden at your own pace and if you tire yourself out, rest for a while at the cafe as you indulge in the various other art works present there.
highlights: Skip the lines at the Musée Rodin and enter a world of art that challenges the norms of sculpture at Rodin's former home, the Hôtel Biron, its sculpture garden.
Discover Rodin’s masterpieces, including The Thinker, The Kiss, and The Gates of Hell, displayed across galleries and lush gardens.
Admire over 6,000 sculptures and explore the artistic legacy of both Auguste Rodin and his muse and protege, Camille Claudel.
Get access to all of Rodin's personal art collection with works from Van Gogh, Renoir, and more.
Enhance your visit with a physical audio guide in 7 languages, or a scenic 1-hour Seine River cruise.

globaltix_product_data.description: An elegant and glass-lined boat traverses the waters of the Seine. Night has fallen and the twinkling lights show you why Paris is known as . The French waiter serves you fine French cuisine, and a glass of wine is just an arm’s length away. A singer performs standards in the background… Nope, this isn't an over-produced TV commercial; it's perhaps the most elegant way to see Paris.The cruise's beginning is picture-perfect: you hop aboard your vessel under the shadow of the Eiffel Tower. Then you cast off and heads southeast towards Île de la Cité and Notre Dame Cathderal, before looping along the other bank of the river. You’ll spend two and a half unhurried hours taking in Paris's sights from the water: the Louvre, Place de la Concorde, the Museé D’Orsay and many others. As you eat, drink, and be merry.You’ll be struck by just how elegant the boat is. Of course, it doesn’t hurt that they’ll give you a glass of champagne or wine (depending on which option you purchase) when you first come aboard. And then the music begins. A live singer accompanied by a small backing band will provide the soundtrack for your evening. Now you're in the mood!Dinner is a four-course gourmet meal, prepared by onboard chefs in a fully equipped kitchen and served by an attentive and discreet wait staff. Wine, , is served alongside your meal. This isn’t so much a boat, as an elegant, floating restaurant.Whether it’s a romantic dinner for two or a lively group meal, seeing Paris from the water, with its lights twinkling in the distance is . Choose the service and cuisine option that suits you, and get ready for a very memorable evening.a la carte

globaltix_product_data.description: Imagine the excitement at the excavation sites when they first uncovered these Etruscan and pre-Roman treasures! Skip the line to the National Etruscan Museum of Villa Giulia and plug into your audio guide as you wander among artifacts that originated in actual burial tombs. This museum is in Pope Julius III's country retreat, and full of fascinating statues, frescoes, and more.From temple decorations to black bucchero tableware, to bronze figurines, terracotta, and various jewelry, there's enough pre-Roman bling to keep you dazzled for hours at The National Etruscan Museum of Villa Giulia. Located near Villa Borghese, not far from the National Gallery of Modern Art, it's an easy-to-reach slice of Italian history. Peruse the different sections dedicated to the most important facets of Etruscan civilization.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Explore the Pantheon in a unique and engaging way with our audioguide and Fast Track Ticket. globaltix_product_data.description: Explore the Pantheon in a unique and engaging way with our audioguide and Fast Track Ticket. Collect your ticket at the OhMyGuide - Roma Museum Store Via dei Bergamaschi 49, Rome, a short distance from the Pantheon, and enhance your visit. Your journey begins with Adriano, the visionary emperor who commissioned the Temple of all the Gods as we see it today. Through the audioguide, hear Adriano's voice as he relives the Pantheon's history and his love for Rome. Witness the perfect geometry of the dome, with a diameter of 43.44 meters, and discover the significance of the oculus, allowing sunlight to illuminate the interior like a sundial. Follow the guidance of Pope Bonifacio IV, who in 609 AD converted the temple into the Basilica of Mary and all Martyrs, safeguarding it from plunder and ensuring its integrity to this day. Walk through the portico with columns of pink granite from Egypt and meet Raphael Sanzio of Urbino, the painter and architect, buried here with other Renaissance artists who admired classical architecture. Discover why this place was chosen for their eternal rest. Listen to the voice of Queen Margherita, resting at the Pantheon with King Umberto I and Vittorio Emanuele II of Savoy. Imagine the rain of red rose petals during Pentecost, descending from the oculus each year to commemorate the descent of the Holy Spirit upon the Apostles. Look up and observe the Pantheon as both a monument and a church. Mons. Micheletti, archpriest rector of the Pantheon in Rome, will guide you to view the building with different eyes. The audioguides feature voices by talented actors such as Sergio Rubini, Alessandro Haber, Daniele Parisi, Giusi Cataldo, and Mons. Daniele Micheletti. Original compositions by Antonio Fresa, performed with the Orchestra of Teatro La Fenice, create a unique and unforgettable experience. Your visit will provide an extraordinary experience and contribute to supporting the activities of the Chapter of Santa Maria ad Martyres. Book now and immerse yourself in the history of the Pantheon, Temple of all the Gods and Basilica of Mary and all Martyrs

globaltix_product_data.description: Explore the beautiful sights of Rottnest Island in air conditioned comfort on this combined ferry and bus tour package that will allow you to take in the historical, cultural and natural interest points of Rottnest Island all in one great value bundle. Begin the journey by departing from the mainland's Hillary's Boat Harbour at 10am as you're taken via stable and spacious ferry across the waters to Rottnest Island, and upon arrival you'll be able to board a comfortable tour bus and be taken to see all the island's many natural and historical highlights. Rottnest is not just a beautiful place - there's innumerable points of interest including cultural and architectural as well, and a bus tour ensures you make the most of your time on the island and get to see them all! View relics at the Rottnest Museum, visit Lomas Cottage and the Pilot Boat House, see the array of cute and interesting Rottnest Island wildlife; it's all here. This is the ideal Rottnest Island tour package for those short on time, so book your Rottnest ferry and bus tour online today Inclusions * Return ferry transfers from Hillarys Boat Harbour * Bayseeker Tour * Hotel transfers from major Perth CBD Hotels Exclusions * Rottnest Island Admission Fee ($20 adults & seniors, $7 children 4-12yrs), this is payable directly to the tour operator on the day of the tour Highlights * Explore the sights of Rottnest Island in air-conditioned comfort * Take in the historical, cultural and natural interest points of Rottnest Island * View the annual migration of Humpback Whales from September to November * Enjoy the array of wildlife that inhabits Rottnest * The vast natural playground has over 63 beaches and 20 bays * Rottnest Island has a large range of activities to keep the family entertained for hours * Splash and slide on the floating aqua park in Thomson Bay located just a short walking distance from the main settlement is the family fun park * Rottnest boasts an incredibly rich heritage. Take a tour up to Oliver Hill on the Captain Hussey, view relics at the Rottnest Museum, Lomas Cottage and Pilot Boat House Hotel Pickup __If you have booked a hotel__ * Prior to completing your purchase, enter your hotel name in the 'Add Booking Notes' section of the shopping cart. Once your booking is confirmed, you will receive a confirmation tour voucher with complete tour operator details. You will be required to contact the tour operator a minimum of 48hrs prior to your day of travel to reconfirm your hotel pick up time __If you have not yet booked a hotel__ * If you have not yet booked a hotel, enter the words 'hotel not known' in the 'Add Booking Notes' section of the shopping cart. Once your booking is confirmed, you will receive a confirmation tour voucher with complete tour operator details. You will be required to contact the tour operator a minimum of 48hrs prior to your day of travel to reconfirm your hotel pick up time __If you do not require a hotel pick up__ * If you do not require a hotel pick up and will be meeting the tour at the tour departure point, enter the words 'pick up not required' in the 'Add Booking Notes' section of the shopping cart. Once your booking is confirmed, you will receive a confirmation tour voucher with complete tour operator details. You will be required to contact the tour operator a minimum of 48hrs prior to your day of travel to reconfirm your tour and the tour departure point Booking Information * Confirmation in the form of a tour voucher will be received at time of booking * Upon completion of purchase, please print the voucher and present on day of the tour * For your information, complete Tour Operator Information including contact details is included on your tour voucher * Mobile Vouchers are accepted! - Vouchers can also be presented on your mobile device for this activity

globaltix_product_data.summary: Due to coronavirus, the In-Town Check-In service at Hong Kong and Kowloon stations will be suspended with effect from 10 April 2020. The Airport Express Shuttle Buses which runs between Hong Kong Station/Kowloon Station and major hotels as well as railway interchanges will also be suspended. The AEL...
globaltix_product_data.description: Due to coronavirus, the In-Town Check-In service at Hong Kong and Kowloon stations will be suspended with effect from 10 April 2020. The Airport Express Shuttle Buses which runs between Hong Kong Station/Kowloon Station and major hotels as well as railway interchanges will also be suspended. The AEL train service during weekday peak hours will be maintained at an interval of 15 minutes, while the non-peak service will be adjusted to an interval of 30 minutes. In addition, starting from 10 April 2020, weekday non-peak services as well as services on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays on the TCL and TML Phase 1 will be adjusted to an interval of around 10 minutes. Passengers may experience an extra waiting time of about one to two minutes on average. DRL service will be suspended starting from the same day while shuttle buses will be deployed to run between Sunny Bay and Disneyland Resort stations. A Hong Kong Airport Express Ticket is the fastest and most convenient way to get between Hong Kong Airport and the city! There’s no need to exchange tickets, just scan your QR code at the gate and hop on the train. You’ll also find free WiFi in every Hong Kong Airport Express carriage to pass the time, although with only 24 mins between stations, you won’t need it for long! Free In-town Check-in Service Make the journey even smoother with the Hong Kong Airport Express free in-town check-in service available for many major airlines at Hong Kong and Kowloon stations. You can check in and collect your boarding pass between 90 minutes and one full day ahead of your scheduled flight departure time. Simply scan your QR code to enter the check-in area.
highlights: Stay in touch and entertained onboard with WiFi and device charging
Travel between the airport and city in only 24 mins!
Get in-town flight check-in services at Hong Kong Station and Kowloon Station

globaltix_product_data.description: The AREX Incheon Airport Express Train offers a fast and convenient non-stop rail transfer between Incheon International Airport and Seoul Station. This is a shared airport transfer service, ideal for travelers seeking a reliable and time-efficient journey into the city. Enjoy comfortable seating, spacious luggage storage, and a direct connection without intermediate stops. It is one of the most efficient ways to travel between the airport and central Seoul. The journey takes approximately 43–51 minutes, depending on the departure terminal (Terminal 1 or Terminal 2). Travel time may vary slightly due to operational conditions, weather, or rail scheduling. Guests can board the train directly at designated AREX platforms located within Incheon International Airport. Clear signage in English, Korean, and other languages makes navigation easy. No driver interaction is required, as this is a self-service train transfer. Passengers can enjoy a smooth, non-stop ride with comfortable seats and onboard facilities. Upon arrival at Seoul Station, guests can conveniently connect to taxis, subways, or other transport options for their onward journey.

Direct express service with no intermediate stops, saving time compared to regular trains and airport buses
Comfortable seating, spacious luggage storage, and smooth ride for a stress-free airport transfer
Fixed travel time and transparent pricing with no traffic delays or hidden costs
Reliable and frequent departures daily, ideal for both early arrivals and late-night flights

globaltix_product_data.description: Keeping up with the Joneses? Surely, one proud royal family would never seek to out-do another? Whether it was built to rival Versailles or not is a moot point, for The Royal Palace of Caserta is truly vast and monumental. By at least one measurement it’s the largest royal palace ever built. A two-hour train ride from Rome, this palace and gardens combo is the perfect destination for a daytrip.The Royal Palace of Caserta is an absolute marvel - not only the largest royal palace in Europe, a visit here will also give you a delightful sense of déjà vu. Having featured in Star Wars II: Attack of the Clones, Mission Impossible III and other blockbuster movies, it is both cinematic and memorable. With Royal Apartments, lush formal gardens (including a park and English Garden), and a number of opulent water features, there's more than enough here to warrant the journey from Rome.
highlights: Enjoy a royal adventure with a guide at one of the largest palaces ever built in Europe
Witness room after room of stunning Baroque architecture, frescoes, and furniture
Breathe in some nature in the English Garden and witness magnificent sculptures and fountains

globaltix_product_data.description: The Royal Palace of Madrid (Palacio Real) is an architectural and cultural treasure at the heart of the Spanish capital. Built on the site of a 9th-century Moorish fortress and completed in 1764, the palace is the official residence of the Spanish monarchy and one of the largest functioning royal palaces in the world. Its lavishly decorated state rooms, world-class art collection, and majestic setting above the Manzanares River make it one of Madrid's most unmissable attractions.
highlights: The official residence of the Spanish Royal Family and one of the largest royal palaces in Europe
Over 3,400 rooms, with 50 open to the public including the stunning Throne Room and Royal Chapel
Home to one of the world's finest collections of royal art, armour, tapestries, and decorative arts
The Royal Armoury houses one of Europe's most complete collections of medieval and Renaissance armour
Set in the heart of Madrid with sweeping views over the Casa de Campo and the Guadarrama mountains

globaltix_product_data.description: The Royal Palace of Madrid (Palacio Real) is an architectural and cultural treasure at the heart of the Spanish capital. Built on the site of a 9th-century Moorish fortress and completed in 1764, the palace is the official residence of the Spanish monarchy and one of the largest functioning royal palaces in the world. Its lavishly decorated state rooms, world-class art collection, and majestic setting above the Manzanares River make it one of Madrid's most unmissable attractions.
highlights: The official residence of the Spanish Royal Family and one of the largest royal palaces in Europe
Over 3,400 rooms, with 50 open to the public including the stunning Throne Room and Royal Chapel
Home to one of the world's finest collections of royal art, armour, tapestries, and decorative arts
The Royal Armoury houses one of Europe's most complete collections of medieval and Renaissance armour
Set in the heart of Madrid with sweeping views over the Casa de Campo and the Guadarrama mountains

globaltix_product_data.description: Hop aboard the Sagano Sightseeing Train, also known as the "Romantic Train," and enjoy a picturesque journey through the scenic countryside of Kyoto. This old-fashioned, charming train takes you on a leisurely ride along the Hozu River, offering stunning views of lush forests, mountains, and vibrant seasonal landscapes, from cherry blossoms in spring to colorful foliage in autumn. The Sagano Train provides a peaceful escape from the city and a unique way to experience the natural beauty of the Arashiyama region.
highlights: Seasonal views include cherry blossoms, green forests, and autumn leaves.
Experience the nostalgia of traveling on an old-fashioned sightseeing train.
Admire breathtaking views of the Hozu River and surrounding landscapes.
Perfect for photographers, nature lovers, and families.
Enjoy a scenic ride through Kyoto’s beautiful Arashiyama area.

globaltix_product_data.description: Start the tour from our office next to Sagrada Familia. Remember you must check in at least 15 minutes before the starting time of the activity. An experienced guide will pick you up from the office and walk you to the Basilica. Enter the monument and discover the ultimate must-see landmark in Barcelona. Learn about the history and significance of Sagrada Familia by the hand of your local guide. Marvel at the astonishing interior, rich in symbolism inspired on natural wonders. Walk freely around the nave whilst listening to your guide’s explanations of Gaudí’s masterpiece on your headsets. Take in all the details of the perfect fusion between architecture and spirituality. Tour the outside façades and wonder at the magnificence of details. At the end of your tour you can stay inside Sagrada Familia and visit the museum. An exhibition of drawings, models and pictures narrate the story of the Basilica. The museum also displays information on Gaudí’s life and career. Will you miss it out?

Option to ascend the towers for panoramic views over Barcelona
Rich audiovisual museum in the crypt explaining Gaudí's vision, construction history, and ongoing works

globaltix_product_data.summary: The Samurai Ninja Museum Tokyo is one of the Japanese capital's most engaging and entertaining cultural experiences, offering an interactive museum and hands-on activity centre in the heart of Tokyo that brings the extraordinary world of Japan's two most legendary warrior traditions to life for visi...
globaltix_product_data.description: The Samurai Ninja Museum Tokyo is one of the Japanese capital's most engaging and entertaining cultural experiences, offering an interactive museum and hands-on activity centre in the heart of Tokyo that brings the extraordinary world of Japan's two most legendary warrior traditions to life for visitors of all ages. Combining a guided tour through an impressive collection of authentic samurai armour, swords, ninja weapons, and historical artefacts with hands-on activities including sword handling, shuriken throwing, and ninja training, the museum delivers a cultural experience that goes far beyond a conventional museum visit. It creates unforgettable memories and is widely regarded as one of the most fun and uniquely Japanese experiences in Tokyo. The museum's bilingual English and Japanese guided tour is led by passionate and knowledgeable guides who bring the history of the samurai and ninja to life through engaging storytelling suitable for both first-time visitors and history enthusiasts. Guests can handle genuine antique samurai swords under expert supervision, try on authentic samurai armour for memorable photos, throw shuriken at targets with instructor guidance, and learn basic sword techniques during an interactive training session. Conveniently located in central Tokyo and operating daily with multiple session times, the Samurai Ninja Museum is an ideal activity for solo travellers, couples, families, and groups seeking an immersive and memorable introduction to Japan's legendary warrior heritage.
highlights: Handle authentic samurai swords and wear traditional armour for a hands-on journey into Japan's warrior heritage.
Learn basic sword techniques and throw shuriken under expert instructor guidance.

globaltix_product_data.name: Santiago Bernabéu Tour
globaltix_product_data.summary: The Santiago Bernabéu Stadium tour offers an unparalleled behind-the-scenes experience at one of world football's most iconic and historically celebrated venues — the home of Real Madrid Club de Fútbol, the most successful club in the history of European football and the spiritual heartland of the b...
globaltix_product_data.description: The Santiago Bernabéu Stadium tour offers an unparalleled behind-the-scenes experience at one of world football's most iconic and historically celebrated venues — the home of Real Madrid Club de Fútbol, the most successful club in the history of European football and the spiritual heartland of the beautiful game for supporters across the globe. The self-guided tour takes guests through the stadium's most exclusive and coveted areas — the players' tunnel, the pitch-side dugouts, the press conference room, the dressing rooms, and the presidential box — providing an intimate and genuinely thrilling encounter with the spaces where football history has been written across decades of Champions League glory. The tour's trophy exhibition is among the most impressive and emotionally charged in world sport — the accumulated silverware of Europe's most decorated club displayed in a dedicated museum space that traces Real Madrid's history from its founding in 1902 through the galácticos era to the present dynasty of Champions League dominance. The recently completed stadium renovation has transformed the Bernabéu into one of the most architecturally stunning and technologically advanced sporting venues in the world — the tour providing guests with a comprehensive appreciation of this extraordinary structure from its deepest levels to its most elevated perspectives.

Discover Madrid's iconic landmarks, art, and royal heritage
Small group experience for a more personal and immersive visit

globaltix_product_data.summary: Prepare to be amazed at the devotion and superstition that drove miners to carve figures, monuments, and altarpieces into the walls of an 800-year-old salt mine.
globaltix_product_data.description: Prepare to be amazed at the devotion and superstition that drove miners to carve figures, monuments, and altarpieces into the walls of an 800-year-old salt mine.
highlights: Marvel at chapels carved into walls
Visit a surreal underground world with caverns and lakes
Walk down 360 steps and visit a UNESCO World Heritage Site
inclusions: Hotel pick-up (if the hotel pick up option is selected)
Elevator ride to the ground level on exit
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: • Infants must sit on laps • Wieliczka Salt Mine tour is not recommended for participants with walking disabilities (there are 800 steps on the way, including 380 right at the start) and for participants with claustrophobia • The guided walk through Wieliczka Salt Mine consists of 20 monumental chambers joined by 1.5 miles (2.5 kilometres) of pathways. • • Visitors entering the Wieliczka Salt Mine descend a 380-step staircase to Level 1 (64 meters below ground level). This walk is not strenuous and can be undertaken in ordinary footwear, however you are asked to consider the walk and 380-step staircase when booking this tour. The return to the surface will be by lift up the Danilowicz Shaft, from Level 3 (135 meters below ground level) • The temperature in the Wieliczka Salt Mine, though constant is low (14C or 57F). That is why even in summer, warm clothes should be worn

Step into E.S.C., Singapore's most exciting escape room, which offers immersive experiences from ball-filled enclosures to quaking floors. Unique new storylines and fresh, STEM-themed puzzles, which test knowledge, skill and tenacity, will keep you coming back for more. And if you're expecting the regular combination locks and ciphers you might be a little disappointed.

 

Package Includes:

  • 1 x Science Centre Admission
  • 1 x Escape Room E.S.C

  • Adult : 13 years and above
options.termsAndConditions:
Entry into E.S.C.

As the Science Centre will be open from 10am - 5pm only, you can make your way to E.S.C. for your booked session via the main entrance if it is before 5pm. After 5pm, please enter via the Annexe drop-off point.


Complimentary entry via the Science Centre Main Entrance will only be valid for the date booked.


General Admission Rules.

  1. Museum of Humankind and Shangri-la are recommended for ages 13 and above, while Dr.X is recommended for ages 18 years and above. Each room can take 4 to 8 players and will require a minimum of 2 pax to start. You will not be able to purchase tickets quantity lower than the minimum numbers.
  2. Each child age below 12 must have a valid ticket and accompanied by a paying adult (of at least 18 years old).
  3. It is mandatory to complete an indemnity form which will be administered digitally upon your arrival. For children aged 12 and below, the accompanying paying adult(s) of at least 18 years old must complete the form on their behalf.
  4. If you want to play exclusively with less than 8 pax, we recommend that you book out all the slots for the session. Otherwise, other groups may be able to join your group in the session.
  5. For your own safety, please wear covered flat shoes for all our rooms. We do not recommend wearing skirts or heels as there are some physical elements in our rooms.
  6. Please arrive at least 15 mins before the start time of your session. If you are late (within 20 mins of your start time), your session may be cut short. If you are later than 20 mins, your session may be forfeited. No refund will be given in such cases.
  7. Guests are responsible for managing their own door gifts and personal belongings. The venue will not be responsible for handling, storing, or safekeeping these items.
  8. While different packages may indicate varying capacities, all birthday bookings are subject to the same space limitations and safety regulations stated above.
  9. Management reserves the right to refuse entry, terminate the booking, or remove any guest who does not comply with the above Terms & Conditions.
  10. No refunds will be provided in the event of non-compliance or breaches of these terms.

globaltix_product_data.description: SEA LIFE Busan Aquarium opened in November 2001 and has been a landmark at Busan that showcases the mystery of the sea. It is a place where all our guests can enjoy the 'Breed, Rescue, Protect' campaign for the protection of the marine ecosystem to see, hear and feel the marine animals breaking away from the simple the usual aquarium. Everyone at SEA LIFE Busan cares deeply about what they do. We care about our guests and their safety, about the animals in our care and their habitats around the world, about the places in which we operate, and about each other. We aim to be a force for good wherever we operate, going above and beyond what is expected of us as a good corporate citizen.
highlights: Immerse yourself in the wonder of the underwater world at the Busan Sea Life Aquarium!
Dive into the wonders of the ocean at our Haeundae beach aquarium! Explore zones, feedings, and interactives with over 10,000 marine life species.
Enjoy the 'Breed, Rescue, Protect' campaign, focusing on marine ecosystem protection, offering an immersive experience beyond a typical aquarium visit.

globaltix_product_data.description: Home to 400 species of exotic sea life, Bangkok's Sea Life Ocean World is a playground of marine animals just waiting for your visit. Let the largest aquarium in South East Asia entice you to the depths of the ocean with its various aquarium zones. Watch as the giant Pacific octopus, the master of camouflage, blends in seamlessly with its environment. Or visit the underwater tunnels to view the explosion of colors from the clownfish and lionfish. Boarding a glass-bottom boat allows you to embark on an amazing ride and grants you unique views of marine life. A knowledgeable Sea Life staff member will be there to guide you through the whole experience. Looking for a bigger thrill? You can go diving with sand tiger sharks. You may also opt to catch a 4D movie at the in-house cinema or learn about the facility's conservation efforts. Madame Tussauds Bangkok Thailand - The one and only Wax Museum in Bangkok. A visit to Madame Tussauds of Bangkok Thailand is a great treat for the entire family. As you walk through room after room, you will be met with a wide variety of wax likenesses to see, including famous people from Asia and around the globe. You won't believe how life-like the statues appear to be! Get tickets to gain Madame Tussauds Entrance and see your favourite stars in life-size, exact replica figures and also watch Ice Age 4D Movie!

globaltix_product_data.description: A park with two personalities that somehow work together. On one side, orcas, dolphins and belugas in vast pools, a chilled walk-through habitat holding hundreds of penguins, manatees under rehabilitation, sharks overhead in a glass tunnel. On the other, one of the strongest coaster collections in Florida. Mako runs long and fast in the classic hypercoaster style. Manta flies you face down with your arms out, skimming water. Kraken loops without a floor beneath your feet, Ice Breaker launches backwards and forwards, and Pipeline makes you stand up and surf. Between them the park curves around a central lake with shaded paths, quick-service kitchens and sit-down restaurants. Animal presentations run to a timetable throughout the day, and after dark the whole waterfront lights up for shows and fireworks.

globaltix_product_data.summary: A park with two personalities that somehow work together. On one side, orcas, dolphins and belugas in vast pools, a chilled walk-through habitat holding hundreds of penguins, manatees under rehabilitation, sharks overhead in a glass tunnel. On the other, one of the strongest coaster collections in F...
globaltix_product_data.description: A park with two personalities that somehow work together. On one side, orcas, dolphins and belugas in vast pools, a chilled walk-through habitat holding hundreds of penguins, manatees under rehabilitation, sharks overhead in a glass tunnel. On the other, one of the strongest coaster collections in Florida. Mako runs long and fast in the classic hypercoaster style. Manta flies you face down with your arms out, skimming water. Kraken loops without a floor beneath your feet, Ice Breaker launches backwards and forwards, and Pipeline makes you stand up and surf. Between them the park curves around a central lake with shaded paths, quick-service kitchens and sit-down restaurants. Animal presentations run to a timetable throughout the day, and after dark the whole waterfront lights up for shows and fireworks.

globaltix_product_data.description: A park with two personalities that somehow work together. On one side, orcas, dolphins and belugas in vast pools, a chilled walk-through habitat holding hundreds of penguins, manatees under rehabilitation, sharks overhead in a glass tunnel. On the other, one of the strongest coaster collections in Florida. Mako runs long and fast in the classic hypercoaster style. Manta flies you face down with your arms out, skimming water. Kraken loops without a floor beneath your feet, Ice Breaker launches backwards and forwards, and Pipeline makes you stand up and surf. Between them the park curves around a central lake with shaded paths, quick-service kitchens and sit-down restaurants. Animal presentations run to a timetable throughout the day, and after dark the whole waterfront lights up for shows and fireworks.

globaltix_product_data.summary: A park with two personalities that somehow work together. globaltix_product_data.description: A park with two personalities that somehow work together. On one side, orcas, dolphins and belugas in vast pools, a chilled walk-through habitat holding hundreds of penguins, manatees under rehabilitation, sharks overhead in a glass tunnel. On the other, one of the strongest coaster collections in Florida. Mako runs long and fast in the classic hypercoaster style. Manta flies you face down with your arms out, skimming water. Kraken loops without a floor beneath your feet, Ice Breaker launches backwards and forwards, and Pipeline makes you stand up and surf. Between them the park curves around a central lake with shaded paths, quick-service kitchens and sit-down restaurants. Animal presentations run to a timetable throughout the day, and after dark the whole waterfront lights up for shows and fireworks.

globaltix_product_data.summary: The Cathedral of Seville is the largest Gothic cathedral in the world and one of the most architecturally magnificent and historically significant religious buildings in the whole of Spain — a UNESCO World Heritage monument of staggering scale, extraordinary artistic richness, and profound historica...
globaltix_product_data.description: The Cathedral of Seville is the largest Gothic cathedral in the world and one of the most architecturally magnificent and historically significant religious buildings in the whole of Spain — a UNESCO World Heritage monument of staggering scale, extraordinary artistic richness, and profound historical resonance that stands as the supreme achievement of Andalusian Christian civilisation on the site of the city's former great Almohad mosque. The Amigo Tours guided experience provides expert navigational and historical context through the cathedral's most significant and rewarding spaces — transforming what can be an overwhelming encounter with one of the world's largest religious buildings into a carefully curated and deeply engaging cultural journey. The guide leads guests through the cathedral's most celebrated treasures — the monumental tomb of Christopher Columbus carried by four royal pallbearers in sculpted bronze, the extraordinary main altarpiece of gilded carved wood that is the largest in the world, the Giralda tower with its distinctive Moorish minaret base and Renaissance upper section providing panoramic views across Seville from its summit, and the magnificent chapter house and sacristy containing works by Murillo, Zurbarán, and Goya from the cathedral's extraordinary art collection.

Uncover Hidden Symbolism and Legends
Admire the Largest Gothic Cathedral in the World

globaltix_product_data.summary: Visit Seville from a unique position and enjoy privileged views: those that can be seen with our cruise on the Guadalquivir. globaltix_product_data.description: Visit Seville from a unique position and enjoy privileged views: those that can be seen with our cruise on the Guadalquivir. From the deck of one of our modern, spacious and safe boats you can relax while observing the banks of the Guadalquivir, where you can find works such as the Plaza de Toros, the old bridges, the mythical Triana District, the pavilions of the international exhibitions held in Seville, as well as the towers of the Plaza de España and numerous constructions that sought in the past to settle on the banks of the magnificent river, which made Seville a strategic point of vital importance for the New World. This was where merchant ships docked, in the Port of Seville, loaded with gold, silver, tobacco and other valuable and highly sought-after goods. In fact, it was in the Monastery of Santa María de las Cuevas, located on a small island in the Guadalquivir known as the Isla de la Cartuja, that Christopher Columbus planned his journey across the ocean in search of India. Let yourself be carried away by the current passing under its beautiful bridges and delight in the silhouette silhouetted against the sky of a unique and inimitable city. Don't think twice, venture on our cruise on the Guadalquivir.

Enjoy a well-organised itinerary that makes the most of your time
Discover one of Spain's most iconic experiences with an expert local guide

globaltix_product_data.summary: Shanghai Disney Resort is China's first Disney resort and one of the most ambitious theme park developments in the world, located in Pudong, Shanghai. Opened in June 2016, the resort is home to Shanghai Disneyland — a park uniquely designed to celebrate Disney storytelling through an authentically C...
globaltix_product_data.description: Shanghai Disney Resort is China's first Disney resort and one of the most ambitious theme park developments in the world, located in Pudong, Shanghai. Opened in June 2016, the resort is home to Shanghai Disneyland — a park uniquely designed to celebrate Disney storytelling through an authentically Chinese lens while delivering the world-class entertainment, technology, and imagination that define the Disney experience globally. The resort also encompasses Disney Town, Wishing Star Park, two themed hotels, and a wide array of dining, shopping, and entertainment options, making it a complete multi-day destination. Shanghai Disneyland is divided into seven themed lands — Mickey Avenue, Gardens of Imagination, Fantasyland, Adventure Isle, Treasure Cove, Tomorrowland, and the newest addition, Zootopia. Each land offers a richly immersive environment with signature attractions, live entertainment, and themed dining. Fantasyland is home to the world's largest Disney castle — Enchanted Storybook Castle — which serves as the iconic centrepiece of the park and hosts multiple experiences within its grand interiors. Adventure Isle delivers high-energy thrills through ROAR! Rapids and the soaring Tarzan's Treehouse, while Treasure Cove brings Pirates of the Caribbean to life with one of the most technologically advanced Disney attractions ever built. Zootopia, the newest land, features the innovative Zootopia: Hot Pursuit ride set entirely within Zhuanopia Police Department's immersive world. A single day covers the highlights of the park, though two days are recommended to fully appreciate every land, show, and entertainment offering at a relaxed pace.
highlights: China's first Disney resort featuring 7 themed lands, including the newest Zootopia land, offering world-class rides, shows, and Disney magic.
Marvel at Enchanted Storybook Castle — the largest Disney castle in the world — standing as the breathtaking centrepiece of Shanghai Disneyland.
Experience Pirates of the Caribbean: Battle for the Sunken Treasure, widely regarded as one of the most advanced Disney ride experiences ever built.
Explore the brand-new Zootopia land with immersive theming and the innovative Zootopia: Hot Pursuit ride, exclusive to Shanghai Disneyland.
Beyond the park, Disney Town and Wishing Star Park offer shopping, dining, live entertainment, and scenic lakeside leisure at no extra charge.

Park operations, restaurant operating hours, and availability are subject to change due to capacity limitations, weather conditions, special events, safety, security, operational requirements, or other circumstances. Each coupon contains a unique QR code and may only be used once. Guests must present the QR code at participating Quick Service Restaurants when redeeming the coupon. globaltix_product_data.summary: Shanghai Disney Resort is China's first Disney resort and one of the most ambitious theme park developments in the world, located in Pudong, Shanghai. Opened in June 2016, the resort is home to Shanghai Disneyland — a park uniquely designed to celebrate Disney storytelling through an authentically C...
globaltix_product_data.description: Shanghai Disney Resort is China's first Disney resort and one of the most ambitious theme park developments in the world, located in Pudong, Shanghai. Opened in June 2016, the resort is home to Shanghai Disneyland — a park uniquely designed to celebrate Disney storytelling through an authentically Chinese lens while delivering the world-class entertainment, technology, and imagination that define the Disney experience globally. The resort also encompasses Disney Town, Wishing Star Park, two themed hotels, and a wide array of dining, shopping, and entertainment options, making it a complete multi-day destination. Shanghai Disneyland is divided into seven themed lands — Mickey Avenue, Gardens of Imagination, Fantasyland, Adventure Isle, Treasure Cove, Tomorrowland, and the newest addition, Zootopia. Each land offers a richly immersive environment with signature attractions, live entertainment, and themed dining. Fantasyland is home to the world's largest Disney castle — Enchanted Storybook Castle — which serves as the iconic centrepiece of the park and hosts multiple experiences within its grand interiors. Adventure Isle delivers high-energy thrills through ROAR! Rapids and the soaring Tarzan's Treehouse, while Treasure Cove brings Pirates of the Caribbean to life with one of the most technologically advanced Disney attractions ever built. options.termsAndConditions: Each mobile number/ID card can be used to purchase Shanghai Ocean Aquarium admission tickets only once per day, with a maximum of 2 tickets per booking. Passholders may bring family and friends to visit and enjoy a CNY 10 discount on Adult and Child admission tickets, for up to 3 accompanying visitors per day. The Annual Pass becomes valid immediately upon successful activation. The pass is strictly for personal use and serves as the required identification for admission. Please present your pass upon entry. If the passholder's appearance does not match the photo on the pass during admission, the visitor must present a valid ID card or passport for verification before entry. Please keep your Annual Pass safe. A CNY 30 replacement fee will apply for lost passes. The pass is non-transferable and cannot be lent to another person. Shanghai Ocean Aquarium reserves the right to request proof of identity when the pass is used. If the pass becomes damaged, worn, or unreadable (including blurred information, photo, or expiry date), a CNY 30 replacement fee will apply before a new pass can be issued. Passholders may enjoy unlimited admission to Shanghai Ocean Aquarium throughout the validity period, except during special events, private functions, or force majeure situations. Once the pass application is confirmed, it cannot be amended, cancelled, or refunded.

globaltix_product_data.description: Located opposite the Bund, Lujiazui is the heart of China's budding financial sector and the only specifically designated financial development zone on the mainland. Landmark attractions include the Oriental Pearl TV Tower, Shanghai World Financial Center, Jin Mao Tower, and the Shanghai Tower. As night falls, the skyscrapers come alive with lights. The nightscape is breathtaking, showing off the modern metropolis that is Shanghai. Parents can take their kids to the Shanghai Ocean Aquarium to explore the magical wonders beneath the sea. Lujiazui is also home to great shopping and dining. It is a modern neighborhood in a very modern city.
highlights: Houses the world’s fastest elevators (20.5 m/s).
Tallest building in China at 632 m, world’s third tallest.
Distinctive twisting design reduces wind loads by 24%.
Green skyscraper with rainwater recycling & wind turbines.
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Visitors with children are requested to take good care of them and not to play, run or fight in the museum. When taking the elevator, please stand firmly and hold on to the elevator door. Do not lean on the elevator door to avoid being pinched when the door opens. If there are many tourists on site, please follow the staff's instructions and queue up in an orderly manner to go up and down the stairs. Visitors with heart disease, high (low) blood pressure, asthma, high eye (brain) pressure, or other medical conditions, as well as those who are pregnant, may experience discomfort when riding high-speed elevators. globaltix_product_data.summary: Have you ever wanted to see sharks up close? You can now have a close encounter with endangered Grey Nurse Sharks on a shark dive at SEA LIFE Sydney Aquarium and no experience is necessary! In a safe environment, you will receive scuba training before your dive into the 1.5 million litre oceanarium....
globaltix_product_data.description: Have you ever wanted to see sharks up close? You can now have a close encounter with endangered Grey Nurse Sharks on a shark dive at SEA LIFE Sydney Aquarium and no experience is necessary! In a safe environment, you will receive scuba training before your dive into the 1.5 million litre oceanarium. After the pool session, your guide will give you a 30 minute tour of the shark tunnels to see these fascinating creatures in their environment. The Grey Nurse Sharks range from 1-3 metres and are free to swim around you in the oceanarium. There are no cages to separate you- you will be in their domain under the watchful guidance of your scuba dive guide. You will encounter 4 species of sharks, including a colony of Grey Nurse Sharks as well as a number of giant stingrays, fish and more. The experience lasts 2.5 hours including the scuba diving safety briefing and time in the water with the marine creatures. All dive gear and wetsuits are provided but you are welcome to bring your own mask and wetsuit if you prefer. All divers must be able to speak English and have a reasonable level of fitness and swimming ability. You must also pass the scuba diving medical check. The minimum age to participate is 14 years old and 3 sessions are held on Friday, Saturday and Sunday at 8am, 11am and 2pm. Don’t miss out on this popular experience. Book your SEA LIFE Sydney Aquarium Shark Dive today!

globaltix_product_data.description: Siam Niramit Phuket is a world-class live cultural show located in Phuket, showcasing Thailand’s rich history, traditions, and mythology. Featuring over 100 performers, elaborate costumes, and advanced stage effects, the performance brings Thai heritage to life in a spectacular way. Guests can also explore a traditional Thai village and enjoy authentic cuisine, making it a complete cultural evening experience. The experience typically lasts 2–3 hours, including time to explore the cultural village and enjoy optional dinner before the show. The main performance runs on a fixed schedule, while pre-show activities are self-paced. Duration may vary depending on crowd levels and seasonal operations. Guests can present their voucher at the ticket counter for entry or scan a e-ticket for direct access, depending on ticket type. Before the show, visitors can stroll through the cultural village, enjoy traditional performances, and participate in interactive activities. If dinner is included, guests can dine at the buffet restaurant featuring Thai and international dishes. The highlight is the grand stage performance, divided into acts that depict Thailand’s historical eras, spiritual beliefs, and festivals. After the show, guests exit through the main lobby area.

globaltix_product_data.name: Chengdu Du Fu Thatched Cottage Museum
globaltix_product_data.summary: Du Fu Thatched Cottage is the former Chengdu residence of the famous Tang Dynasty poet Du Fu. Du Fu lived here for nearly four years. During his stay, he created hundreds of poems. This place is thus regarded as the “holy land” of Chinese literature. Today's Du Fu Thatched Cottage has survived multi...
globaltix_product_data.description: Du Fu Thatched Cottage is the former Chengdu residence of the famous Tang Dynasty poet Du Fu. Du Fu lived here for nearly four years. During his stay, he created hundreds of poems. This place is thus regarded as the “holy land” of Chinese literature. Today's Du Fu Thatched Cottage has survived multiple dynasties and been restored many times. The most important architecture of the place is his former residence, the thatched house. This former residence was built with the architectural characteristics of the western Sichuan civilian residences.
highlights: Former residence of Tang Dynasty poet Du Fu, where he composed over 240 poems.
Reconstructed thatched cottages and halls reflecting Tang-era style and cultural heritage.
Classical Chinese gardens with pavilions, bridges, and bamboo groves create a tranquil atmosphere.
Displays of calligraphy, poetry, and cultural relics, plus events celebrating Chinese poetry and art.
A museum dedicated to Du Fu’s life, works, and influence on Chinese literature.
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Note: Pets are not allowed into the attraction[Kind tips]Chengdu Du Fu Thatched Cottage Museum implements a real-name identification(supports second-generation ID cards). You must bring your original ID card to enter the museum. Other documents are available at the on-site ticket window. Visitors who purchase tickets must fill in their personal identity information truthfully. If the information is inconsistent, they will not be allowed to enter the museum. If your ticket cannot be checked on the day of your visit due to loss or damage of your ID or other reasons, please apply for a refund on your own.
globaltix_product_data.address: No.37, Qinghua Road, Qingyang District, Chengdu City

globaltix_product_data.description: Skip the line to one of Italy's most important Roman-Gothic style buildings - the magical Cathedral of Siena. Marvel at the frescoes by Donatello, Michelangelo, and Pinturicchio. See the Crypt and the Piccolomini Library, and don't forget to check out the floor. It's made of 56 panels of inlaid marble mosaics and is one sight you won't forget.Housing some of the most important European artistic monuments, the Roman-Gothic style Cathedral of Siena makes for a meaningful morning. Over a million visitors every year step through these stunning doors - it's just as spectacular as Florence's Duomo.Skip the line and get up close to amazing frescoes by the likes of Donatello, Michelangelo, and Pinturicchio. They're all here in what is one of the most important examples of this style of building in Italy, constructed between 1214 and 1263. See the Crypt, the Baptistery and the Museo dell'Opera, all of which form the (Old Cathedral), and the (New Cathedral) and check out the Piccolomini Library, dedicated to Pope Pius II.Oh, and don't forget to look down. The floor is an art piece in itself, with 56 scenes engraved in marble, which were carved between 1369 and 1547 by 40 different artists. You'll step lightly, but the complexity is staggering!

Mount Faber Line Soar high above the two destinations through the sky on the most scenic highway in Sing...
globaltix_product_data.description: Cable Car Experience Faber Peak Singapore and Sentosa on the Cable Car Sky Network! Enjoy not one but TWO cable car lines that connect TWO buzzing destinations – Sentosa and Faber Peak Singapore. Mount Faber Line Soar high above the two destinations through the sky on the most scenic highway in Singapore for priceless views. Fly high above the hill from Faber Peak Singapore, through a skyscraper and cross the harbour on the Mount Faber Line before landing in Sentosa Island. Sentosa Line Journey over the jungle, sand and sea on the Sentosa Line which will take you to dozens of attractions on Sentosa. Choose your stop at the Merlion station, Imbiah Lookout station and Siloso Point station to enjoy the sandy beaches, Madame Tussauds, Mega Adventure Park, Skyline Luge Sentosa, Universal Studios Singapore, S.E.A. Aquarium and more! Good Old Days There is nothing quite as familiar and comforting as the taste of wok-hei in Beef Hor Fun, the fragrance of Nasi Briyani and the appetising sight of you tiao tossed in thick Rojak sauce. Located conveniently at Sentosa's Beach Station, this family-friendly Halal restaurant serves up a wide variety of tantalizing local favourites such as laksa, chicken rice and many more! So come and experience the Good Old Days of Singapore with our delicious local cuisine! Arbora An architectural delight, the shethered alfresco dingin area features elegant hiba wood arcs and adorned with a unique centrepiece. For Set Lunch, there is a choice of main choice and reservation is required for 15 pax and above. "Important Note" Menu Arbora Lunch Soup : Soup of the Day Main Course (Selection of 1 main) - Singapore Signature Laksa - Oven-Roasted Mustard Chicken Massaged with Mustard & Roasted till Golden Brown Served wih Homemade Gravy & Mashed Spuds - Breaded Fish Fillet with Air flown assorted Garden Green Salad with Potatoes & Tartar Sauce. - Gateaux of Fricassee Mushroom with Vegetable on Spaghetti (Vegetarian) Beverage : - Coffee - Tea - Iced Green Tea Menu Good Old Days Dinner Appetizer: Choice of Soup of the Day / Salad Main Course (choose 1) : - Fried Rice with Breaded Fish - Fried Rice with Baked Chicken - Singapore Laksa - Chicken Briyani - Vegetarian Fried Rice Dessert : - Cut Fruits Beverage: - Choice of Soft Drink / Coffee / Tea
highlights: See-through glass floors: Gaze down at stunning landscapes beneath your feet.
Enhanced ventilation: Get a more comfortable, breezy journey with an improved design of the window louvres.
Be mesmerised by the illuminating glow cast by the lighted rings around the cabin windows.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Located at Resorts World Sentosa, Singapore Oceanarium is a leading ocean institute with the purpose to inspire greater knowledge, love, and action for the ocean and aquatic life. We are dedicated to advancing marine education, research, and supporting the conservation and preservation of threatened...
globaltix_product_data.description: Located at Resorts World Sentosa, Singapore Oceanarium is a leading ocean institute with the purpose to inspire greater knowledge, love, and action for the ocean and aquatic life. We are dedicated to advancing marine education, research, and supporting the conservation and preservation of threatened species. With a unique blend of live habitats, oceanic stories and interactive technology, Singapore Oceanarium connects knowledge from meaningful marine education and encounters to real-world applications. Our long-term partnerships with institutes, accreditation by the Association of Zoos & Aquariums (AZA), and membership of World Association of Zoos and Aquariums (WAZA) and Southeast Asian Zoo and Aquarium Association (SEAZA) is a testament to our commitment to inspire generations of ocean stewards for greater action. Singapore Oceanarium also encompasses a Research and Learning Centre – a dedicated space that offers advanced purpose-built spaces for research, conservation and community outreach. Certified by Singapore’s Building and Construction Authority as a Green Mark Platinum Zero Energy building, the centre is designed with environmental sustainability at its core and its energy needs are powered entirely by solar energy.
highlights: One of the world’s largest kreisel tanks, home to over 5,000 moon jellyfish, offering a mesmerizing, ethereal display
A recreated mangrove habitat featuring interactive, touch‑friendly displays showcasing native biodiversity
Features life‑sized animatronics and fossils of prehistoric marine creatures, tracing evolution from primeval seas to land
A deep‑sea display portraying how whale carcasses nurture entire ecosystems, using immersive visuals and real habitats
A breathtaking 36‑metre‑wide viewing panel where reef manta rays and zebra sharks glide before your eyes

globaltix_product_data.summary: Located at Resorts World Sentosa, Singapore Oceanarium is a leading ocean institute dedicated to inspiring greater knowledge, love, and action for the ocean and aquatic life. Through a unique blend of live habitats, oceanic stories, state-of-the-art digital innovation, and interactive technology, th...
globaltix_product_data.description: Located at Resorts World Sentosa, Singapore Oceanarium is a leading ocean institute dedicated to inspiring greater knowledge, love, and action for the ocean and aquatic life. Through a unique blend of live habitats, oceanic stories, state-of-the-art digital innovation, and interactive technology, the attraction connects meaningful marine education with real-world applications. Singapore Oceanarium is accredited by the Association of Zoos & Aquariums (AZA) and is a member of the World Association of Zoos and Aquariums (WAZA) and Southeast Asian Zoo and Aquarium Association (SEAZA) — a testament to its commitment to inspiring generations of ocean stewards. Beyond its exhibits, Singapore Oceanarium is home to a Research and Learning Centre featuring advanced, purpose-built spaces for research, conservation, and community outreach. Certified by Singapore's Building and Construction Authority as a Green Mark Platinum Zero Energy building, the centre runs entirely on solar energy, with environmental sustainability at its core. The attraction is also dedicated to advancing marine education and supporting the conservation and preservation of threatened species through long-term partnerships with institutes worldwide. This summer, experience the ocean like never before with the exclusive Cry Me an Ocean activation by POP MART — the largest activation to date at Singapore Oceanarium. Running from 24 June to 30 August 2026, guests can explore seven newly created marine-themed CRYBABY characters brought to life through larger-than-life inflatables, sculptures, and photo zones across Singapore Oceanarium, WEAVE, and an ocean-themed POP-Up store by POP MART. Specially designed installations placed alongside real marine habitats offer a fun and immersive way to connect with the wonders of the ocean
highlights: One of the world’s largest kreisel tanks, home to over 5,000 moon jellyfish, offering a mesmerizing, ethereal display
A recreated mangrove habitat featuring interactive, touch‑friendly displays showcasing native biodiversity
Features life‑sized animatronics and fossils of prehistoric marine creatures, tracing evolution from primeval seas to land
A deep‑sea display portraying how whale carcasses nurture entire ecosystems, using immersive visuals and real habitats
A breathtaking 36‑metre‑wide viewing panel where reef manta rays and zebra sharks glide before your eyes

globaltix_product_data.description: Located at Resorts World Sentosa, Singapore Oceanarium is a leading ocean institute dedicated to inspiring greater knowledge, love, and action for the ocean and aquatic life. Through a unique blend of live habitats, oceanic stories, state-of-the-art digital innovation, and interactive technology, the attraction connects meaningful marine education with real-world applications. Singapore Oceanarium is accredited by the Association of Zoos & Aquariums (AZA) and is a member of the World Association of Zoos and Aquariums (WAZA) and Southeast Asian Zoo and Aquarium Association (SEAZA) — a testament to its commitment to inspiring generations of ocean stewards. Beyond its exhibits, Singapore Oceanarium is home to a Research and Learning Centre featuring advanced, purpose-built spaces for research, conservation, and community outreach. Certified by Singapore's Building and Construction Authority as a Green Mark Platinum Zero Energy building, the centre runs entirely on solar energy, with environmental sustainability at its core. The attraction is also dedicated to advancing marine education and supporting the conservation and preservation of threatened species through long-term partnerships with institutes worldwide. This summer, experience the ocean like never before with the exclusive Cry Me an Ocean activation by POP MART — the largest activation to date at Singapore Oceanarium. Running from 24 June to 30 August 2026, guests can explore seven newly created marine-themed CRYBABY characters brought to life through larger-than-life inflatables, sculptures, and photo zones across Singapore Oceanarium, WEAVE, and an ocean-themed POP-Up store by POP MART. Specially designed installations placed alongside real marine habitats offer a fun and immersive way to connect with the wonders of the ocean
highlights: One of the world’s largest kreisel tanks, home to over 5,000 moon jellyfish, offering a mesmerizing, ethereal display
A recreated mangrove habitat featuring interactive, touch‑friendly displays showcasing native biodiversity
Features life‑sized animatronics and fossils of prehistoric marine creatures, tracing evolution from primeval seas to land
A deep‑sea display portraying how whale carcasses nurture entire ecosystems, using immersive visuals and real habitats
A breathtaking 36‑metre‑wide viewing panel where reef manta rays and zebra sharks glide before your eyes

globaltix_product_data.summary: Located at Resorts World Sentosa, Singapore Oceanarium is a leading ocean institute dedicated to inspiring greater knowledge, love, and action for the ocean and aquatic life. Through a unique blend of live habitats, oceanic stories, state-of-the-art digital innovation, and interactive technology, th...
globaltix_product_data.description: Located at Resorts World Sentosa, Singapore Oceanarium is a leading ocean institute dedicated to inspiring greater knowledge, love, and action for the ocean and aquatic life. Through a unique blend of live habitats, oceanic stories, state-of-the-art digital innovation, and interactive technology, the attraction connects meaningful marine education with real-world applications. Singapore Oceanarium is accredited by the Association of Zoos & Aquariums (AZA) and is a member of the World Association of Zoos and Aquariums (WAZA) and Southeast Asian Zoo and Aquarium Association (SEAZA) — a testament to its commitment to inspiring generations of ocean stewards. Beyond its exhibits, Singapore Oceanarium is home to a Research and Learning Centre featuring advanced, purpose-built spaces for research, conservation, and community outreach. Certified by Singapore's Building and Construction Authority as a Green Mark Platinum Zero Energy building, the centre runs entirely on solar energy, with environmental sustainability at its core. The attraction is also dedicated to advancing marine education and supporting the conservation and preservation of threatened species through long-term partnerships with institutes worldwide. This summer, experience the ocean like never before with the exclusive Cry Me an Ocean activation by POP MART — the largest activation to date at Singapore Oceanarium. Running from 24 June to 30 August 2026, guests can explore seven newly created marine-themed CRYBABY characters brought to life through larger-than-life inflatables, sculptures, and photo zones across Singapore Oceanarium, WEAVE, and an ocean-themed POP-Up store by POP MART. Specially designed installations placed alongside real marine habitats offer a fun and immersive way to connect with the wonders of the ocean
highlights: One of the world’s largest kreisel tanks, home to over 5,000 moon jellyfish, offering a mesmerizing, ethereal display
A recreated mangrove habitat featuring interactive, touch‑friendly displays showcasing native biodiversity
Features life‑sized animatronics and fossils of prehistoric marine creatures, tracing evolution from primeval seas to land
A deep‑sea display portraying how whale carcasses nurture entire ecosystems, using immersive visuals and real habitats
A breathtaking 36‑metre‑wide viewing panel where reef manta rays and zebra sharks glide before your eyes

globaltix_product_data.description: - Please be advised that the inventory for each session is limited. To secure your preferred date and time, we strongly recommend making a reservation as early as possible. - Please ensure that sufficient slots remain for your preferred session to avoid companions being unable to book the same time. The Original DUCKtours at Suntec City is a Tourism Award-winning attraction. First in Singapore, an impressive 18 year perfect safety record, and 1 million passengers – nothing comes close to the Original DUCKtours @ Suntec City. This hour-long adventure start with a city tour of the historical Civic District, before splashing into the water and swimming off like a duck for a picturesque harbour tour. Climb aboard a refurbished Vietnam War amphibious vehicle for a unique tour of Singapore! Start your land and sea adventure with a big splash into the Marina Bay, where you can admire views of the bustling urban city's skyline and marvel at Singapore's most iconic landmarks—the Marina Bay Sands, Gardens by the Bay, the Esplanade Theatre and the towering Merlion. Your journey continues as you waddle back onto land and drive past the Singapore Flyer and into the Civic District. There you will see the steps of the Old Supreme Court where the British surrendered to the Imperial Japanese army during WWII, and the War Memorial Park, a tribute to those who gave their lives during WWII's Japanese occupation. End the tour with a loop around the world’s largest water fountain at Suntec City, named the Fountain of Wealth, for good luck.
highlights: Explore Singapore on a 1hr DUCKtours and you get to see city sights by both land and water.
Cruise along Marina Bay, and get up close to iconic landmarks of Singapore
Get up close to Singapore's famous skyline, historical landmarks, and gorgeous bay view

globaltix_product_data.description: Begin the ultimate travel experience around Lion City with this unique Singapore Cable Car promotion. Take to the skies and enjoy unparalleled views of Singapore's top attractions from Mount Faber Park to Sentosa Island. Start or end your journey at Mount Faber, located near Bukit Merah and one of Singapore's oldest hilltop parks. Ride on a cable car in Singapore with your Sky Pass and access all six stations across the Sentosa Line and the Mount Faber Line. Get the Sky Pass with Meal deal and enjoy a daily set lunch at Arbora Hilltop Garden & Bistro, a unique restaurant offering the perfect dining experience and majestic views of Sentosa, or dinner at Good Old Days Restaurant, a family-friendly halal restaurant offering wok-made stir-fried vegetables and aromatic dishes.
highlights: Location: The only cableway that links Mount Faber, HarbourFront, and Sentosa Island.
Experience: Fly on board the Singapore Cable Car and enjoy the amazing aerial views that unfold all around you from 100 meters above sea level.
Duration: Each ride lasts around 30 minutes.
New Cable Cars: New spherical cable cars with transparent bottoms will be unveiled in Feb 2024 but will run in 2nd quarter of the year.

globaltix_product_data.name: Singapore Zoo
globaltix_product_data.summary: Singapore Zoo is a world-renowned wildlife park located in Singapore, featuring an open-concept design that immerses visitors in naturalistic animal habitats. This outdoor attraction showcases over 2,800 animals across diverse zones, from rainforest environments to savannah landscapes. Guests can en...
globaltix_product_data.description: Singapore Zoo is a world-renowned wildlife park located in Singapore, featuring an open-concept design that immerses visitors in naturalistic animal habitats. This outdoor attraction showcases over 2,800 animals across diverse zones, from rainforest environments to savannah landscapes. Guests can enjoy close-up encounters, interactive feeding sessions, and educational presentations. It is a must-visit destination for families and nature lovers seeking an engaging and eco-friendly wildlife experience. The recommended duration is approximately 3–5 hours or a half-day to full-day visit, depending on your pace and activities. The experience is self-paced, allowing guests to explore various zones and attend scheduled shows at their convenience. Duration may vary based on crowd levels, weather conditions, and show timings. Guests can enter directly using a e-ticket for seamless admission or redeem tickets at the counter if required. Upon entry, visitors can explore themed zones featuring animals in spacious, barrier-free habitats. Highlights include animal feeding sessions, keeper talks, and live presentations. Guests may also opt for a tram ride (if included or purchased separately) for a guided overview of the park. Visitors can move freely between zones, enjoy dining options, and spend time observing wildlife at their own pace throughout the visit.
highlights: Explore a world-class open-concept zoo with animals roaming in naturalistic habitats across themed zones.
Renowned for immersive exhibits and close-up wildlife encounters, including feeding sessions and animal presentations.
Perfect for families, nature lovers, and educational trips seeking a fun and enriching outdoor experience.
Includes access to all zoo zones, walking trails, and scheduled animal shows (tram ride may be optional add-on).
Ideal for visitors of all ages, from kids to adults, looking to connect with wildlife in a lush rainforest setting.

A senior is defined as a person at 60 years of age and above for the purpose of determining whether an admission ticket to a Mandai Wildlife Group (MWG) Park is required. By bus from Sintra (historic center) to the National Palace of Pena: Take the Scotturb bus No. 434, which runs from the railway station to the Palace of Pena. Parking lots at Pena Park Entrance are limited and have an extra cost. There are no parking lots up to the palace.

globaltix_product_data.description: Create unforgettable memories at the Sriracha Tiger Zoo in Pattaya! Gather your travel essentials and bring your crew to explore Asia's largest tiger zoo, home to over 300 majestic Panthera tigris and nearly 100,000 crocodiles. Discover a unique world where animals coexist harmoniously—watch pigs playing with tiger cubs, crocodiles showcasing their talents, and baby goats happily scampering around. Encounter exotic creatures like kangaroos, camels, ostriches, and more as they roam freely in this incredible sanctuary. Get up close and personal with these animals—feed them, hold them, and learn about their lives and proper care. For a fun-filled, educational, and heartwarming family adventure, the Sriracha Tiger Zoo is your ultimate destination!
highlights: Make a visit to the incredible Sriracha Tiger Zoo, the biggest tiger zoo in Asia located in Pattaya
Meet, greet, and feed adorable tiger cubs, farm animals, ostriches, kangaroos, and more
Visit a zoo that promotes the protection of the environment and various endangered animals
See over 300 Panthera Tigris and nearly 100,000 species of crocodiles on site

Skip the lines to the Sisi Museum and Imperial Apartments at Hofburg
Explore the Hofburg Palace Complex, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, with a Guide

globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Arrive 10 minutes early, as latecomers won't be able to join the group or get a refund. Tours are in 1 language only, as selected when booking. Headsets will be provided if the group reaches 18+, with a max of 25 participants. This activity is not suitable for individuals with disabilities. No luggage storage for bags, extra clothing etc. Pets are not allowed. Hofburg tickets (Sisi Museum & Imperial Apartments) include timed entry to skip the ticket line. The corridors in the Sisi Museum are narrow, crowded and loud, so you will need to stay close to the guide. 2025: Sisi Museum is under renovation, so access to certain rooms and exhibitions is restricted. Free entry to courtyards, Heldenplatz & Burggarten. The gardens are not green or lit in winter—book a morning tour or visit in spring, summer or autumn. For guest safety, if the weather is bad (e.g. snowy day), we will offer an alternative route. From 08.11 to 31.12, you will have a chance to visit a local Christmas Market instead.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Waiting in line to visit a clock is a paradox of wasted time folding in upon itself. globaltix_product_data.description: Waiting in line to visit a clock is a paradox of wasted time folding in upon itself. Of course, when that clock is a 600-year-old marvel of medieval engineering it's worth it. However, this skip-the-line ticket gets you right to the front of the line, so you can visit the Gothic clock tower, and see the insides of the world's oldest operational astronomical clock.Time flies when you're having fun, so make sure you get into the fast lane to see Prague's world-famous Astronomical Clock. Meet your guide in the quaint Old Town Square to pick up your tickets. Rain or shine, the guide will be holding an open blue and white umbrella. And then visit the clock. Every hour a small trapdoor opens and Christ himself marches out, followed by his disciples. The Grim Reaper also rings a bell - checking to see whose time has come (unsurprisingly, everyone shakes their heads 'no'). There are also planetary motion, the zodiac and more on the clock - and 75% of its parts are original - like original.With your tickets, you'll get to skip the lines and take the stairs or an elevator up the tower. From there you'll have amazing views over the Old Town Square and the rest of Prague's Old Town.On your way back down to Prague, you can think on the staying power of this clock. It's an appropriate occasion to call to mind the words of English essayist Henry Austin Dobson: we .That ought to encourage you to make the most of your time in Prague.
highlights: Get a short introduction in English to the history, significance, and meaning of this remarkable piece of medieval engineering
See the famous 600-year-old astronomical clock on your own and skip the long lines to get into its tower
Get spectacular views of the City of a Thousand Spires from the top
inclusions: Skip-the-line access to the clock tower
Short intro in English on the history of the venue

globaltix_product_data.description: Discover two of the greatest masterpieces by Antoni Gaudí on this complete guided tour of Barcelona. The experience begins at the iconic Park Güell, located in a privileged area of the city and recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. From this unique location, you will enjoy spectacular panoramic views of Barcelona while learning how Gaudí’s original vision evolved into one of the most extraordinary parks in the world. Explore the monumental area with your expert guide and admire the architect’s organic style, where nature and design blend seamlessly. After the visit to the park, the tour continues to Barcelona’s most famous landmark: the Sagrada Familia. Step inside this impressive basilica and discover the history and symbolism that make it one of the most visited monuments in Spain. With your local guide, you will learn about its construction and the natural inspiration behind its extraordinary design. Admire the light filtering through its stained glass windows, walk through the central nave while listening to detailed explanations via your radio guide, and experience the unique fusion of architecture, spirituality, and art that defines Gaudí’s masterpiece. At the end of the tour, you will also explore the exterior of the temple and understand why this architectural jewel is part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site.
