globaltix_product_data.summary: The Guided Tour to Sagrada Família and Park Güell combines Barcelona's two most celebrated and architecturally extraordinary creations of Antoni Gaudí in a single expertly managed day that delivers the full scope of the visionary Catalan architect's unique and unprecedented contribution to world arc...
globaltix_product_data.description: The Guided Tour to Sagrada Família and Park Güell combines Barcelona's two most celebrated and architecturally extraordinary creations of Antoni Gaudí in a single expertly managed day that delivers the full scope of the visionary Catalan architect's unique and unprecedented contribution to world architecture. Both sites are UNESCO World Heritage properties — the Sagrada Família basilica representing Gaudí's spiritual and architectural masterpiece in its most ambitious and monumental form, and Park Güell the most playful, colourful, and nature-inspired expression of his decorative genius in a garden and public space of extraordinary originality. The expert Amigo Tours guide provides the biographical and architectural context that makes both sites fully comprehensible and deeply rewarding — covering Gaudí's creative philosophy, his synthesis of natural forms and Gothic structural principles, his deeply personal Catholic faith, and the specific design decisions at both sites that reflect the full depth of his architectural vision. All tickets are pre-secured by Amigo Tours for both attractions — eliminating the significant challenge of independent procurement for two of Barcelona's most popular and strictly capacity-controlled sites and ensuring a seamlessly structured and genuinely enriching full Gaudí day in the Catalan capital.

Enjoy panoramic views of Barcelona from Park Güell
Learn from an expert guide specialized in Modernist art and architecture

globaltix_product_data.summary: Faunia is a nature and wildlife park located in Madrid, Spain, designed around immersive ecosystems and themed habitats. The attraction combines a zoo, botanical environment, educational exhibits, and interactive animal experiences across spacious outdoor and indoor areas. Visitors can discover wild...
globaltix_product_data.description: Faunia is a nature and wildlife park located in Madrid, Spain, designed around immersive ecosystems and themed habitats. The attraction combines a zoo, botanical environment, educational exhibits, and interactive animal experiences across spacious outdoor and indoor areas. Visitors can discover wildlife from around the world while exploring carefully recreated climates and environments in a family-friendly setting. The park features more than 1,200 animals from over 150 species spread across 15 themed areas and four major ecosystems, including the Jungle, Polar Ecosystem, African Forest, and Mediterranean habitats. Guests can see king penguins, Komodo dragons, manatees, lemurs, sea lions, flamingos, and tropical birds while enjoying educational talks, feeding sessions, and interactive experiences. The Polar Ecosystem is especially known for being one of Europe’s largest penguin habitats. Most guests spend between half a day and a full day exploring the attraction depending on their pace and participation in scheduled activities. Entry is available through printed or mobile tickets, and the visit follows a self-guided format with clearly marked routes throughout the park. Visitors can take breaks at restaurants, picnic zones, shops, and rest areas while moving between ecosystems and exhibits.
highlights: Experience one of Europe’s largest polar penguin environments with underwater viewing areas.
Flexible self-guided experience suitable for families, nature lovers, and wildlife enthusiasts.

Visitors take a special slide and slide down the slope, experiencing the thrill of crossing slopes, curves and tunnels. The track is designed to be safe and suitable for family travel, enjoying the dual pleasure of speed and beautiful scenery. Highlights include flexible speed control, magnificent scenery and convenient cable car service to the top. Skyline Luge Busan is a unique outdoor adventure attraction in Busan, South Korea, offering an exciting gravity-powered ride down specially designed hillside tracks. Navigate a series of slopes, curves, and tunnels while controlling your own speed with an easy-to-use steering and braking system. Suitable for families, friends, and riders of all experience levels, the attraction combines thrilling descents with spectacular views of Busan's surrounding landscapes. Guests can also enjoy a scenic Skyride chairlift journey to the top of the course before each unforgettable ride.
highlights: Experience the thrill of riding a gravity-powered luge cart down specially designed tracks featuring curves, slopes, and exciting turns.
Enjoy complete control of your ride with an easy-to-use braking and steering system, suitable for beginners and experienced riders.

Ride the Skyride chairlift to the top of the course and enjoy panoramic vistas before starting your luge adventure.
Perfect for families and groups, with safe, purpose-built tracks designed to provide fun and excitement for a wide range of ages.

globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Use the first offer (including Alex, K-Limousine, Jingle Bell) to activate the pass (start time countdown). Example] With the 48-hour Discover Seoul Pass, you can enjoy the first benefits such as free admission to tourist attractions and free transportation (Alex, K Limousine, etc.) at 9 am on January 1, and you can activate the pass benefits before 8:59 am on January 3. Travel tickets can be redeem ticket within the validity period of the pass (48/72/120 hours). When visiting tourist attractions using Discover Seoul Pass, you must present the QR code registered on the app. The operating hours and holidays of each course may be changed according to the schedule of each course. Please check the website or smartphone application for operation-related notices before visiting. The pass is valid for 5 years from the date of issue. Mobile passes can be used through mobile applications without the need to collect physical cards. (Transportation card function, Rail+, T-money excluded) Discover Seoul Pass is a product for foreigners only. Korean nationals cannot use it. Discover Seoul Pass is for individuals only and not for groups. If more than 10 people use DSP, access to Attraction may be restricted. The app will work properly when the smartphone is connected to a wireless network. However, if the phone is connected to the network, please delete the app and reinstall it. If it does not work even after reinstalling, please consult the Discover Seoul Pass CS Center (Tel: 02-1644-1060). Customers visiting Lotte World must exchange their physical tickets at the South Gate Ticket Office "Overseas Tickets".

globaltix_product_data.description: Escape from the hustle and bustle of the city, take your loved ones to the much-celebrated Splash Out Langkawi, and spend your weekend cooling down with a range of water activities. Slide down the colors of the Rainbow Rider for thrills and spills, or get drenched at Big Splash Kingdom. Ride the gut-wrenching Perfect Storm to show off your bravery and be amazed by the rough ride that will keep you spinning toward the ground. For something more relaxing, casually float on the River of Life and feel the gentle current carry your stresses away.
highlights: Location: The waterpark is located in Kedah Langkawi, around 10 minutes drive from the main ferry terminal.
Attractions: The park features 12 water attractions (River of Life, Big Splash Kingdom, Perfect Storm).
The park is suitable for all ages, with several sections great for younger kids.
Splash Kingdom is a water play area for children 12 years old and below.
Many of the bigger slides and activities have a minimum height requirement of 120cm.
inclusions: Admission to Splash Out Langkawi Water Theme Park

options.description: Operating Hours / Schedule: Effective 2 July 2026, Splash Out Langkawi operates from 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM daily, closed every Wednesday. Please note the park closes earlier at 9:45 PM as per the on-site schedule. Ticket prices remain unchanged — only operating hours and attraction schedules have been updated. Attraction-specific hours: Tower 1 (Perfect Storm, Shipwreck Falls): 5:15 PM – 6:45 PM & 8:30 PM – 9:45 PM Tower 2 (Splash Tacular, Splash Twister, Splash Python): 3:30 PM – 5:00 PM & 7:00 PM – 8:15 PM Wave Run: 3:00 PM – 5:00 PM & 7:15 PM – 9:00 PM River of Life: Open 2:00 PM – 7:00 PM (closed after 7:00 PM) Big Splash, Rainbow Rider, Sprinkle Island, Wild Water: Open throughout regular park hours (2:00 PM – 10:00 PM) Poseidon's Revenge: Fully closed for maintenanceRecommended arrival: at least 15 minutes before your preferred attraction's opening slot, as several rides operate on limited time windows rather than being open all day. What to Bring / Preparation Swimwear, a change of clothes, comfortable sandals or water shoes, a towel, and a waterproof phone pouch or dry bag. Sunscreen and a light jacket are recommended for the evening hours as it can get breezy after sunset. Additional Notes / Tips Since this is a night-opening water park, most attractions run on specific time slots rather than being open continuously — check the schedule above before planning your visit to avoid disappointment. River of Life closes earlier (7:00 PM) than the rest of the park, so plan this ride earlier in your visit. Poseidon's Revenge is fully closed under maintenance — please plan alternative attractions. Lockers, changing rooms, and nursing rooms are available on-site for visitor convenience. Halal food options are available at Seafarers Haven Food Court. How To Get There Address: Splash Out Langkawi, PT 1233, Persiaran Mutiara, Kelana Mas, 07000 Kuah, Langkawi, Kedah By car/taxi: Simply input the address into Google Maps or your GPS. Taxis and ride-hailing services are readily available across the island. From Kuah Jetty: The park is just a short drive away, making it convenient to combine with a Langkawi ferry arrival or island-hopping tour. Parking: On-site parking is available for self-drive visitors.

Attraction-specific hours: Tower 1 (Perfect Storm, Shipwreck Falls): 5:15 PM – 6:45 PM & 8:30 PM – 9:45 PM Tower 2 (Splash Tacular, Splash Twister, Splash Python): 3:30 PM – 5:00 PM & 7:00 PM – 8:15 PM Wave Run: 3:00 PM – 5:00 PM & 7:15 PM – 9:00 PM River of Life: Open 2:00 PM – 7:00 PM (closed after 7:00 PM) Big Splash, Rainbow Rider, Sprinkle Island, Wild Water: Open throughout regular park hours (2:00 PM – 10:00 PM) Poseidon's Revenge: Fully closed for maintenanceRecommended arrival: at least 15 minutes before your preferred attraction's opening slot, as several rides operate on limited time windows rather than being open all day. What to Bring / Preparation Swimwear, a change of clothes, comfortable sandals or water shoes, a towel, and a waterproof phone pouch or dry bag. Sunscreen and a light jacket are recommended for the evening hours as it can get breezy after sunset. Additional Notes / Tips Since this is a night-opening water park, most attractions run on specific time slots rather than being open continuously — check the schedule above before planning your visit to avoid disappointment. River of Life closes earlier (7:00 PM) than the rest of the park, so plan this ride earlier in your visit. Poseidon's Revenge is fully closed under maintenance — please plan alternative attractions. Lockers, changing rooms, and nursing rooms are available on-site for visitor convenience. Halal food options are available at Seafarers Haven Food Court. How To Get There Address: Splash Out Langkawi, PT 1233, Persiaran Mutiara, Kelana Mas, 07000 Kuah, Langkawi, Kedah By car/taxi: Simply input the address into Google Maps or your GPS. Taxis and ride-hailing services are readily available across the island. From Kuah Jetty: The park is just a short drive away, making it convenient to combine with a Langkawi ferry arrival or island-hopping tour. Parking: On-site parking is available for self-drive visitors.

globaltix_product_data.description: SplashMania Waterpark is a tropical-themed waterpark in Gamuda Cove, Selangor, offering a dynamic mix of thrilling slides, wave pools, and family-friendly attractions. Surrounded by a rainforest-inspired setting, the park delivers a refreshing escape with modern facilities and vibrant themed zones. Guests can enjoy both adrenaline-pumping rides and relaxing water experiences, making it a well-rounded destination near Kuala Lumpur. The experience is designed to be flexible and self-paced, with a recommended visit duration of 4 to 6 hours or a full day. Guests can explore the park at their own leisure during operating hours, allowing time to enjoy both high-speed attractions and laid-back areas. Actual duration may vary depending on crowd levels, queue times, and seasonal operations. Upon arrival, guests can enter by scanning their e-ticket directly at the gate or by exchanging it at the counter, depending on the ticket type. Inside, visitors will find a variety of zones featuring signature slides, wave pools, lazy rivers, and dedicated play areas for children. The layout allows smooth movement between attractions, offering a balanced flow from high-energy rides to relaxation spaces. Throughout the visit, guests can also access convenient facilities such as lockers, dining outlets, and rest areas, ensuring a comfortable experience from start to finish. Whether seeking thrills or a casual day out, the park caters to families, couples, and groups looking for an engaging and refreshing waterpark adventure.

globaltix_product_data.summary: America's first wax museum opened in St. Augustine in 1949, and it still occupies its place by the old city gate. More than a hundred and sixty figures fill the galleries, each one sculpted, haired and finished by hand using techniques that have barely changed in a century. The collection ranges wid...
globaltix_product_data.description: America's first wax museum opened in St. Augustine in 1949, and it still occupies its place by the old city gate. More than a hundred and sixty figures fill the galleries, each one sculpted, haired and finished by hand using techniques that have barely changed in a century. The collection ranges wide — presidents and monarchs, explorers and scientists, religious figures, film stars and musicians — with displays explaining how the figures are made, from the clay head and the glass eyes to the individually inserted hairs. A separate gallery given over to horror and film monsters is the part most visitors remember, and photographs are encouraged throughout. It takes about an hour, sits directly on the walking route into the old town, and is pleasantly cool on a hot Florida afternoon.

globaltix_product_data.summary: The Vatican: St. Peter’s Basilica, Papal Tombs Tour with Dome is a comprehensive cultural and religious experience located in Vatican City, offering guided access to one of the most important landmarks in the world. This tour allows visitors to explore the grandeur of St. Peter’s Basilica while unco...
globaltix_product_data.description: The Vatican: St. Peter’s Basilica, Papal Tombs Tour with Dome is a comprehensive cultural and religious experience located in Vatican City, offering guided access to one of the most important landmarks in the world. This tour allows visitors to explore the grandeur of St. Peter’s Basilica while uncovering its rich history, artistic masterpieces, and spiritual significance through expert-led commentary. During the tour, guests will visit key highlights inside the basilica, including Michelangelo’s Pietà, Bernini’s Baldachin, and the vast central nave. The experience also includes access to the Vatican Grottoes (Papal Tombs), where many former popes are buried, providing a deeper connection to centuries of Catholic history. The journey continues with a climb to the dome, where visitors can admire intricate mosaics up close before reaching the top for panoramic views over Vatican City and Rome. The experience typically lasts around 2–2.5 hours and follows a fixed timeslot schedule. Guests meet at a designated point near St. Peter’s Square, pass through security screening, and enter with a guide. The tour follows a structured route—from the basilica interior to the papal tombs and finally the dome—combining guided exploration with short physical activity during the climb.
highlights: Perfect for couples, solo travelers, and small groups seeking an immersive and comprehensive Vatican experience.
Experience breathtaking panoramic views of Rome from the top of St. Peter’s Dome after an unforgettable climb.
Ideal for culture lovers, history enthusiasts, and first-time visitors exploring Vatican City’s most iconic landmark.
Includes guided tour, access to basilica interiors, Vatican Grottoes, dome climb, and audio headsets.
Explore St. Peter’s Basilica, Papal Tombs, and climb the dome while discovering art, history, and religion in one guided tour.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Amsterdam's Stedelijk Museum, the permanent home of the Dutch National Museum of Modern Art, has one of the richest modern art collections in the world. As well as regularly rotating temporary exhibitions, the museum houses many modern classics.The permanent collection of the Stedelijk (Dutch for 'm...
globaltix_product_data.description: Amsterdam's Stedelijk Museum, the permanent home of the Dutch National Museum of Modern Art, has one of the richest modern art collections in the world. As well as regularly rotating temporary exhibitions, the museum houses many modern classics.The permanent collection of the Stedelijk (Dutch for 'municipal') Museum includes works from leading lights of 19th- and 20th-century painting. Artists include Monet, Picasso and Chagall - as well as Pop Art from Warhol and Lichtenstein. There are also abstracts by Mondrian and Kandinsky, a unique collection of 29 paintings by influential avant-garde painter Casimir Malevich, and a whole lot more. With a collection of 90,000 works of art in its 9,000m2 of exhibition space, there's sure to be something for everyone. The terrace that opens onto Amsterdam's famous Museumplein is the perfect spot to relax after your museum visit, enjoy a slice of cake, and repeatedly say to your companions, "Yes, the art was beautiful, but what does it ?".The first edition of the monthly magazine De Stijl was published in 1917. This cutting-edge publication had a huge impact on the art world. This temporary exhibition, part of the 100th anniversary of De Stijl, reveals how the magazine's legacy still resonates today.One of the most impressive Eastern European artists of the 20th century, Edward Krasiński (1925-2004), was also a prominent figure in the 1960s and 1970s Polish avant-garde era. This is the first retrospective of his work in the Netherlands.

globaltix_product_data.summary: The Sumida Aquarium is located on the 5th and 6th floors of the Tokyo Skytree. This urban aquarium has more than 10,000 species of marine life. The museum reproduces the "Tokyo Great Water Tank" in the Ogasawara Sea, a World Heritage Site, and an open indoor water tank. You can see penguins and fur...
globaltix_product_data.description: The Sumida Aquarium is located on the 5th and 6th floors of the Tokyo Skytree. This urban aquarium has more than 10,000 species of marine life. The museum reproduces the "Tokyo Great Water Tank" in the Ogasawara Sea, a World Heritage Site, and an open indoor water tank. You can see penguins and fur seals, the aquarium also has a jellyfish tank and a research laboratory. The Cradle of Life takes the sea of the "Tokyo Islands" as its theme, and reproduces the "Tokyo Grand Tank". Watching whale sharks and various fish swimming in the water, it seems that the marine world of the Ogasawara Islands is in front of you. Playing with Water and Life This is the largest open indoor water tank in Japan, with a water volume of about 350 tons. There are penguins and fur seals living in a large water tank, and you can observe them up close. The exhibition space is connected through two floors, shortening the distance between tourists and animals, and using LED lighting, you can not only watch them move during the day, but also observe penguins sleeping at night. Aquarium Restaurant There is a penguin cafe in the aquarium, providing snacks, desserts, soft drinks, and a place for tourists to rest.
highlights: Discover over 10,000 marine creatures in a modern urban aquarium.
Explore immersive exhibits inspired by the UNESCO-listed Ogasawara Sea.
See penguins and fur seals up close in Japan's largest open indoor tank.
Admire beautiful jellyfish displays and learn about marine conservation.
Relax at the Penguin Café with snacks, desserts, and drinks.

globaltix_product_data.name: SUMMIT One Vanderbilt
globaltix_product_data.summary: SUMMIT One Vanderbilt is New York City's most immersive, visually breathtaking, and creatively extraordinary sky experience — a multi-sensory observation and art installation destination occupying the top four floors of One Vanderbilt Avenue, Midtown Manhattan's most striking supertall skyscraper, t...
globaltix_product_data.description: SUMMIT One Vanderbilt is New York City's most immersive, visually breathtaking, and creatively extraordinary sky experience — a multi-sensory observation and art installation destination occupying the top four floors of One Vanderbilt Avenue, Midtown Manhattan's most striking supertall skyscraper, that redefines what an observation experience can be through a spectacular combination of glass-enclosed outdoor terraces, indoor mirror and glass immersive art environments, and the most dramatic and unobstructed panoramic views of the New York City skyline available from any publicly accessible point in the world's most iconic urban landscape. Unlike any conventional observation deck, SUMMIT One Vanderbilt is as much a world-class contemporary art experience as it is an elevated viewing destination — the immersive installations of artist Kenzo Digital transforming the space into a sensory environment of extraordinary reflective beauty that multiplies and reframes the Manhattan skyline in endlessly surprising and visually arresting ways. The experience encompasses three distinct and equally extraordinary environments — the indoor glass and mirror immersive art spaces where the city and the sky are reflected and distorted into a visual world of almost infinite depth and beauty, the outdoor glass-enclosed terraces where the Midtown skyline fills every panel of the wraparound glazed walls at dazzling proximity, and the signature LEVITATION experience — glass-floored and glass-walled outdoor pods that extend beyond the building's facade at 1,000 feet above street level, placing guests in suspended transparent glass enclosures with the city visible in every direction including directly below their feet in a physical sensation of vertiginous aerial exposure that is completely unlike anything available at any other observation experience in New York City.
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: The fee does not include food and beverages, gratuities, or other personal expenses. Free for children aged 0–5 The venue does not provide luggage storage facilities. As SUMMIT One Vanderbilt is a unique space, please note the following dress code: Wear comfortable shoes. Stiletto heels, steel-toe boots, sneakers, and other footwear that may damage the mirrored floor are not allowed. Dress appropriately and avoid unnecessary exposure on glass and mirrored floors. SUMMIT recommends wearing long pants, shorts, or leggings whenever possible. If visiting during the day, SUMMIT recommends bringing sunglasses. Please note that all SUMMIT admission tickets are time-stamped. You must arrive at the specified time. If you arrive more than 20 minutes after the time stated on your ticket, you may not be admitted. Any late arrival is subject to availability and requires a rescheduling fee. Location of use 45 E 42nd St, New York, NY 10017 Time of use Please refer to your selected time slot

globaltix_product_data.description: SUMMIT One Vanderbilt is New York City's most immersive, visually breathtaking, and creatively extraordinary sky experience — a multi-sensory observation and art installation destination occupying the top four floors of One Vanderbilt Avenue, Midtown Manhattan's most striking supertall skyscraper, that redefines what an observation experience can be through a spectacular combination of glass-enclosed outdoor terraces, indoor mirror and glass immersive art environments, and the most dramatic and unobstructed panoramic views of the New York City skyline available from any publicly accessible point in the world's most iconic urban landscape. Unlike any conventional observation deck, SUMMIT One Vanderbilt is as much a world-class contemporary art experience as it is an elevated viewing destination — the immersive installations of artist Kenzo Digital transforming the space into a sensory environment of extraordinary reflective beauty that multiplies and reframes the Manhattan skyline in endlessly surprising and visually arresting ways. The experience encompasses three distinct and equally extraordinary environments — the indoor glass and mirror immersive art spaces where the city and the sky are reflected and distorted into a visual world of almost infinite depth and beauty, the outdoor glass-enclosed terraces where the Midtown skyline fills every panel of the wraparound glazed walls at dazzling proximity, and the signature LEVITATION experience — glass-floored and glass-walled outdoor pods that extend beyond the building's facade at 1,000 feet above street level, placing guests in suspended transparent glass enclosures with the city visible in every direction including directly below their feet in a physical sensation of vertiginous aerial exposure that is completely unlike anything available at any other observation experience in New York City.

globaltix_product_data.name: Sun World Ba Den Mountain
globaltix_product_data.summary: Sun World Ba Den Mountain is a premier cultural, spiritual, and sightseeing destination located atop Ba Den Mountain—the highest peak in southern Vietnam, often referred to as the “Roof of the South.” Rising nearly 1,000 meters above the plains, the complex offers a unique blend of majestic natural...
globaltix_product_data.description: Sun World Ba Den Mountain is a premier cultural, spiritual, and sightseeing destination located atop Ba Den Mountain—the highest peak in southern Vietnam, often referred to as the “Roof of the South.” Rising nearly 1,000 meters above the plains, the complex offers a unique blend of majestic natural landscapes, rich heritage, and modern tourism experiences. Developed by Sun Group, the destination features a world-class cable car system that allows visitors to effortlessly reach the summit while enjoying panoramic views of lush forests, vast farmlands, and drifting clouds. The cable car station itself holds a Guinness World Record as the largest in the world, adding a sense of scale and innovation to the journey. At its core, Sun World Ba Den Mountain is renowned as a sacred pilgrimage site. The mountain is home to an extensive system of ancient pagodas and temples, including the centuries-old Ba Pagoda complex nestled midway up the mountain. At the summit stands the impressive Tay Bo Da Son Buddha statue—recognized as the tallest bronze Buddha statue in Asia—alongside other monumental spiritual works that create a serene and awe-inspiring atmosphere. Beyond spirituality, the destination offers a rich cultural experience with year-round festivals, traditional ceremonies, and artistic performances that celebrate local heritage. Visitors can also explore scenic gardens, exhibition spaces, and modern entertainment features, making it an ideal destination for both pilgrimage and leisure travel. Combining breathtaking scenery, deep-rooted spirituality, and world-class infrastructure, Sun World Ba Den Mountain delivers a memorable journey where visitors can reconnect with nature, culture, and inner peace in one of southern Vietnam’s most iconic destinations.
highlights: Spectacular Cable Car Journey – Ride one of the world’s most modern cable car systems with stunning panoramic views from base to summit.
Southern Vietnam’s Highest Peak – Reach the “Roof of the South” at nearly 1,000 meters above sea level.
Sacred Spiritual Complex – Discover ancient pagodas and peaceful temples nestled in the mountains.
Iconic Giant Buddha Statue – Visit the impressive Tay Bo Da Son Buddha, a major spiritual landmark.
Breathtaking Scenic Views – Enjoy sweeping landscapes of forests, farmlands, and clouds from the mountaintop.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Sun World Ba Na Hills is an entertainment complex in Da Nang, Vietnam, known for its breathtaking mountain scenery, French-inspired architecture, and world-class attractions. Visitors can ride one of the world’s longest cable cars, stroll across the famous Golden Bridge, explore the charming French...
globaltix_product_data.description: Sun World Ba Na Hills is an entertainment complex in Da Nang, Vietnam, known for its breathtaking mountain scenery, French-inspired architecture, and world-class attractions. Visitors can ride one of the world’s longest cable cars, stroll across the famous Golden Bridge, explore the charming French Village, and enjoy thrilling games at Fantasy Park. With its cool climate, stunning landscapes, and diverse cultural experiences, Ba Na Hills is a must-visit destination for travelers seeking adventure and relaxation.
highlights: Enjoy the stunning panoramic views of the mountains and lush landscapes by the iconic "Hand of the Gods" bridge aka Golden Bridge.
Take one of the world's longest cable car rides, the cable car taking visitors through breathtaking mountain scenery.
Visit French Village - a charming European style village with cobblestone streets, Gothic architecture, and romantic atmosphere.
Visit Linh Ung Pagoda, a serene Buddhist temple featuring a giant white Buddha statue and peaceful surroundings.
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Enter with voucher Ticket is valid only for the selected date. The ticket is valid for single use only. Eligibility Senior ticket is applicable for adults from 70 years old and above. Child ticket is applicable for child height 100-140cm. Child height under 100cm can enter free of charge. Additional information Customers aged 18 and above are eligible for two complimentary glasses of craft beers (250ml/each), subject to changes based on operational circumstances. The attraction operation schedule can be changed/closed without prior notice due to the weather conditions. Please always keep your voucher during the visit time.
globaltix_product_data.address: An Son Village, Hoa Ninh Commune, Hoa Vang District, Da Nang City

globaltix_product_data.description: Sun World Ba Na Hills is an entertainment complex in Da Nang, Vietnam, known for its breathtaking mountain scenery, French-inspired architecture, and world-class attractions. Visitors can ride one of the world’s longest cable cars, stroll across the famous Golden Bridge, explore the charming French Village, and enjoy thrilling games at Fantasy Park. With its cool climate, stunning landscapes, and diverse cultural experiences, Ba Na Hills is a must-visit destination for travelers seeking adventure and relaxation.
highlights: Enjoy the stunning panoramic views of the mountains and lush landscapes by the iconic "Hand of the Gods" bridge aka Golden Bridge.
Take one of the world's longest cable car rides, the cable car taking visitors through breathtaking mountain scenery.
Visit French Village - a charming European style village with cobblestone streets, Gothic architecture, and romantic atmosphere.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Sun World Hon Thom is a world-class island entertainment complex located on Hon Thom Island, part of the An Thoi archipelago in southern Phu Quoc. Blending pristine tropical nature with modern attractions, it offers visitors a full day of adventure, relaxation, and immersive entertainment. The journ...
globaltix_product_data.description: Sun World Hon Thom is a world-class island entertainment complex located on Hon Thom Island, part of the An Thoi archipelago in southern Phu Quoc. Blending pristine tropical nature with modern attractions, it offers visitors a full day of adventure, relaxation, and immersive entertainment. The journey begins with the world’s longest sea-crossing cable car, stretching nearly 8 kilometers, where guests can enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of turquoise waters and scattered islets below. Upon arrival, visitors are welcomed into a vibrant island paradise featuring Aquatopia Water Park—one of Southeast Asia’s most advanced water parks with over 20 thrilling rides—alongside a wide range of beach and marine activities such as snorkeling, kayaking, and parasailing. Beyond daytime experiences, the magic continues into the evening at Sunset Town, located near the cable car station on the mainland. This Mediterranean-inspired coastal complex comes alive with spectacular live shows, combining cutting-edge multimedia effects, music, water, and light performances set against the backdrop of the ocean at sunset. Visitors can enjoy vibrant street performances, artistic displays, and large-scale productions that create a lively, romantic atmosphere—perfect for ending the day on a high note. With its unique combination of thrilling attractions, natural beauty, and world-class entertainment from island to sunset shows, Sun World Hon Thom delivers a truly unforgettable experience in Phu Quoc.
highlights: Ride the world’s longest sea-crossing cable car with breathtaking panoramic ocean views
Experience thrilling slides and attractions at Aquatopia Water Park
Relax on pristine beaches with crystal-clear waters on Hon Thom Island
Enjoy a mix of water sports and leisure activities in a tropical island setting
End your day with vibrant sunset vibes and spectacular shows at Sunset Town

globaltix_product_data.summary: "Immerse yourself in history, myth, and natural beauty on a captivating day tour from Antalya to Kekova, Demre, and Myra.  This adventure unveils a treasure trove of ancient wonders, starting with a mesmerizing boat trip along the turquoise coast.  As you sail the crystal-clear waters, pee...
globaltix_product_data.description: "Immerse yourself in history, myth, and natural beauty on a captivating day tour from Antalya to Kekova, Demre, and Myra.  This adventure unveils a treasure trove of ancient wonders, starting with a mesmerizing boat trip along the turquoise coast.  As you sail the crystal-clear waters, peer down to catch glimpses of the Sunken City of Kekova, a former Lycian city partially submerged by earthquakes centuries ago.  Imagine the bustling life that once thrived here, and marvel at the resilience of these submerged structures.
highlights: Visit the Church of Saint Nicholas in Demre: Demre, also known as Kale, is believed to be the former bishopric of Saint Nicholas, also known as Santa Claus.
Discover the Ancient City of Myra: Myra was an important Lycian city in ancient times.
Scenic Boat Trip: Enjoy a relaxing boat trip along the coast, taking in the beautiful scenery of the Mediterranean Sea and the surrounding mountains.
Learn About Lycian History: Throughout the day, your guide will share information about the Lycian civilization
Explore the Sunken City of Kekova: Sail over the sunken ruins of Kekova, a former Lycian city partially submerged by earthquakes centuries ago

globaltix_product_data.description: Experience endless fun and excitement at Berjaya Times Square Theme Park, a world-class indoor amusement park located within one of Kuala Lumpur’s largest shopping malls. Enjoy adrenaline-pumping rides like the Supersonic Odyssey suspended roller coaster and thrilling Go-Kart racing, alongside family-friendly attractions in the Kids’ Zone with colorful rides and safe play areas. The Experience Pass offers unlimited access to rides and attractions, plus entertainment in the arcade filled with games for all ages. With flexible single- or multi-day passes, dining options, and shopping just steps away, it’s the perfect destination for thrill-seekers, families, and friends looking for an action-packed day indoors.
highlights: Experience heart-pounding excitement with a variety of thrilling rides at Berjaya Times Square Theme Park.
Challenge your friends and family to a thrilling race on our exhilarating Go-Kart track, where speed and skill will determine the victor.
For the younger ones, the Kids' Zone offers a magical and enchanting experience.
Step into our Arcade section and discover a world of entertainment and gaming.
inclusions: Rides included: Supersonic Odyssey Roller Coaster, Robo Crash, Honey Bump, Molly-Cool’s Swing, Crazy Bus, Botanic Drive, Flying Bumble Bee, Buddy Go Round, Fantasy Trail, Dizzy Izzy, Spinning Orbit, Ooorts’ Express
Admission to: Berjaya Times Square Theme Park & Amusement Rides
exclusions: Excludes Terry Carnival Games Level 5, Terry Carnival Games Level 7, Haunted House, Semico Battle, Winter Wonderland Snow Town, 7D Xperia, Combat Heroes, Arcade Games and Go-Kart @ BTSKL.
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Admission Ticket is valid for Malaysian and non-Malaysian tourists. Ticket is valid for one-time entry only. A valid ticket must be presented to gain admission. Entry is only permitted within the validity period stated on the ticket. Entry will not be allowed for tickets that are invalid, redeemed, collected, consumed, lost, or expired. Tickets will not be replaced and no refund will be provided. The attraction reserves the right to request personal identification or proof of nationality before granting admission. Access may be denied if ticket conditions of sale have not been met. Eligibility Child below 3 years old or below 90 cm in height is free of charge. A surcharge of RM 20.00 (Adult) or RM 16.00 (Child) will be imposed on customers who fail to present their Malaysian Identity Card (MyKad/MyKid) during redemption of Malaysian ticket category. The attraction reserves the right to determine Child, Infant, Youth, Senior, or Adult ticket age range and may request proof of age before admission. Attraction Access Height, weight, size, and age restrictions and medical warnings apply to certain rides and attractions. These are displayed at each ride and available at Guest Services. The attraction reserves the right to change operating days, hours, and last admission times without prior notice. The attraction may temporarily or permanently close rides, events, or facilities for maintenance, safety, operational reasons, force majeure, special events, or private functions. No ticket replacement or refund will be granted under these circumstances. Additional Information No jewelry or valuable items are allowed to be worn or brought during activities. This activity is not recommended for individuals with medical conditions (e.g., high blood pressure, epilepsy), pregnant women, or seniors. Due to the nature of the activity, it is not recommended for persons with impaired physical mobility or wheelchair users. Important Notes Please ensure all admission, eligibility, and attraction access requirements above are reviewed prior to your visit. Plan your visit in advance and check the official website for the latest operating hours before arrival. How to Get There Easily accessible by public transportation. Take the KL Monorail to Imbi station, which is directly connected to Berjaya Times Square.

globaltix_product_data.description: Cruise aboard Sydney's flagship MV Sydney 2000 in this 3-course lunch cruise along the beautiful Sydney Harbour. Enjoy stunning views from the upper deck, superb dining and attentive service for the entirety of the journey. With a contemporary a la carte lunch menu with a 3-course option, this is simply Sydney's best lunchtime venue. With dishes such as salmon, beef serloin fillet and slow-baked lemon and lime tart on offer, you can be certain that both your eyes and your tastebuds are in for a treat on this cruise. Travelling past icons such as the Sydney Harbour Bridge and the Sydney Opera House, you'll witness million-dollar views usually only reserved for the very wealthy. Dress code is smart casual, so no singlets and thongs are allowed. Cruises depart from No.6 Jetty at Circular Quay at 12.30pm and return at 2:00pm or 3:30pm. For those closer to Darling Harbour, cruises depart there from No.1 King St Wharf at 12noon and return at approximately 1:30pm or 3:00pm. For a unique way to see Sydney this is it. Why settle for your run of the mill restaurant when you could enjoy a lunch cruise!

options.name: Top Deck 3 Course Lunch
options.description: Cruise aboard Sydney's flagship MV Sydney 2000 in this 3-course lunch cruise along the beautiful Sydney Harbour. Enjoy stunning views from the upper deck, superb dining and attentive service for the entirety of the journey. With a contemporary a la carte lunch menu with a 3-course option, this is simply Sydney's best lunchtime venue. With dishes such as salmon, beef serloin fillet and slow-baked lemon and lime tart on offer, you can be certain that both your eyes and your tastebuds are in for a treat on this cruise. Travelling past icons such as the Sydney Harbour Bridge and the Sydney Opera House, you'll witness million-dollar views usually only reserved for the very wealthy. Dress code is smart casual, so no singlets and thongs are allowed. Cruises depart from No.6 Jetty at Circular Quay at 12.30pm and return at 2:00pm or 3:30pm. For those closer to Darling Harbour, cruises depart there from No.1 King St Wharf at 12noon and return at approximately 1:30pm or 3:00pm. For a unique way to see Sydney this is it. Why settle for your run of the mill restaurant when you could enjoy a lunch cruise! Inclusions * 3 course contemporary Australian a la carte dining * 3 hour cruise on Sydney Harbour Cruise Exclusions * Hotel transfers * Drinks are not included in this experience, but may be purchased onboard. BYO is not permitted Extras * Upgrade to a guaranteed window seat - Once you have received your voucher, you can call the tour operator to add on this upgrade option (their contact number will be printed on your voucher) Highlights * Enjoy spectacular views of the Sydney Harbour while cruising onboard Sydney's flagship vessel on the top deck of course * Famous Sydney sights * Sydney Opera House * Sydney Harbour Bridge * 3 course contemporary Australian a-la-carte menu Time * Departs No.6 Jetty Circular Quay at 12.30pm and returns at 2.00pm or 3.30pm. Departs No.1 King St Wharf Darling Harbour at 1.30pm and returns at 3.00pm. * Departs Thursday - Sunday, subject to availability * Not available on special event days including, but not limited to, Valentine's Day, Christmas Day, Boxing Day or Australia Day Sample Menu __Entrée__ * Smoked salmon with herb salad of dill, lime, Sicilian capers, and Cornichons (GF) * Spinach and ricotta light ravioli served with salsa Napolitana and aged Italian Grana Padano cheese (V) * Melange of sweet potato & pumpkin with shredded kale and couscous, fragrant herb vinaigrette dressing with hints of rosemary, oregano, thyme & dried cranberries, crushed walnuts (V) __Main Course__ * Barramundi fillet gremolata rubbed, vegetable medley & lemon infused oil (GF available) * Australian serloin fillet served with mashed potatoes, baby beets and veal jus (GF available) * Roast chicken supreme served with wild rocket, carrot batons, spinach & pumpkin, seasoned with lemon myrtle and white pepper Chardonnay jus * Middle-eastern slow cooked eggplant, with zucchini, roasted capsicum, polenta and marinated semi-dried tomatoes (V-GF) __Desserts__ * Exotic stone – whipped coconut mousse with a tropical crémeux insert on an almond sablé with yellow glaze & passion fruit marshmallow * Chocolate Caramel – light chocolate, cold-set cheesecake & smooth caramel inner layer with dark chocolate mirror glacé and Belgium chocolate disc * Tiramisu Tower – Amaretto biscuits dipped in coffee, layered with soft cream and flavoured with cocoa Additional Information * Smart casual dress code * Sample menu subject to change without notice * Anyone below the age of 18 must be accompanied by a parent * Child fare includes a special Child Menu. globaltix_product_data.summary: Cruise aboard Sydney's flagship MV Sydney 2000 in this 3-course lunch cruise along the beautiful Sydney Harbour. Enjoy stunning views from the upper deck, superb dining and attentive service for the entirety of the journey. With a contemporary a la carte lunch menu with a 3-course option, this is si...
globaltix_product_data.description: Cruise aboard Sydney's flagship MV Sydney 2000 in this 3-course lunch cruise along the beautiful Sydney Harbour. Enjoy stunning views from the upper deck, superb dining and attentive service for the entirety of the journey. With a contemporary a la carte lunch menu with a 3-course option, this is simply Sydney's best lunchtime venue. With dishes such as salmon, beef serloin fillet and slow-baked lemon and lime tart on offer, you can be certain that both your eyes and your tastebuds are in for a treat on this cruise. Travelling past icons such as the Sydney Harbour Bridge and the Sydney Opera House, you'll witness million-dollar views usually only reserved for the very wealthy. Dress code is smart casual, so no singlets and thongs are allowed. Cruises depart from No.6 Jetty at Circular Quay at 12.30pm and return at 2:00pm or 3:30pm. For those closer to Darling Harbour, cruises depart there from No.1 King St Wharf at 12noon and return at approximately 1:30pm or 3:00pm. For a unique way to see Sydney this is it. Why settle for your run of the mill restaurant when you could enjoy a lunch cruise!
highlights: Contemporary Australian cuisine
See famous Sydney Harbour sites
Delicious 3 course lunch

globaltix_product_data.summary: Soaring 309 meters above Sydney's cityscape, Sydney Tower Eye (often simply called Sydney Tower) offers unparalleled 360-degree panoramic views. This iconic landmark, situated in the heart of Sydney CBD, is a must-visit for anyone wanting to experience the city from a breathtaking new perspective. T...
globaltix_product_data.description: Soaring 309 meters above Sydney's cityscape, Sydney Tower Eye (often simply called Sydney Tower) offers unparalleled 360-degree panoramic views. This iconic landmark, situated in the heart of Sydney CBD, is a must-visit for anyone wanting to experience the city from a breathtaking new perspective. The fully enclosed observation deck allows you to take in the sights no matter the weather. Marvel at iconic landmarks like the Sydney Harbour Bridge and Opera House in stunning detail. On a clear day, you can even see as far as the Blue Mountains, a dramatic range located 80 kilometers away. For the thrill-seekers, Sydney Tower boasts the Skywalk experience. Step out onto an open-air platform hundreds of meters above the ground for a truly exhilarating adventure with breathtaking city panoramas. Whether you choose to sightsee from the observation deck or take the heart-pounding Skywalk adventure, Sydney Tower Eye promises an unforgettable experience that will leave you speechless.
highlights: All-Weather Observation Deck: Enjoy stunning views comfortably year-round.
Witness Sydney's iconic skyline from 309 meters above the city.
Gaze upon this dramatic mountain range 80 kilometers away.
Thrill-seekers can step onto an open-air platform for breathtaking city views.
Iconic Landmarks in Detail: See the Sydney Harbour Bridge and Opera House up close.

globaltix_product_data.description: Made entirely in Sweden and assembled in Singapore, T-Play (Kids Indoor Playground) is the first augmented playground introduced in HomeTeamNS, and one of the most interactive transportation themed playgrounds in Singapore. Housed in a 4,200 square foot facility at HomeTeamNS Bukit Batok, the specially crafted kid-friendly arena consists of spectacular designs and interactive play centres. These centres are designed to engage the child’s brain development, motion coordination and sense of direction. Parents can observe their young ones from a distance, or enjoy the various facilities available at the clubhouse while their kids play freely. Adult supervision is encouraged. T-Play (Kids Indoor Playground) offers party rooms to host birthday parties and field trips. We cater to children aged 6 months to 12 years old.

globaltix_product_data.description: The Chimei Museum is a renowned private museum located in Tainan, Taiwan, celebrated for its vast and diverse collections that blend Western art, musical instruments, natural history, and cultural artifacts. Founded in 1992 by philanthropist Shi Wen-long, the museum aims to make art and culture accessible to everyone, reflecting its guiding principle of “sharing the beauty of art with the public.” Housed in a grand, neoclassical-style building within Tainan Metropolitan Park, the museum’s design and surroundings evoke the elegance of European architecture and gardens.
highlights: Masterpieces spanning Western art from the Renaissance to modern times.
Fascinating wildlife, fossils, and diorama exhibits.
One of the world’s finest violin and instrument collections.

globaltix_product_data.summary: The Maokong Gondola is one of Taipei's most scenic and beloved leisure attractions, offering a breathtaking aerial cable car journey through the forested hillsides of southern Taipei from Taipei Zoo Station all the way up to the tea-growing highlands of Maokong. Operated by the Taipei Rapid Transit...
globaltix_product_data.description: The Maokong Gondola is one of Taipei's most scenic and beloved leisure attractions, offering a breathtaking aerial cable car journey through the forested hillsides of southern Taipei from Taipei Zoo Station all the way up to the tea-growing highlands of Maokong. Operated by the Taipei Rapid Transit Corporation, the gondola system stretches approximately 4.03 kilometres across four stations — Taipei Zoo, Taipei Zoo South, Zhinan Temple, and Maokong — rising steadily through dense subtropical forest and offering sweeping panoramic views over the city, the surrounding mountain ranges, and the verdant valleys below. It is one of the few urban gondola systems in Asia that combines effortless scenic transportation with a genuine cultural and culinary destination at its summit, making it equally appealing as a sightseeing experience, a family day out, and a popular evening excursion for both locals and international visitors.The gondola fleet includes both standard enclosed cabins and the much-sought-after Crystal Cabins — gondolas fitted with a transparent glass floor panel that allows guests to look directly down through the cabin base to the forest canopy and terrain far below, adding a thrilling and unforgettable dimension to the aerial journey for those willing to embrace the vertigo-inducing perspective. Each cabin accommodates up to 8 passengers and the ride between the bottom and top stations takes approximately 30 minutes each way, delivering consistently spectacular views throughout. At the Maokong summit, the gondola connects visitors to one of Taiwan's most charming tea culture destinations — a hillside community of traditional teahouses, restaurants, and scenic viewpoints nestled among the tea plantations that have defined the area's identity for generations. The Maokong area is particularly celebrated for its Tieguanyin and Four Seasons oolong teas, and a visit to one of the many rustic teahouses perched along the hillside ridge is an essential and deeply enjoyable part of the full Maokong experience.

globaltix_product_data.description: Taipei 101 Observatory offers panoramic views of Taipei City from one of the world's most iconic skyscrapers, located in the heart of the Xinyi District. Formerly the world's tallest building and still considered the world's tallest "green" structure, Taipei 101 rises 508 meters (382 meters to the main observation floor), giving visitors sweeping 360-degree views across the city skyline and surrounding mountains — extending to the Taiwan Strait on clear days. The visitor experience begins with one of the world's fastest elevators, whisking guests from the 5th floor to the 89th-floor Indoor Observatory in just 37 seconds at a speed of 1,010 meters per minute. From there, guests can explore the enclosed 89th-floor deck with floor-to-ceiling glass walls, and — when conditions allow — step out onto the open-air 91st-floor Outdoor Observatory at 440 meters for a breezier, unfiltered view of the city. Engineering enthusiasts can also view the building's massive Tuned Mass Damper, the world's largest, which helps stabilize the tower against high winds and earthquakes. A separate "Skyline 460" add-on ticket grants limited-time access to the 101st-floor open-air platform for those wanting to go even higher. An "Infinite Sky" mirrored installation adds a striking photo opportunity along the visitor path, using reflection and rotation effects to create a kaleidoscope-like visual. Dining options near the observatory cater to a range of tastes, including Taiwanese, Western, vegetarian, and Halal choices.
highlights: Admire spectacular 360-degree panoramic views of Taipei from the 89th-floor indoor observatory.
Visit one of the world's tallest and most iconic skyscrapers.
See the famous 660-ton tuned mass damper that helps stabilize the building.
Capture stunning cityscape photos during both daytime and nighttime visits.
Enjoy a comfortable indoor viewing experience with interactive exhibits and souvenir shops.

globaltix_product_data.description: The Kecak Dance at Tanah Lot is a traditional Balinese performance held in the open air near the iconic Tanah Lot sea temple. Performed at sunset, the dance is famous for its powerful “cak-cak-cak” chanting, created by a large group of male performers sitting in a circle. Unlike most Balinese dances, Kecak uses no musical instruments—the rhythm and energy come entirely from human voices and movements. The story usually comes from the Ramayana epic, focusing on Prince Rama, Princess Sita, the demon king Ravana, and the monkey warrior Hanuman. The dramatic chanting, expressive hand gestures, and fire elements combine with the ocean and sunset backdrop, creating a memorable cultural experience. Location : Inside in area Tanah Lot , De Jukung Resto & Bar Tanah Lot Exclude : Entrance Ticket Tanah Lot Foreigner Tourist : Adult : IDR 75.000, Child : IDR 40.000 Domestic Tourist : Dewasa : IDR 30.000, Anak : IDR 20.000 Parking Vehicle : 2 Wheels : Rp 3.000 ; 4 Wheels : Rp 5.000 ; 6 Wheels : Rp 10.000

options.name: up to 15,000ft tandem skydive
options.description: Take on the thrill of a lifetime and discover the magic of Newcastle from above with a Tandem Skydive up to 15,000ft! The fun doesn't truly begin until you reach the dropzone. On the count of three, you'll be out of the plane door and free-falling for up to 60 seconds and reaching speeds of up to 200km/hr, all while attached to a qualified skydiving instructor. Once the intitial fall is over and your parachute has been deployed, you'll be able to relax and catch your breath as you leisurely float to views of the entire region for around 5 to 7 minutes. Offering up magnificent views of the Hunter Valley and Lake region, as well as unforgettable views of the amazing NSW coastline, this experience is truly one to tell the grandkids. All personalised training and instruction is provided before your jump to help settle any fears you may have. The drop zone is located at Belmont Airport, Newcastle and is accessible by car, bus or train. Allow approximately 4 hours for your total skydive experience * Transfers are available every Tuesday and Wednesday at 6.50am for a 7am pick up Location * If you are self driving, please meet at the drop zone check-in office, located at Belmont Airport, 864 Pacific Hwy, Marks Point, approximately a 90 minute drive from Sydney and 30 minute drive from Newcastle * Transfers are available from Sydney CBD every Tuesday and Wednesday 6.50am for 7am. globaltix_product_data.description: Travel from the town of Te Anau to **New Zealand's**' famous underground network of glow worm caves nearby that is illuminated by the light of hundreds of native local **glow worms**! This **glow worms tour** will take you into their heart to view this amazing natural display up close. A must-do experience for anyone visiting the Fiordland region, the **glow worm caves** are located in the lower section of a much larger cave system which extends deep under the nearby Fiordland National Park and consist of a wondrous underground world of flowing water that plays home to hundreds of the shimmering glow worms. The tour begins with a cruise across the smooth waters of Lake Te Anau aboard our purpose-built cruise vessel as we then disembark on the Western shores and take some time to view the informative displays at Cavern House before being accompanied by your friendly, experienced nature guide into the caves in a small group. Inclusions * Tour through the underground network of glowworm caves * Short guided walk into the forest to view native flora and fauna * Return Scenic Cruise across Lake Te Anau on a luxury catamaran * Complimentary tea and coffee Exclusions * Refreshments are not included however can be purchased at the Cavern House and on the boat at the location of the Te Anau Glowworm Caves and also on the cruise vessel Highlights * Experience a mysterious underground world with a guided cave tour past the rushing water of an underground stream before drifting in silent darkness beneath the luminous shimmer of hundreds of glowworms Time *Ex Te Anau* * 10.15am * 2pm * 4:30pm Departure Location * Trips to the Glowworm Caves depart from the RealNZ Visitor Centre, 85 Lakefront Drive, Te Anau What To Bring * Waterproof jacket * Insect repellent * Sunscreen/ sunglasses * Camera Additional Information * Suitable for all ages with exception of infants * Morning departure times may vary * Light refreshments are available for purchase at Cavern House and on the Luminosa. * A REASONABLE AGILITY LEVEL IS NECESSARY (SOME BENDING IS REQUIRED DUE TO LOW CAVES ENTRANCE AND STEPS ARE INVOLVED). NOT SUITABLE FOR WHEELCHAIR PASSENGERS OR HEELED SHOES Booking Information * Confirmation in the form of a tour voucher will be received at time of booking * Upon completion of purchase, please print the voucher and present on day of the experience * For your information, complete Tour Operator Information including contact details is included on your tour voucher * Availability was accurate at the time of booking however, is subject to change due to circumstances out of our control. globaltix_product_data.description: The world-famous Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre in Hanoi has its roots in an art form that dates back to the 11th century. The tradition of water puppet theater stems from a time when rice paddy fields were flooded and villagers would create entertainment by standing in waist-deep water with the puppets performing over the water. Using large rods to support the puppets it appeared as if they were moving across the water with the puppeteers hidden behind a screen.
highlights: Authentic Art Form: Experience Vietnam’s unique water puppetry, a 1,000-year-old tradition performed on a live water stage.
Cultural Storytelling: Watch folk tales, legends, and rural life come alive through handcrafted puppets and skilled puppeteers.
Live Orchestra: Enjoy traditional Vietnamese music with live singers and instruments enhancing every scene.
Immersive Setting: Sit in a theater designed for close-up views of the water stage, creating an engaging and intimate atmosphere.
Easy & Family-Friendly: Short, engaging show ideal for all ages, perfect for adding a cultural highlight to your Hanoi visit.

globaltix_product_data.description: The Habitat Penang Hill is a B Corp Certified, award winning rainforest discovery park, set atop the storied Penang Hill, the gateway to the UNESCO Penang Hill Biosphere Reserve. Apart from the myriad of flora and fauna that are discoverable along our 1.6km trail, visitors will enjoy breathtaking views atop Curtis Crest Tree Top Walk, the highest accessible viewing platform on Penang Island as well as traverse the longest bridge of its kind in the world, the Langur Way Canopy Walk. Your visit helps funds environmental conservation and education efforts in Penang and beyond through The Habitat Foundation Experience iconic attractions including the Curtis Crest Tree Top Walk and Langur Way Canopy Walk, offering scenic views and unforgettable rainforest adventures while contributing to conservation efforts.
highlights: Enjoy the vibes of the rainforests of the UNESCO Penang Hill Biosphere Reserve
Traverse the longest double span ribbon bridge in the world, the Langur Way Canopy Walk
Set your sights on breathtaking views of Penang and its surroundings atop Curtis Crest Tree Top Walk, the highest accessible viewing platform on the island
Discover the myriad of flora and fauna that call our rainforest home
Unique Wildlife and Exquisite Flora: Over 150 species of fauna and more than 200 species of flora are being showcased throughout the entire exhibition.

Night Walk starts around 7.45pm (subject to darkness), lasts about 1 hour, ends around 8.45pm. Sunset and Night Walk experiences are weather dependent. Important Notes Outside food and drinks are not allowed inside the venue. Weather conditions may affect sunset and night walk experiences.

globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: 1. The performance only supports seat selection by ticket tier, with specific seats automatically assigned by the system. Neither seating zones nor exact seats can be specified. The ticket tier price directly corresponds to seat quality—higher prices increase the probability of obtaining seats with better visibility. Within your selected ticket tier range, the system will prioritize allocating relatively better seats based on factors like order time. Due to production scheduling, available seating ranges may vary across different dates and performances, meaning some seats may have obstructed views. The system cannot specify obstruction probabilities for specific ticket tiers during purchase. If you require optimal visibility, we recommend choosing a higher ticket tier for better viewing position assurance (suggestion only; please purchase according to personal needs). Placing an order indicates your understanding and agreement with this rule. 2. This performance is suitable for audiences aged 12 and above. Children under 5 are not permitted. Children under 16 must be accompanied by an adult and share the same seat. Children purchasing tickets alone will be denied entry. 3. The system will prioritize seating together for products under the same booking, but adjacent seating may not be available due to limited seats. Products from different bookings cannot be identified as companion bookings by the system and therefore will not be processed for adjacent seating. 4. Since the valid QR code for the admission voucher takes time to generate, please wait for 5 minutes after your booking is confirmed to view the voucher (ensure there's a QR code in the top-left corner). 5. For certain mobile models that require additional download of the voucher, to avoid download failures due to poor on-site Internet connection, we recommend downloading the voucher in advance and keeping a screenshot. 6. The price of admission tickets may vary due to factors such as demand and unexpected events, so the price you pay may differ from other ticket prices. 7. Outside food and beverages are not allowed inside the venue. globaltix_product_data.description: Lost World Aquarium is a family-friendly attraction that brings you up close with a variety of fascinating marine life in an immersive and educational environment. Explore themed zones filled with colorful fish, unique sea creatures, and interactive exhibits designed to entertain both kids and adults, making it a perfect stop for a fun and relaxing outing.
highlights: Marine Life: The aquarium is home to over 65,000 marine animals from different parts of the world.
Theme: The aquarium is designed to resemble the lost city of Atlantis, with its ruins and ancient artifacts.
Location: The Palm resort on the Palm Jumeirah island in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

Participants under 18 must be accompanied by an adult. Pregnant women are not allowed to participate in this experience.

globaltix_product_data.description: The Bangkok: The Newest Luxury 5-Star Bangkok Chao Phraya Cruise is a premium river cruise experience set along the iconic Chao Phraya River in Bangkok, Thailand. This luxury dinner cruise offers a unique way to explore the city at night, combining panoramic views of illuminated landmarks with fine dining and live entertainment aboard a modern, state-of-the-art vessel. Guests will enjoy a 2-hour journey on a spacious 3-deck cruise ship, including an open-air rooftop deck for unobstructed skyline views and indoor air-conditioned seating for comfort. The experience features an extensive international buffet with Thai and global cuisine, complemented by live music performances and traditional Thai dance shows, creating a vibrant and elegant atmosphere throughout the evening. The cruise operates on a fixed evening schedule (typically 8:00 PM – 10:00 PM) with check-in at Asiatique The Riverfront. Guests present their tickets at the counter, proceed to boarding, and enjoy a seamless experience from arrival to return. The journey passes major riverside landmarks such as Wat Arun, the Grand Palace, and Rama VIII Bridge, offering a scenic and memorable night in Bangkok.

globaltix_product_data.description: Go behind the scenes at the Optus Stadium in Perth on this 90 minute HALO rooftop walking tour. Perth’s largest sporting stadium offers one of the best vantage points of the city and is a must-do activity for sports fans. Join guides on a trip up to Level 5 via a staircase to the famous sails. If you prefer a ride in the lift, that can be arranged too. Elevated above the stadium, guests can enjoy a 360 degree walk around the rooftop as you discover insider knowledge about game day operations and the construction of the stadium. Access to the Western Viewing Deck is included in the HALO rooftop tour with spectacular views of Derbal Yerrigan (Swan River) and Perth City. The HALO rooftop walk is suitable for guests who are looking for an enjoyable walk in one of the world’s most beautiful and technologically advanced stadiums without the heart-racing adrenaline rush that the VERTIGO rooftop tour offers.
highlights: Enjoy breathtaking views of Perth City from the Western Viewing Deck

Safe and secure guided tour with insider knowledge

globaltix_product_data.name: The Paddington Bear Experience
globaltix_product_data.summary: The Paddington Bear Experience is a charming and imaginatively designed immersive attraction located in the heart of London's Paddington area, celebrating one of British children's literature's most beloved characters — Paddington Bear, the small brown bear from Darkest Peru who captured the hearts...
globaltix_product_data.description: The Paddington Bear Experience is a charming and imaginatively designed immersive attraction located in the heart of London's Paddington area, celebrating one of British children's literature's most beloved characters — Paddington Bear, the small brown bear from Darkest Peru who captured the hearts of generations of readers and film audiences worldwide since Michael Bond first introduced him in 1958. Opened in 2024 and situated close to Paddington Station, the attraction places guests directly inside Paddington's world through a series of beautifully crafted interactive themed environments that bring the warmth, humour, and gentle adventure of the Paddington stories to vivid physical life. It is a purpose-built experience designed equally for families with young children, lifelong Paddington fans, and anyone with an appreciation for the enduring magic of great British storytelling. The experience is structured as a guided walk-through journey through multiple immersive rooms and environments, each themed around key locations and moments from Paddington's world. Guests step into scenes inspired by the Brown family home at 32 Windsor Gardens, the bustling arrivals hall of Paddington Station, Mr Curry's garden, the Geographer's shop, and several other iconic settings drawn directly from the books and films. Each environment is richly detailed with interactive elements, theatrical lighting, sound design, and character storytelling that engage guests of all ages throughout the journey. A life-sized Paddington character presence — whether through animatronic technology, costumed character appearances, or digital integration — brings the bear himself into the experience in a way that creates genuinely memorable moments for younger visitors in particular. The experience also includes a dedicated retail area stocked with an exclusive range of Paddington merchandise, gifts, and collectibles available only at the attraction. A visit to The Paddington Bear Experience typically takes between 60 and 90 minutes, including the guided immersive journey and time in the retail area. Entry is by timed ticket only, with advance online booking strongly recommended as daily capacity is limited and sessions sell out regularly, particularly during school holidays and weekends. The experience is suitable for all ages and is fully accessible, with the intimate timed-entry format ensuring that each session feels personal and uncrowded rather than rushed. Its central Paddington location makes it easily reachable by London Underground, National Rail, and bus services, and it pairs naturally with a visit to the famous Paddington Bear statue on Platform 1 of Paddington Station — a much-loved London landmark just a short walk away.
highlights: Enjoy interactive storytelling environments designed for all ages, from young children experiencing Paddington for the first time to lifelong fans of the books.
Timed entry sessions ensure an intimate, uncrowded experience — a thoughtfully paced 60 to 90-minute journey through one of Britain's most cherished stories.
Located in the heart of London's Paddington area, just moments from the famous Paddington Bear statue on Platform 1 of Paddington Station.
Browse an exclusive retail area offering Paddington merchandise, gifts, and collectibles available only at the attraction and not sold elsewhere.
Step inside Paddington's world through multiple immersive themed rooms recreating iconic locations from the beloved books and films in rich detail.

globaltix_product_data.description: Instead of slamming your phone against the ground or punching a hole in the wall or flipping a table, you can come to the Smash Room and shatter, break, stomp, tear, yell, and embrace an animalistic release you can only find here, a therapy that doesn't involve reflection, a meditation that doesn't involve soul searching. Smash Room Dubai is the brainchild of Hiba Balfaqih and her friend, Ibrahim Abudyak. They set up the Smash Room with the purpose of being an outlet to vent frustration by smashing things, it was that simple. Set up in the back of an old tire shop in Al Quoz, the Smash Room has four rooms to choose from. Depending on how much frustration you'd like to expend, you can choose the number of items you can smash to bits. All the items that are smashed have been collected from junkyards (you can make donations to this as well). Once you have chosen the room of your choice, grab a weapon and begin smashing, it is as simple as that. Everything in the room is expendable, and you can destroy all the items to your heart's content.

globaltix_product_data.description: Experience one of Penang’s most iconic attractions at The TOP Penang, a modern indoor entertainment hub located in the heart of George Town. This multi-level attraction combines an observation deck, theme park elements, and interactive exhibits all under one roof. Guests can enjoy breathtaking city views from the Rainbow Skywalk, explore fun and educational zones, and experience a variety of family-friendly activities, making it an ideal destination for visitors of all ages. The recommended visit duration is approximately 2 to 4 hours, depending on the number of attractions included in your ticket and your pace of exploration. The experience is generally self-paced, allowing guests to explore each level and attraction at their own leisure. Actual duration may vary based on crowd levels, weekends, public holidays, or special events taking place at the venue. Upon arrival, guests can enter using a direct QR code or redeem their tickets at the designated counter, depending on the booking type. After entry, visitors can proceed through different zones, starting from indoor attractions such as interactive exhibits, Jurassic-themed experiences, and family-friendly rides, before heading up to the highlight observation deck. During the visit, guests can enjoy a variety of experiences including the Rainbow Skywalk, glass-bottom walkway, observation deck, and multiple themed attractions. The journey typically flows from indoor entertainment zones to the rooftop level, where guests can take in panoramic views of Penang’s skyline. Visitors are free to explore at their own pace, capture memorable photos, and enjoy a complete entertainment experience from start to finish.
highlights: Enjoy observation deck, skywalk, indoor theme park & interactive exhibits in one exciting multi-level attraction.
Walk the Rainbow Skywalk with glass floors and take in panoramic views from Penang’s tallest tower.
Perfect for families, couples, and groups seeking fun, photos, and unique city experiences.
Tickets may include entry to multiple zones, rides, and themed attractions depending on selected package.
Explore at your own pace with a self-guided experience suited for all travel styles.

globaltix_product_data.description: Discover one of Madrid’s most important cultural landmarks, the Thyssen-Bornemisza National Museum. Step into a world of artistic brilliance where you can admire authentic masterpieces by 19th- and 20th-century icons such as Picasso, Miró, and Dalí. The museum also offers a fascinating journey through art history, showcasing early Italian paintings and continental European works from the 16th to 18th centuries. With a rich permanent collection and captivating temporary exhibitions, the Thyssen-Bornemisza provides an unforgettable experience for art lovers seeking both classic elegance and modern creativity.
highlights: Discover one of Madrid's important cultural centers

globaltix_product_data.description: With Switzerland's incredible natural beauty – its snow capped mountains and crystal-clear lakes – it's almost unfair that it's also home to some of the best chocolate in the world. Lindt melts in your mouth and there's all you can eat on this tour. These Lindt Home of Chocolate tickets might not be golden, but it's the closest you'll get to stepping inside Willy Wonka's factory. Take a tour through the world of chocolate, from its origins to cocoa's conquering of Europe. Along the way you'll meet the Swiss chocolatiers who have made life sweet with their inventions. It's no easy feat, so come and find out how cocoa beans are transformed into one of your favourite treats.

globaltix_product_data.description: Step inside the first Gothic cathedral in the world, and the final resting place of 43 kings, 32 queens and 10 servants to the monarchy, including Marie Antoinette. The Basilica of Saint Denis is a testament to French art and architecture, with over 70 statues and monumental tombs from the Renaissance!43 kings, 32 queens and 10 servants to the monarchy were buried in the royal abbey of Saint-Denis, from King Dagobert in 639 AD, right up to royals in the 19th century. It sounds like a plot point from 'Game of Thrones', but it's just French history.Built on the grave of Saint-Denis, a Bishop of Paris who died in 250 AD, this beautiful basilica became a cathedral in 1966.See over 70 statues and monumental tombs from the Renaissance period, plus the biggest collection of funerary sculpture from the 12th to the 16th centuries, all within these walls.A must-visit for French history lovers, there's lots to impress including the crypts - which are also now home to the tomb of Marie Antoinette.

globaltix_product_data.description: Visit Australia's true "home of the birds" at **Birdworld Kuranda** in QLD's tropical north just 30 minutes' drive from Cairns and 1 hour from Port Douglas for a look at one of the most diverse collections of bird life in the world! This interactive, family oriented "bird zoo" located in one of the most popular rainforest areas of Queensland is a must-do for animal lovers visiting the region. With over 75 species of exotic birds from both Australia and abroad, each boasting an array of beautiful colours, you'll be able to enjoy both the views and having a turn at hand-feeding some of these friendly avian creatures yourself! Enjoy not just the company of the birds but the lush rainforest environment as well - take a stroll through the tropical landscape that blends trees with tumbling waterfalls and clean ponds and revel in the sounds of the birds as they frolic and play. A great day out for adults and families and kids alike, Kuranda's Birdworld is not to be missed - so buy your tickets online today!
highlights: Over 75 species of birds
Hand-feed various birds
Lush rainforest environment
Brilliant Amazonian macaws
Lorikeets, Galahs & Cockatoos
Endangered cassowaries

globaltix_product_data.description: On this land, the first aquarium was born. Rainwater falling between the Tamba Mountains and the Ashiu Primeval Forest turns into clear springs, then streams, soon converging into great rivers that ultimately flow into the sea. The interconnected ecosystem from source to ocean, along with diverse symbiotic life forms, is recreated within the aquarium. Moreover, Kyoto Aquarium is not just about exhibits—it regularly hosts hands-on learning activities like "Close Encounters" and guide sessions led by caretakers. The aquarium aims to become a comprehensive edutainment facility where Kyoto's children can connect with water and its diverse inhabitants. It also reduces energy consumption through solar power and supports breeding programs for Kyoto's rare species. As a flagship facility in an eco-model city, it is committed to nature conservation.
highlights: Experience lively dolphin performances that combine fun, learning, and amazing tricks—perfect for all age groups.
Beautiful tanks featuring jellyfish, tropical fish, and river ecosystems create a peaceful and mesmerizing environment.
Easy to explore, interactive, and weather-proof—ideal for a relaxing and enjoyable visit in Kyoto.
Get a close look at one of the world’s most unique and ancient creatures, found mainly in Japan.
Watch playful penguins in a natural-style habitat, offering great photo moments and family fun.
