Temporary closure may occur due to facility maintenance or weather conditions. Address: 35-1 Kankiji-cho, Shimogyo-ku, Kyoto 600-8835 (inside Umekoji Park) [Transportation method] Approx. 15 min walk west from the central exit of Kyoto station, or approx. 7 min walk from JR Sanin Main Line Umekoji Kyoto Nishi station. Important notes 1. Non-smoking in the venue. 2. No pets allowed in the museum. However, assistance dogs such as guide dogs are permitted. 3. Please refrain from any behavior that may cause inconvenience to other travelers. 4. Please do not use flash when taking photos. Photos and videos may only be taken for personal entertainment purposes; commercial use is prohibited. 5. Please do not bring large (or long) luggage such as scooters or suitcases for the visit to avoid causing inconvenience to other visitors. If staff determine the items are unsuitable for entry, they may approach to remind you. You may bring your own lunch box, but please eat only at the beaver, seal, or dolphin stadiums or the benches in the Sanshisuimei area. Eating and drinking are prohibited in other exhibition areas. 6. Multiple entries on the same day are not currently available. Reminder 1. Pick up a program schedule upon entry. The shows are spaced closely for visitors' convenience. Check the activity duration on the official website before planning your visit. 2. The Kyoto aquarium is not particularly large, but it is well-designed in terms of space and features unique animals such as salamanders, sea lions, seals, jellyfish, sardines, and dolphin shows. It's a great place to bring children, and the admission ticket is affordable. Combining it with a visit to the railway museum makes for a fulfilling day. 3. Opening hours may vary, please check the official website in advance.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Jump back in time in the creepy innards of the Mamertine Prison and uncover the history of this spooky space. globaltix_product_data.description: Jump back in time in the creepy innards of the Mamertine Prison and uncover the history of this spooky space. Skip the line and learn about the doings of Saint Peter and uncover the fate of shunned Roman emperors and kings, along with a special video guide accompaniment.He may have been a Saint, but Peter wasn't immune to imprisonment. Once inside Mamertine however, it's said that he made water spring from the rocks and used it to baptize other inmates, jailers and visitors! There was just no holding him back.Rather than be lowered into a cell through the ceiling like Peter and the shunned emperors and kings who also endured this gloomy place, you'll skip the line and take the stairs.Enjoy an educational video guide on the history of this fascinating part of Via dei Fori Imperiali, which is also the oldest prison in Rome!
highlights: Visit Rome's oldest prison in the evocative Via dei Fori Imperiali and walk in the footsteps of shunned emperors and kings
Learn about the miraculous actions of St. Peter, who was once a prisoner at Mamertine
Discover the fascinating history of the prison with a special audio guide

globaltix_product_data.description: Hong Kong Peak Tram is a historic funicular railway located on Hong Kong Island, offering a scenic ride up to Victoria Peak. This iconic attraction provides breathtaking views of the city skyline, Victoria Harbour, and surrounding landscapes. The steep ascent and unique visual illusion make it a must-try experience for visitors. It is one of Hong Kong’s most famous sightseeing attractions, ideal for first-time visitors and photographers. The recommended duration is approximately 1–2 hours, depending on queue times and time spent at the Peak. The experience is generally self-paced, with flexible return options if round-trip tickets are selected. Duration may vary depending on crowd levels and weather conditions. Guests can present their e-ticket or redeem tickets at the Peak Tram Lower Terminus. After boarding, enjoy a short but scenic tram ride to Victoria Peak. Upon arrival, visitors can explore attractions such as Sky Terrace 428, shopping areas, and viewing points. Guests can spend time at the Peak before returning via tram or continuing their visit independently.

globaltix_product_data.name: Time Travel Vienna: Magical Viennese History Tour
globaltix_product_data.summary: Music. Power. Glory. War. As the center of the Ottoman Empire and the former home of Freud and Mozart among others, Vienna has been through a lot. And with this time travel experience, you'll get to experience it all.In just one hour you'll feel and experience Vienna's dramatic and thrilling history...
globaltix_product_data.description: Music. Power. Glory. War. As the center of the Ottoman Empire and the former home of Freud and Mozart among others, Vienna has been through a lot. And with this time travel experience, you'll get to experience it all.In just one hour you'll feel and experience Vienna's dramatic and thrilling history. Using 5D cinema, animatronic figures, and special effects, you'll turn even the most disinterested member of your party into a history buff. This one hour experience, led by a real tour guide, is the perfect gateway to Vienna. Each trip offers fact-based insights into the city that started as the Roman camp Vindobonan and that's not all! You'll learn tons of things you never knew about The Imperial City.Also, your time travel experience takes place in an actual monastery in the center of the city. Cutting-edge technology in an ancient monastery? No wonder the rules of space and time are so flexible here.
highlights: An innovative 1,300 m² world of adventures through time, right in the center of Vienna
Humorous and informative, this hour-long tour will take you from the foundation of Vienna as a Roman camp all the way through to the modern times
A highly interactive and totally immersive experience
Time Travel Vienna uses 5D cinema, animatronic figures and special effects to whisk you to the past, and back to the present

globaltix_product_data.name: Toba Aquarium
globaltix_product_data.summary: Experience an unforgettable journey beneath the waves at Toba Aquarium, one of Japan's premier marine attractions. Showcasing an extensive collection of aquatic life from Japan and around the world, the aquarium offers visitors the opportunity to observe a remarkable diversity of marine species in c...
globaltix_product_data.description: Experience an unforgettable journey beneath the waves at Toba Aquarium, one of Japan's premier marine attractions. Showcasing an extensive collection of aquatic life from Japan and around the world, the aquarium offers visitors the opportunity to observe a remarkable diversity of marine species in carefully designed habitats. With 12 distinctive exhibition zones, each highlighting different aquatic environments, the aquarium provides an immersive and educational experience for visitors of all ages. Meet charming sea otters, marvel at the ancient nautilus, and encounter the rare dugongs and African manatees—animals often associated with the origins of mermaid folklore. Designed without a fixed visitor route, Toba Aquarium encourages guests to explore freely and discover its exhibits at their own pace. Be sure to catch the daily sea lion and walrus performances, where these charismatic animals showcase their natural abilities in fun and engaging presentations.
highlights: Home to 1,200+ species and 25,000+ animals, making it one of the richest aquariums in Japan.
The only place in Japan (and rare globally) where you can see a dugong, a gentle marine mammal linked to mermaid legends.
A major highlight—this is currently the only aquarium in Japan with sea otters, making it a must-visit for animal lovers.
Enjoy sea lion performances and feeding shows held throughout the day for an interactive experience.

globaltix_product_data.description: TeamLab Planets TOKYO is a one-of-a-kind immersive art museum where visitors walk through water, become part of digital artworks, and engage with vibrant, interactive installations. This breathtaking exhibition, created by the renowned art collective TeamLab, blends art, technology, and nature to create a surreal, multi-sensory experience.
highlights: Infinity Spaces: Enter rooms filled with mirrored surfaces and dazzling lights that create a boundless, dreamlike atmosphere.
Walk Through Water: Step into mesmerizing digital environments, including a vast water installation that responds to movement.
Floating Flower Garden: Experience a stunning installation where flowers move and surround you as you walk.
Interactive Artworks: Engage with large-scale digital projections that shift and transform based on your presence.
Sensory Immersion: The exhibits engage all five senses, making the experience truly unforgettable.
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Once the admission ticket is activated, it is for personal use only and cannot be resold or shared by multiple people at the same time You are not allowed to re-enter the venue after leaving admission ticket are only valid on the fixed-date. You will not be able to enter without a voucher. Please note that it may take 30-60 minutes to enter the venue; if there is a delay, please wait patiently Wheelchair users must use the wheelchairs provided by the exhibition hall when entering the venue; the number of wheelchairs provided on site is limited and they are standard models without special accessories Please be barefoot in some areas to experience the artwork. Please remove your shoes when entering the locker space.The water depth of the exhibits can reach the knee level of an adult. One of the exhibition areas is a mirrored space. If you wear a skirt or wide pants, there is a risk of exposure. It is recommended to wear pants when visiting the exhibition We are not responsible for any personal injury, loss or other problems caused by the facilities during the exhibition. The exhibition facilities are complex and pets such as guide dogs are not allowed to enter. Small lockers are available for free use on site. Locker size is 23cm (W) x 34cm (D) x 37cm (H). Please note that some exhibits have flashing lights or loud sound effects. Admission control: In order to disperse the crowds of visitors, teamLab Planets TOKYO will open pre-sale e-tickets for fixed-date and times (each 30 minutes is a time slot). In addition, the number of admission ticket and the number of visitors provided in each time slot will be limited to avoid overcrowding after reopening. Please wear a mask. Everyone is encouraged to follow proper cough etiquette and wash hands frequently or use alcohol disinfectant. Alcohol sprayers are available in many places in the venue. Please feel free to use them. Ventilation and air conditioning equipment in the museum is open 24 hours a day to strengthen cleaning and disinfection operations in the museum "Sunrise and Sunset" exhibition: In case of light rain, the exhibition will remain open for visitors; in case of heavy rain and strong winds such as typhoons, the exhibition may be cancelled Prohibitions & RestrictionsNo outside food or drinks allowed It is prohibited to bring dangerous items such as bottles, firecrackers, lasers, etc. that may disturb or cause inconvenience to other spectators into the venue Smoking and drinking are prohibited. The use of flash and lighting equipment is prohibited. TeamLab Planets TOKYO Admission Ticket (Youth) Booking notices Prices include taxes. You may need to wait 30–90 minutes for entry. Purchased admission tickets cannot be canceled or refunded. Visitors holding "middle school/high school student" admission tickets may be required to present their student ID and identification documents. Admission tickets are non-transferable. Tickets purchased through resale will not be valid for entry. The operator assumes no responsibility in such cases. Important Notes for Arrival About admission tickets and entry Please arrive at the venue entrance in advance and queue according to the admission time stated on your ticket. The time indicated on the ticket is not the duration of stay allowed inside the venue. When you leave the waiting queue, make sure your companions stay in line. If you're alone, please notify a nearby staff member. Please place the stroller in the designated area before entering. Children under 13 are not allowed to enter alone and must be accompanied by a guardian aged 18 or above. For safety management reasons, pregnant women are unable to experience certain artworks. · Wheelchair users are allowed to enter. However, as wheelchairs cannot access some water-based exhibits, staff will guide you through alternative routes. Visitors using wheelchairs must transfer to the museum's designated wheelchairs before entry. (Note: The quantity of designated wheelchairs is limited, and we appreciate your understanding.) Please be aware that the museum's designated wheelchairs are standard models without any additional restraints. · You may enter with a cane or prosthetic limb. Depending on your situation, some artworks may not be viewable. Before entry, staff will explain the viewing route and rules based on your situation. No re-entry after exit. Once entered, the admission ticket fee is non-refundable. About the venue · In the "Water" area, you must enter barefoot to experience the artwork. Please remove your shoes when entering the locker area. · Some artworks are located in water, so please remove your socks or stockings in the locker area beforehand. Even adults may find the water level reaching up to their knees in the artwork. · The water-based works use sodium hypochlorite, with its concentration adjusted to ensure compliance with appropriate standards. · The venue features water-based exhibits, so we recommend bringing a change of clothes for children in case they get wet. Please avoid entering the next exhibit while wet. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. If you or your child get your clothes wet, staff will guide you to change clothes. For safety reasons, you cannot proceed to the next artwork while wearing wet clothing. If you don't have spare clothes, towels are available for loan - please dry your wet clothes before entering the next artwork. Please note that the water area is for viewing purposes only and is not a swimming area. Some exhibits feature mirrored flooring. If concerned about exposure, you may borrow safety shorts or a wrap from the museum. Free safety shorts (mid-thigh length) are available for use in the facility, with sizes ranging from XS to 6L. Please ask staff if needed and return them before leaving. · Some experiences cannot be participated in while wearing sandals or high heels. Free shoe rental service is available inside the venue. There may be areas with strong lighting stimulation or dimly lit spaces. For safety reasons, customers visiting with children must hold their hands tightly while viewing the artworks. The museum provides bypass routes for visitors who wish to skip exhibits, including those with disabilities, children, and their companions. Please consult the staff members if needed. Visitors with infants can enter while wearing baby carriers. The restrooms in the facility are equipped with diaper changing stations. If you need to breastfeed or rest, you can use the first aid room. Feel free to consult nearby staff members for assistance. Even adults may find the water level in the artwork reaching up to their knees. · Sodium hypochlorite is used in water-based works, with its concentration adjusted to ensure compliance with appropriate standards. · The museum features water-based exhibits. We recommend bringing a change of clothes for children in case they get wet. Please avoid entering the next exhibit while wet. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. · If you or your child get your clothes wet, staff will guide you to change clothes. For safety reasons, you cannot proceed to the next exhibit while wearing wet clothing. If you didn't bring spare clothes, the museum provides towel rental services. Please dry your wet clothes before entering the next exhibit. Please note that the water area is an ornamental display zone and not a swimming facility. · Some exhibits feature mirrored flooring. If concerned about accidental exposure, you may borrow safety shorts or a wrap skirt from the museum. · Free-to-use safety shorts (mid-thigh length) are available in sizes ranging from XS to 6L. Please inquire with staff if needed and return them before leaving. · Some exhibits cannot be experienced while wearing sandals or high heels. Free shoe rental service is available inside the venue. · There may be areas with strong lighting stimulation or dim lighting. For safety reasons, customers visiting with children must hold their hands tightly while viewing the artworks. · The museum provides bypass routes for visitors who wish to skip exhibits, including those with disabilities, children, and their companions. Please consult the staff if needed. Visitors with infants can enter while wearing a baby carrier. · The restrooms in the museum are equipped with diaper changing tables. If you need to breastfeed or rest, you can use the first aid room. Feel free to consult nearby staff for assistance. When the museum is crowded, staff members will guide some customers who have stayed for an extended period toward the exits. About Carry-on Baggage · The passages between artworks inside the venue are dimly lit, and there are areas with unstable ground or artworks that involve entering water. Therefore, for safety and hygiene considerations, carrying personal items into the artwork areas is prohibited. If you need to carry essential items for special reasons, please consult with staff. · Free lockers are available inside the facility. You can store your carry-on luggage in the lockers after passing through the entrance gate. In case of severe weather conditions such as typhoons or heavy rain, the exhibition may be suspended. We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding. options.name: TeamLab Planets TOKYO Admission Ticket
options.description: The teamLab Planets TOKYO is an immersive digital art museum located in Tokyo, Japan, offering a one-of-a-kind sensory experience where visitors become part of the artwork. Created by the renowned art collective teamLab, this attraction blends technology, light, water, and space to create interactive installations that engage all five senses. It is a must-visit destination for art lovers and travelers seeking a futuristic and Instagram-worthy experience. Operation Hours: Daily, 08.30 - 22.00 Location : 6-1-16 Toyosu, Koto City, Tokyo
options.termsAndConditions: Entry may require a 30–90 minute wait. Tickets are non-refundable, non-cancellable, and non-transferable. Resale tickets are invalid. Student tickets may require valid student ID. No re-entry after exit. Please arrive early and queue according to your ticket admission time (admission time is not a time limit). Children under 13 must be accompanied by an adult aged 18 or above. Pregnant visitors may be unable to experience certain artworks. Wheelchair users are welcome; some water exhibits are inaccessible and designated wheelchairs must be used (limited availability). Some exhibits include strong lighting, dark spaces, mirrored floors, and water up to knee level. Water areas require barefoot entry; shoes and socks must be removed. Clothing may get wet; bringing a change of clothes is recommended. Wet clothing is not permitted in subsequent exhibits. Free safety shorts and shoe rentals are available on-site. Personal belongings are not allowed inside exhibit areas. Free lockers are available (23 × 34 × 37 cm). Oversized luggage will be stored in the stroller parking area. Baby carriers are allowed; diaper-changing stations and a first aid room are available. Staff may guide visitors to exit during peak crowd conditions. Photography and interviews may occur inside the venue. Some artworks may be unavailable due to operational or weather conditions. The operator is not responsible for injury, loss, or theft. Visitors asked to leave for rule violations are not eligible for refunds. Prohibited: intoxicated or disruptive behavior, eating or smoking inside the venue, dangerous items, commercial photography without approval, and animals including assistance dogs.

globaltix_product_data.description: Odaiba is a large artificial island in Tokyo Bay connected to central Tokyo via the Rainbow Bridge. It has become increasingly popular as an entertainment and leisure area. Odaiba has something of a precious commodity in its public access to the waterfront. In most other locations, industry and harbor facilities block people from accessing the sea. Restaurants, shopping, and entertainment options abound, making Odaiba a popular tourist destination. Be sure to look for the Replica State of Liberty with the Rainbow Bridge set behind. It’s a great backdrop for photos.

globaltix_product_data.description: The Tokyo Tower Observatory offers visitors an iconic experience with stunning panoramic views of Japan’s capital. Standing at 333 meters, Tokyo Tower is a symbol of the city’s modern skyline. Visitors can explore the two observation decks: the Main Deck at 150 meters and the Top Deck at 250 meters. Both provide incredible views of landmarks like Mount Fuji on clear days and the bustling city below. For an extra thrill, the "Lookdown Window" offers a glass floor view directly beneath your feet. In the evenings, the tower lights up with vibrant illuminations, making it a must-visit both day and night. With a café, souvenir shops, and interactive displays about the tower's history, it's the perfect spot for tourists and locals alike.
highlights: Enjoy breathtaking 360-degree views of Tokyo from the Main Deck (150m) and Top Deck (250m).
Walk on the "Lookdown Window" for a thrilling view straight down the tower.
Witness the beauty of Tokyo's skyline lit up at night with special lighting effects.
Relax at the tower’s café and shop for exclusive Tokyo Tower merchandise.
Learn about the tower's history and significance through interactive displays and exhibits.

options.termsAndConditions: Admission tickets are non-transferable. Tickets purchased through resale will not grant entry. The operator assumes no responsibility in such cases. This admission ticket is only valid for teamLab Planets in Toyosu and cannot be used for other teamLab exhibitions. To redeem the admission ticket, you need to provide the QR code generated after completing the reservation. Please bring a device that can display the QR code or print it out. *If you cannot present the QR code, the redemption voucher will not be applicable. On-site notices About Admission Tickets and Entry · Please arrive at the venue entrance in advance according to the entry time specified on your ticket and queue up. If you do not hold a valid ticket for that day, you will not be allowed to enter. · The time indicated on the ticket is not the duration you can stay inside the venue. · When you leave the waiting queue, make sure your companions stay in line. If you're alone, please notify a nearby staff member. Please place the stroller in the designated area before entering. Children under 13 years old are not allowed to enter alone and must be accompanied by a guardian aged 18 or above. For safety management reasons, pregnant women are unable to experience certain artworks. · Wheelchair users are allowed to enter. However, as some water-based artworks are not wheelchair accessible, staff will guide you through alternative routes in those areas. Visitors using wheelchairs must transfer to the museum's designated wheelchairs before entry. (※Please note that the quantity of designated wheelchairs is limited.) The museum's wheelchairs are standard models without any additional restraints. · You may enter with a cane or prosthetic limb. Depending on your condition, some artworks may not be viewable. Before entry, staff will explain the viewing route and rules based on your specific situation. Re-entry after exiting is not permitted. Once admitted, the admission ticket fee is non-refundable. About the Venue · In the "Water" area, visitors must enter barefoot to experience the artwork. Please remove your shoes when entering the locker area. · Some exhibits are located in water, so please remove your socks or stockings in the locker area beforehand. · Even adults may find the water depth in the artwork reaching up to their knees. · Sodium hypochlorite is used in water-based works, with its concentration adjusted to ensure compliance with appropriate standards. · There are water-based exhibits in the venue, so we recommend bringing a change of clothes for children in case they get wet. Please avoid entering the next exhibit while wet. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. · If you or your child get your clothes wet, staff will guide you to change clothes. For safety reasons, you cannot proceed to the next artwork while wearing wet clothing. If you did not bring spare clothes, the museum provides towel rental services. Please dry your wet clothes before entering the next exhibit. Please note that the water area is an ornamental display zone and not a swimming facility. · Some installations feature mirrored floors. If concerned about accidental exposure, you may borrow safety shorts or a wrap skirt from the venue. · Free-to-use safety shorts (mid-thigh length) are available in sizes ranging from XS to 6L. Please inquire with staff if needed and return them before leaving. · Some exhibits cannot be experienced while wearing sandals or high heels. Free shoe rental service is available inside the venue. · There may be areas with strong lighting stimuli or dim lighting. For the safety of children, please hold their hands tightly while viewing the artworks. · The museum provides bypass routes for visitors who wish to skip certain exhibits, including individuals with disabilities, children, and their accompanying companions. Please consult the museum staff if needed. Visitors with infants can enter while wearing a baby carrier. · The restrooms in the museum are equipped with diaper changing tables. If you need to breastfeed or rest, you can use the first aid room. Feel free to consult nearby staff for assistance. When the museum is crowded, staff members will guide some customers who have stayed for an extended period toward the exit. About Carry-on Baggage · The passages between artworks inside the venue are dim, and there are areas with unstable ground or artworks that involve entering water. Therefore, for safety and hygiene reasons, personal belongings are prohibited in the artwork areas. If you need to bring essential items for special reasons, please consult with staff. · Free lockers are available inside the facility. After passing through the entrance gate, you can store your carry-on luggage in the lockers. Locker dimensions: 23cm (W) x 34cm (D) x 37cm (H) · As there is no additional storage area in the facility, personal belongings exceeding the above locker dimensions cannot be stored. Luggage exceeding the above locker dimensions will be stored and locked in the stroller parking area. Please be advised in advance. About "Microcosmic Moss Garden - The Frozen Colors of Light, Dusk to Dawn" Visits can proceed as usual during light rain. However, in case of severe weather conditions such as typhoons or heavy rain, the exhibition may be suspended. We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding. Other · This facility shall not be held responsible for any injuries, losses, damages, or other disputes arising from the use of the facility. ※For other facility information or precautions, please check the official website at https://planets.teamlab.art/tokyo/#notice. · The operator shall not be held responsible for any loss or theft of valuables. Your understanding is appreciated. Please understand that there may be temporary interviews and photography inside the venue. If you do not wish to be photographed, please inform the staff. · Some works may be unavailable for viewing due to unforeseen circumstances. We appreciate your understanding. Please note if you fall under any of the following circumstances: · Individuals who have experienced muscle spasms or loss of consciousness due to light stimulation · Not suitable for those with severe fear of enclosed spaces, darkness, or heights · People with palpitations and shortness of breath. Pregnant women or those who may be pregnant. · For those holding infants. · Others who are concerned about their own physical health or condition. Prohibited items · Entry for intoxicated or unruly individuals · Eating and smoking inside the facility · Dangerous items or items deemed unsuitable for entry by the operator Re-entry after exiting · Photography or interviews for commercial purposes without prior consent · Bringing any animals, including assistance dogs ※In addition to the above, admission ticket fees cannot be refunded for visitors who are asked to leave by the operator's judgment. We appreciate your understanding. About the coin-operated lockers at Tokyo Tower: There are coin-operated lockers (for a fee) on the 1st floor of Foot Town. Service hours: 9:00–23:00 (One-day service only) Present your e-ticket for direct verification and access. (Choose one) Location of use1 6-1-16 Toyosu, Koto-ku, Tokyo Ticket gate Time of use 09:00~20:30 Location of use2 4-2-8 Shibakoen, Minato City, Tokyo Time of use 09:00~23:00 Operating hours may vary, please check the official websites in advance: Tokyo Tower: https://www.tokyotower.co.jp/fee/; teamLab Planets TOKYO DMM: https://www.teamlab.art/jp/e/planets/

options.termsAndConditions: Admission tickets are non-transferable. Tickets purchased through resale will not grant entry. The operator assumes no responsibility in such cases. This admission ticket is only valid for teamLab Planets in Toyosu and cannot be used for other teamLab exhibitions. To redeem the admission ticket, you need to provide the QR code generated after completing the reservation. Please bring a device that can display the QR code or print it out. *If you cannot present the QR code, the redemption voucher will not be applicable. On-site notices About Admission Tickets and Entry · Please arrive at the venue entrance in advance according to the entry time specified on your ticket and queue up. If you do not hold a valid ticket for that day, you will not be allowed to enter. · The time indicated on the ticket is not the duration you can stay inside the venue. · When you leave the waiting queue, make sure your companions stay in line. If you're alone, please notify a nearby staff member. Please place the stroller in the designated area before entering. Children under 13 years old are not allowed to enter alone and must be accompanied by a guardian aged 18 or above. For safety management reasons, pregnant women are unable to experience certain artworks. · Wheelchair users are allowed to enter. However, as some water-based artworks are not wheelchair accessible, staff will guide you through alternative routes in those areas. Visitors using wheelchairs must transfer to the museum's designated wheelchairs before entry. (※Please note that the quantity of designated wheelchairs is limited.) The museum's wheelchairs are standard models without any additional restraints. · You may enter with a cane or prosthetic limb. Depending on your condition, some artworks may not be viewable. Before entry, staff will explain the viewing route and rules based on your specific situation. Re-entry after exiting is not permitted. Once admitted, the admission ticket fee is non-refundable. About the Venue · In the "Water" area, visitors must enter barefoot to experience the artwork. Please remove your shoes when entering the locker area. · Some exhibits are located in water, so please remove your socks or stockings in the locker area beforehand. · Even adults may find the water depth in the artwork reaching up to their knees. · Sodium hypochlorite is used in water-based works, with its concentration adjusted to ensure compliance with appropriate standards. · There are water-based exhibits in the venue, so we recommend bringing a change of clothes for children in case they get wet. Please avoid entering the next exhibit while wet. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. · If you or your child get your clothes wet, staff will guide you to change clothes. For safety reasons, you cannot proceed to the next artwork while wearing wet clothing. If you did not bring spare clothes, the museum provides towel rental services. Please dry your wet clothes before entering the next exhibit. Please note that the water area is an ornamental display zone and not a swimming facility. · Some installations feature mirrored floors. If concerned about accidental exposure, you may borrow safety shorts or a wrap skirt from the venue. · Free-to-use safety shorts (mid-thigh length) are available in sizes ranging from XS to 6L. Please inquire with staff if needed and return them before leaving. · Some exhibits cannot be experienced while wearing sandals or high heels. Free shoe rental service is available inside the venue. · There may be areas with strong lighting stimuli or dim lighting. For the safety of children, please hold their hands tightly while viewing the artworks. · The museum provides bypass routes for visitors who wish to skip certain exhibits, including individuals with disabilities, children, and their accompanying companions. Please consult the museum staff if needed. Visitors with infants can enter while wearing a baby carrier. · The restrooms in the museum are equipped with diaper changing tables. If you need to breastfeed or rest, you can use the first aid room. Feel free to consult nearby staff for assistance. When the museum is crowded, staff members will guide some customers who have stayed for an extended period toward the exit. About Carry-on Baggage · The passages between artworks inside the venue are dim, and there are areas with unstable ground or artworks that involve entering water. Therefore, for safety and hygiene reasons, personal belongings are prohibited in the artwork areas. If you need to bring essential items for special reasons, please consult with staff. · Free lockers are available inside the facility. After passing through the entrance gate, you can store your carry-on luggage in the lockers. Locker dimensions: 23cm (W) x 34cm (D) x 37cm (H) · As there is no additional storage area in the facility, personal belongings exceeding the above locker dimensions cannot be stored. Luggage exceeding the above locker dimensions will be stored and locked in the stroller parking area. Please be advised in advance. About "Microcosmic Moss Garden - The Frozen Colors of Light, Dusk to Dawn" Visits can proceed as usual during light rain. However, in case of severe weather conditions such as typhoons or heavy rain, the exhibition may be suspended. We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding. Other · This facility shall not be held responsible for any injuries, losses, damages, or other disputes arising from the use of the facility. ※For other facility information or precautions, please check the official website at https://planets.teamlab.art/tokyo/#notice. · The operator shall not be held responsible for any loss or theft of valuables. Your understanding is appreciated. Please understand that there may be temporary interviews and photography inside the venue. If you do not wish to be photographed, please inform the staff. · Some works may be unavailable for viewing due to unforeseen circumstances. We appreciate your understanding. Please note if you fall under any of the following circumstances: · Individuals who have experienced muscle spasms or loss of consciousness due to light stimulation · Not suitable for those with severe fear of enclosed spaces, darkness, or heights · People with palpitations and shortness of breath. Pregnant women or those who may be pregnant. · For those holding infants. · Others who are concerned about their own physical health or condition. Prohibited items · Entry for intoxicated or unruly individuals · Eating and smoking inside the facility · Dangerous items or items deemed unsuitable for entry by the operator Re-entry after exiting · Photography or interviews for commercial purposes without prior consent · Bringing any animals, including assistance dogs ※In addition to the above, admission ticket fees cannot be refunded for visitors who are asked to leave by the operator's judgment. We appreciate your understanding. About the coin-operated lockers at Tokyo Tower: There are coin-operated lockers (for a fee) on the 1st floor of Foot Town. To redeem the admission ticket, you need to provide the QR code generated after completing the reservation. Please bring a device that can display the QR code or print it out. *If you cannot present the QR code, the redemption voucher will not be applicable. On-site notices About Admission Tickets and Entry · Please arrive at the venue entrance in advance according to the entry time specified on your ticket and queue up. If you do not hold a valid ticket for that day, you will not be allowed to enter. · The time indicated on the ticket is not the duration you can stay inside the venue. · When you leave the waiting queue, make sure your companions stay in line. If you're alone, please notify a nearby staff member. Please place the stroller in the designated area before entering. Children under 13 years old are not allowed to enter alone and must be accompanied by a guardian aged 18 or above. For safety management reasons, pregnant women are unable to experience certain artworks. · Wheelchair users are allowed to enter. However, as some water-based artworks are not wheelchair accessible, staff will guide you through alternative routes in those areas. Visitors using wheelchairs must transfer to the museum's designated wheelchairs before entry. (※Please note that the quantity of designated wheelchairs is limited.) The museum's wheelchairs are standard models without any additional restraints. · You may enter with a cane or prosthetic limb. Depending on your condition, some artworks may not be viewable. Before entry, staff will explain the viewing route and rules based on your specific situation. Re-entry after exiting is not permitted. Once admitted, the admission ticket fee is non-refundable. About the Venue · In the "Water" area, visitors must enter barefoot to experience the artwork. Please remove your shoes when entering the locker area. · Some exhibits are located in water, so please remove your socks or stockings in the locker area beforehand. · Even adults may find the water depth in the artwork reaching up to their knees. · Sodium hypochlorite is used in water-based works, with its concentration adjusted to ensure compliance with appropriate standards. · There are water-based exhibits in the venue, so we recommend bringing a change of clothes for children in case they get wet. Please avoid entering the next exhibit while wet. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. · If you or your child get your clothes wet, staff will guide you to change clothes. For safety reasons, you cannot proceed to the next artwork while wearing wet clothing. If you did not bring spare clothes, the museum provides towel rental services. Please dry your wet clothes before entering the next exhibit. Please note that the water area is an ornamental display zone and not a swimming facility. · Some installations feature mirrored floors. If concerned about accidental exposure, you may borrow safety shorts or a wrap skirt from the venue. · Free-to-use safety shorts (mid-thigh length) are available in sizes ranging from XS to 6L. Please inquire with staff if needed and return them before leaving. · Some exhibits cannot be experienced while wearing sandals or high heels. Free shoe rental service is available inside the venue. · There may be areas with strong lighting stimuli or dim lighting. For the safety of children, please hold their hands tightly while viewing the artworks. · The museum provides bypass routes for visitors who wish to skip certain exhibits, including individuals with disabilities, children, and their accompanying companions. Please consult the museum staff if needed. Visitors with infants can enter while wearing a baby carrier. · The restrooms in the museum are equipped with diaper changing tables. If you need to breastfeed or rest, you can use the first aid room. Feel free to consult nearby staff for assistance. When the museum is crowded, staff members will guide some customers who have stayed for an extended period toward the exit. About Carry-on Baggage · The passages between artworks inside the venue are dim, and there are areas with unstable ground or artworks that involve entering water. Therefore, for safety and hygiene reasons, personal belongings are prohibited in the artwork areas. If you need to bring essential items for special reasons, please consult with staff. · Free lockers are available inside the facility. After passing through the entrance gate, you can store your carry-on luggage in the lockers. Locker dimensions: 23cm (W) x 34cm (D) x 37cm (H) · As there is no additional storage area in the facility, personal belongings exceeding the above locker dimensions cannot be stored. Luggage exceeding the above locker dimensions will be stored and locked in the stroller parking area. Please be advised in advance. About "Microcosmic Moss Garden - The Frozen Colors of Light, Dusk to Dawn" Visits can proceed as usual during light rain. However, in case of severe weather conditions such as typhoons or heavy rain, the exhibition may be suspended. We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding. Your understanding is appreciated. Please understand that there may be temporary interviews and photography inside the venue. If you do not wish to be photographed, please inform the staff. · Some works may be unavailable for viewing due to unforeseen circumstances. We appreciate your understanding. Please note if you fall under any of the following circumstances: · Individuals who have experienced muscle spasms or loss of consciousness due to light stimulation · Not suitable for those with severe fear of enclosed spaces, darkness, or heights · People with palpitations and shortness of breath. Pregnant women or those who may be pregnant. · For those holding infants. · Others who are concerned about their own physical health or condition. globaltix_product_data.summary: Experience the best of Paris in just one, two or three days with this hop-on hop-off tour! The 100% clean buses provide a comfortable and convenient way to see the city's top landmarks and attractions, including the Louvre Museum, Notre-Dame Cathedral, Champs-Elysées, Arc de Triomphe, Eiffel Tower,...
globaltix_product_data.description: Experience the best of Paris in just one, two or three days with this hop-on hop-off tour! The 100% clean buses provide a comfortable and convenient way to see the city's top landmarks and attractions, including the Louvre Museum, Notre-Dame Cathedral, Champs-Elysées, Arc de Triomphe, Eiffel Tower, and more. As you tour the city, you can use the audio guide commentary to learn more about Paris and hop off at any stop to explore the sights in more detail. Visit the Louvre Museum, admire the Notre Dame Cathedral, do some shopping in the Champs-Elysées, visit the top of the Arc de Triomphe or the Eiffel Tower and enjoy amazing views of the city. Take a walk in the Latin Quarter, Marais, or Ile de Saint Louis and learn more about Paris through the audio guide commentary. A child-friendly channel is available for the little ones in English and French.Your ticket is valid for 24, 48, or 72 hours upon first validation, and you can hop on and off the bus as many times as you like within the validity period. Cruise is in option so please select the dedicated option to enjoy the cruise.The Seine River cruise is operated by Vedettes de Paris. globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: The Top of the Rock is open 7 days a week, 365 days a year, regardless of weather conditions. In the case of inclement weather, portions of the deck may be closed for safety reasons. You will be advised about weather conditions and visibility prior to entry Tickets won't be refunded on the same day in the case of inclement weather. However, speak with staff on-site on the date of your visit and your ticket can be reissued for a future time and date The last elevator to the top goes up 1 hour before closing time (Beam Combo + VIP Option Only) Guests must be 52 inches (~132 cm) or taller to ride alone on The Beam Experience. globaltix_product_data.description: The Topkapi Palace Fast-Track Skip-the-Line Access & Audio Guide is a cultural attraction experience located in Istanbul, Turkey, offering priority entry to one of the most significant landmarks of the Ottoman Empire. This self-guided visit allows guests to explore the historic palace complex—once home to Ottoman sultans for over 400 years—while learning through a detailed multilingual audio guide. Inside the palace, visitors can discover expansive courtyards, imperial halls, royal chambers, and world-renowned collections such as the treasury, kitchens, and religious relics. Highlights include the Harem section, intricate tilework, and panoramic views over the Bosphorus, all enhanced by immersive storytelling via the audio guide. The experience typically lasts around 2–4 hours or longer depending on exploration pace and follows a fixed timeslot entry system. Guests meet a host at a designated point for escorted entry, skip ticket lines (security checks still apply), and then explore the palace independently at their own pace using the audio guide app on their smartphone.

globaltix_product_data.description: Visit the Tower Bridge; an iconic landmark that sits by the Thames, known for its immaculate architecture and history. The new installment of the glass walkway of the Tower Bridge is bound to amaze you with its panoramic views of the British capital. Nicknamed “The Most Famous Bridge in the World”, the Tower Bridge was built in 1894 and is a marvel of Victorian Engineering. The bridge crosses the River Thames close to the Tower of London and has become an iconic symbol of London. High-level walkways were built to allow people to cross the Thames and today, these Walkways act as viewing galleries, giving visitors the most spectacular views of the London skyline. You will get to view the Docklands, the GLA building, the Tower of London, St Paul’s, Big Ben and the London Eye in the distance. Therefore, giving you the perfect photo op! The Tower Bridge exhibition uses immersive multimedia such as films, photos, and interactive displays to explain why and how Tower Bridge was built. This experience not only guarantees great memories but greats insights. Getting There By Bus: The nearest bus stop is Tower Of London (Stop TH) which is 5 minutes from Tower Bridge. By Subway: Get down at Tower Hill station. Tower Bride is 15 minutes walk from the station.
highlights: Learn about the history of the bridge and gather information about the architectural prowess of the Victorian era.
View the Docklands, the GLA building, the Tower of London, St Paul’s, and the London Eye in the distance.
Go across the glass high-level walkway to admire spectacular views of the bustling capital of England.
Learn why and how the bridge was built at the Tower Bridge Exhibition.
Visit the Victorian Engine Rooms and marvel at the original steam engines that were used to operate the bascules of the bridge.

globaltix_product_data.name: Hanoi Market Tour and Vietnamese Traditional Dish Cooking Class
globaltix_product_data.summary: OVERVIEW Embrace Vietnamese culture with a culinary class at the Old Quarter This hands-on experience starts with a trip to the local market to buy fresh ingredients and then heading to the kitchen where you will make four classic Vietnamese dishes (fried spring rolls, papaya salad, pho rolls, mixed...
globaltix_product_data.description: OVERVIEW Embrace Vietnamese culture with a culinary class at the Old Quarter This hands-on experience starts with a trip to the local market to buy fresh ingredients and then heading to the kitchen where you will make four classic Vietnamese dishes (fried spring rolls, papaya salad, pho rolls, mixed pho) and Vietnamese specialty - egg coffee. After the class, you can enjoy lunch with all the delicious dishes you’ve just made. DETAILED ITINERARY 08:30 - 09:00 AM: Start with a welcome at our office at No. 47 Hang Bong Street and then head to Yen Thai market, a local market nearby where you can get a glimpse of local life, buy fresh food and have a better understanding of Vietnamese ingredients plus their substitutes. On the way to the market, you will pass by and get a brief introduction to Yen Thai Communal House, a National Historical and Cultural Relic of Vietnam. 09:00 - 11:30 AM: After visiting the market, head to the kitchen for the cooking class. Your cooking instructor will show you how to make four classic Vietnamese dishes (fried spring rolls, papaya salad, pho rolls, mixed pho) and Vietnamese specialty egg coffee. Our instructor will guide you step by step to make fried spring rolls first. This can be considered our ‘national’ dish for holidays and gathering feasts. It will require the flexibility of your hands to make even and lovely rolls. Then move to papaya salad with the main flavors of sour and sweet. This type of salad will help to neutralize and take back your appetite after a fried dish. Pho rolls and mixed pho are variants of our traditional rice noodles - Pho. These are locals’ favorites especially on summer days. For Pho rolls, we will learn how to skillfully separate and take out one uncut Pho sheet and also prepare ingredients to put inside and make delicious white and round rolls. As for mixed Pho, let’s roll your sleeves and blanch Pho noodles, it will require hot water to make them soft and warm. Let’s get to know what is also needed to make delicious mixed Pho. Get to know more about Vietnamese cooking as well as the story behind each traditional dish. Finally, coming to the dessert, we will have two different options as below: Option 1: Let’s make Hanoi’s signature drink - egg coffee. Prepare to taste the frothy egg cream with traditional Vietnamese brewed coffee. Feel free to get creative and decorate your own coffee cup using cocoa sauce. Option 2: We will make a lotus seed and green bean sweet soup which is characterized by their fragrant and sweet flavors, often showcasing Vietnamese lotus seeds, beans, and other natural ingredients. This type of nourishing dessert can cool you down on a hot summer day and also warm you up in a cold winter. 11:30 AM - 12:30 PM: Enjoy lunch with all the dishes made by you. Let’s take some photos together to save the moments and your ‘masterpieces’. Don’t forget that you will also be awarded with our Certificate!!
highlights: Learn how to make authentic local dishes such as fried spring rolls.
We also make Hanoi's signature drink - egg coffee or another option for your choice is Vietnamese lotus seed
Experience the buzz of a local market
Green beans sweet soup which offers a delightful and authentic way to experience the diverse flavors

globaltix_product_data.name: Turbopass Athens
globaltix_product_data.summary: The Turbopass Athens City Pass is a convenient all-in-one digital sightseeing pass designed for visitors exploring Athens, Greece. It provides access to the city’s most iconic historical landmarks, museums, and guided experiences, making it an efficient way to discover Athens’ rich ancient heritage...
globaltix_product_data.description: The Turbopass Athens City Pass is a convenient all-in-one digital sightseeing pass designed for visitors exploring Athens, Greece. It provides access to the city’s most iconic historical landmarks, museums, and guided experiences, making it an efficient way to discover Athens’ rich ancient heritage and vibrant culture without purchasing multiple tickets. With the pass, guests can visit top attractions such as the Acropolis, Acropolis Museum, and other archaeological sites, along with additional experiences like hop-on hop-off bus tours and guided city walks. Depending on the selected package, the pass may also include optional add-ons such as airport transfers or day trips, offering a seamless and flexible travel experience. The pass is available for 1 to 5 consecutive days and is fully self-paced. After purchase, guests receive a digital QR code via email, which activates upon first use. Visitors can present the pass at participating attractions, while major sites may require pre-booked time slots to manage visitor flow.
highlights: Access Athens’ top landmarks including the Acropolis, museums, and archaeological sites with one digital pass
Perfect for couples, families, and solo travelers exploring Athens efficiently and flexibly.
Enjoy additional experiences such as hop-on hop-off bus tours and guided city tours.
Ideal for history lovers, first-time visitors, and travelers seeking a convenient sightseeing solution.
Includes digital pass, attraction entry, guided tours, and optional transport or add-on experiences.

options.name: Athens City Pass with One Day Cruise & Public Transport - 6 Day
options.description: Make the most of Athens with the all-inclusive Athens City Pass. This fully packed ticket unlocks access to over 15 top attractions of your choice. Marvel at the soaring heights of the Acropolis and discover the fascinating exhibits of the New Acropolis Museum. The Athens City Pass also includes a complimentary 48-hour hop-on hop-off bus tour, giving you the freedom to explore the city’s most iconic sights at your own pace — including the Athens City Sightseeing Audio Tour for an even richer experience. To complete your Athens adventure, we highly recommend booking the One Day Cruise — including hotel transfer and a lunch buffet — to the stunning islands of Hydra, Poros, and Aegina. You also have the option to book a public transportation ticket to move easily around the city by metro, bus, or tram.

Please check your final confirmed entry time on your digital City Pass. The Athens City Pass also includes a complimentary 48-hour hop-on hop-off bus tour, giving you the freedom to explore the city’s most iconic sights at your own pace — including the Athens City Sightseeing Audio Tour for an even richer experience. To complete your Athens adventure, we highly recommend booking the One Day Cruise — including hotel transfer and a lunch buffet — to the stunning islands of Hydra, Poros, and Aegina. You also have the option to book a public transportation ticket to move easily around the city by metro, bus, or tram.
options.termsAndConditions: Opening times are subject to change depending on the season. Check the official attraction website for the most up-to-date information. Check your email inbox for the link to your digital pass sent by Turbopass. Click the link in the email and familiarize yourself with your digital City Pass. Acropolis & Parthenon entry: your visit will be pre-booked for the first day of your digital City Pass, with a time slot between 08:00 AM and 02:00 PM, depending on availability. Please check your final confirmed entry time on your digital City Pass. globaltix_product_data.summary: The Florence City Pass (Turbopass) is a comprehensive sightseeing pass designed for visitors exploring Florence, Italy, offering convenient access to the city’s top attractions, guided tours, and experiences in one digital ticket. This all-in-one pass simplifies travel planning by bundling major hig...
globaltix_product_data.description: The Florence City Pass (Turbopass) is a comprehensive sightseeing pass designed for visitors exploring Florence, Italy, offering convenient access to the city’s top attractions, guided tours, and experiences in one digital ticket. This all-in-one pass simplifies travel planning by bundling major highlights such as the Uffizi Gallery, Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore, and Ponte Vecchio, making it ideal for first-time visitors who want a structured and efficient way to explore the city. With the pass, guests can access multiple attractions and experiences, including museums, sightseeing tours, guided walking tours, and cultural sites. It also includes hop-on hop-off sightseeing bus tours, guided experiences, and optional activities at selected attractions. This ensures a smoother experience, especially during peak travel seasons when tickets and reservations may sell out in advance. The pass is available for 1 to 7 consecutive days and is fully self-paced. After purchase, guests receive a digital pass via email, which activates upon first use. Visitors simply present the QR code at each attraction for entry, while certain major sites may require pre-assigned time slots. The experience allows flexible exploration while reducing the need to purchase individual tickets.

globaltix_product_data.description: The Paris Museum Pass is a convenient digital sightseeing pass designed for visitors exploring Paris, France. Offered by Turbopass, this culture-focused pass provides free admission to more than 50 museums and monuments in and around Paris, covering the city and the wider Île-de-France region. It's an ideal solution for travelers looking to experience Paris's world-class museums and landmarks efficiently, without the hassle of purchasing individual tickets at every site. With the pass, guests can enjoy entry to a wide range of cultural attractions, including the Musée du Louvre and the Musée d'Orsay with priority admission, the Palace of Versailles, and the Centre Pompidou, along with landmarks such as the Arc de Triomphe, Sainte-Chapelle, the Panthéon, the Musée Rodin, and the Army Museum at Les Invalides. The pass also grants priority access at many included museums and monuments, helping guests save time at the city's most visited sites and making it a well-rounded option for art, history, and architecture enthusiasts alike. The pass is available for 2, 4, or 6 days, with the daily rate decreasing the longer the duration selected, and guests booking a three-day City Pass receive a Museum Pass valid for four days, while five-day bookings receive six. The pass is fully self-paced with no fixed itinerary. After purchase, guests receive a digital ticket via email, which is activated upon first use. Visitors simply present the pass at participating museums and monuments, while certain sites may require advance booking or time slot reservations.

globaltix_product_data.description: The Venice City Pass (Turbopass) is an all-in-one digital sightseeing pass designed for visitors exploring Venice, Italy. It provides convenient access to the city’s top attractions, museums, and guided experiences in a single ticket, helping travelers save both time and money while discovering the iconic lagoon city. The pass typically includes highlights such as St. Mark’s Basilica, Doge’s Palace, and several museums, making it ideal for first-time visitors. With the pass, guests can access 30+ attractions and experiences, including cultural landmarks, churches, and museums, as well as unique activities like gondola rides and island tours to Murano, Burano, and Torcello. Some packages also offer skip-the-line entry and optional upgrades such as public transport (vaporetto), providing a seamless way to explore Venice without purchasing individual tickets. The pass is available for 1 to 7 consecutive days and is fully self-paced. After purchase, guests receive a digital pass via email, which is activated upon first use. Free admission: On the first Sunday of each month, April 25 (Liberation Day), June 2 (Republic Day), and November 4 (National Unity and Armed Forces Day), all visitors can enter for free without purchasing tickets. 3. Attraction closing days: Every Monday, Jan 1, and Dec 25 4. No storage room available on site, pets are prohibited 5. Concession tickets: Only available to EU citizens aged 18 to 25, who must present a passport or ID card. Non-EU citizens, including those from Switzerland, Norway, Liechtenstein, Uruguay, as well as individuals with permits issued for reasons listed on the Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs website, are eligible to purchase discounted tickets. 6. Free admission: Free admission (collect free tickets at the ticket office, proof of eligibility required when claiming tickets) for children under 18 of any nationality (passport or ID card must be presented). Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult; visitors with disabilities are entitled to free priority admission only with valid disability certification (D.M. 507/97 and D.M. 13/2019). Disability proof must be issued by a public institution; scholars, university students, and teachers; student groups and teachers; guides and interpreters; journalists (registered members of the Italian Journalists Association only). Journalists must present a valid press card in Italian or English for the current year (e.g., press pass); employees of the Italian Ministry of Culture; members of the Carabinieri Command for the Protection of Cultural Heritage; International Council of Museums (ICOM) members. 7. The Uffizi Gallery provides accessibility information: There is a ramp (Via della Ninna) inside the museum, and an elevator is available at the end of the visiting route, but some exhibits/galleries may be temporarily closed. globaltix_product_data.description: Say hello to the lovely penguins and multicolored tropical fish at a water world wonderland in Langkawi, one of the biggest aquariums in Southeast Asia. With more than 5,000 species of animals, including fish, birds, and mammals, the aquarium won't leave you with a moment of boredom! Comfortably stroll through the Marine Life Area, Rainforest Area, and Sub-Antarctic Area. These three zones make up the main areas of Underwater World, and each of them features different exciting animals. UWL Operation Hours for Chinese New Year Celebration Date : 17 - 18 February 2026 Operation Hours: 9.30 am - 9.30 pm
highlights: Underwater World Langkawi continues to captivate visitors with its unique blend of knowledge, education, and entertainment.
The Penguinarium: Located in the Sub-Antarctic section, the Penguinarium steals the show.
It stands as the leading facility in Malaysia for breeding jumpy Rockhopper penguins in captivity.
Marmosets in the Rainforest Section: The rainforest area hosts the world’s smallest species of monkeys, the marmosets.
Underwater World Langkawi is not just an aquarium; it’s an immersive experience where adventure meets education.

options.description: Discover an exciting underwater adventure at Underwater World Langkawi, one of the largest aquariums in Southeast Asia. Home to more than 5,000 animals, including a wide variety of fish, birds, and mammals, this attraction offers an engaging and educational experience for visitors of all ages. Get up close with adorable penguins and vibrant tropical fish while exploring the aquarium’s three main zones: the Marine Life Area, Rainforest Area, and Sub-Antarctic Area. Each zone showcases unique habitats and fascinating animals, making Underwater World Langkawi a must-visit destination for nature and wildlife lovers. Easy to find, very well signposted around Pantai Cenang area. By Motorcycle/Scooter (most popular): If you rented a bike, just ride to Pantai Cenang — it's the main tourist street, hard to miss. Parking is easy and free nearby. By Bus: Hop-On Hop-Off Langkawi bus serves Pantai Cenang — check their schedule as it's the easiest public option on the island.

globaltix_product_data.description: This is a real working film studio with a theme park built on top of it, and the Studio Tour remains the thing that sets it apart. A tram carries you through active backlots — crashed airliners, flooded streets, the facades of a hundred films you half-recognise — before plunging into King Kong and Fast & Furious sequences on giant screens. Beyond the tour, the park divides across two levels. Above sit The Wizarding World of Harry Potter, with Hogwarts castle rising over Hogsmeade, and Super Nintendo World, where a wearable band lets you punch blocks and collect coins across the whole land. Below are Jurassic World, Transformers and the Revenge of the Mummy coaster. Everything is packed tight into a hillside site, so you move between eras and franchises in a few minutes' walk. Just outside the gate, Universal CityWalk carries the evening on with restaurants, cinemas and live music.

globaltix_product_data.description: This is a real working film studio with a theme park built on top of it, and the Studio Tour remains the thing that sets it apart. A tram carries you through active backlots — crashed airliners, flooded streets, the facades of a hundred films you half-recognise — before plunging into King Kong and Fast & Furious sequences on giant screens. Beyond the tour, the park divides across two levels. Above sit The Wizarding World of Harry Potter, with Hogwarts castle rising over Hogsmeade, and Super Nintendo World, where a wearable band lets you punch blocks and collect coins across the whole land. Below are Jurassic World, Transformers and the Revenge of the Mummy coaster. Everything is packed tight into a hillside site, so you move between eras and franchises in a few minutes' walk. Just outside the gate, Universal CityWalk carries the evening on with restaurants, cinemas and live music.

globaltix_product_data.description: Immerse yourself in the wonders of Universal Studios Japan™ and explore Kansai with unparalleled convenience! This package includes a 1-day admission ticket to Universal Studios Japan featuring access to the spectacular SUPER NINTENDO WORLD™ and a Have Fun in Kansai Pass (1-week free access to 3 top attractions). Perfect for travelers looking to experience iconic Japanese entertainment and regional gems with ease.
highlights: Experience the ultimate balance of theme park thrills and Kansai exploration at a fantastic price.
Step into a vibrant, interactive world inspired by classic Nintendo games like Mario Kart™ and more.
Enjoy free entry to 3 facilities of your choice in the Kansai region for 1 week.
Explore the best of Kansai, from historical sites to cultural hotspots, while enjoying entertainment-packed Universal Studios Japan.
Dive into thrilling rides, live shows, and themed attractions, including the highly acclaimed SUPER NINTENDO WORLD™
inclusions: Have Fun in Kansai Pass 1 Week Free Pass (3 facilities)

Have Fun in Kansai Pass 1 Week Free Pass (3 facilities) No age limit, suitable for adults and children Have fun in Kansai Pass valid for 90 days after purchase Ticket can be used on the validity which indicated on the ticket. You cannot use the QR Code by itself to enter the area Universal Studios Japan, so be sure to get your "Area Timed Entry Ticket: Advance Booking" ticket before going to the area. Once you exit SUPER NINTENDO WORLD™, you will not be able to enter again. Depending on crowd conditions, it may be possible to enter without an "Area Timed Entry Ticket: Advance Booking" ticket.

globaltix_product_data.description: Experience the magic of Universal Studios Japan without the hassle of long queues by booking your Admission Ticket & Express Pass today! With our convenient e-voucher, you can easily enter the park and enjoy a seamless adventure. Immerse yourself in the enchanting world of Harry Potter and the Forbidden Journey™, where you'll soar through the iconic Hogwarts Castle. Join Gru and his mischievous Minions in Despicable Me Minion Mayhem for a hilarious and interactive experience. These are just a taste of the incredible attractions awaiting you at Universal Studios Japan. Don't miss out on the fun – reserve your tickets now and make unforgettable memories at this world-class theme park.
highlights: Use the Express Pass to experience select attractions fast and easy
Experience iconic attractions like Harry Potter and Despicable Me.
Enjoy seamless entry to Universal Studios Japan with our e-voucher.
inclusions: 1 pcs of Universal Express Pass 4: Minecart & Fun
This Express Pass includes the Area Timed Entry Ticket : Super Nintendo World™,THE WIZARDING WORLD OF HARRY POTTER™
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: The express admission ticket cannot specify a time, and the guest's admission time is subject to the final ticket issuance. One volume is limited to one person. Please note that in the case of individual purchases, cancellations will not be possible. A separate admission ticket is required to enter the park. Attraction facilities have temporary suspension hours. Express admission tickets for suspended attractions can be exchanged for one express admission ticket for other corresponding attractions during the suspension period of the attraction. The operation hours of corresponding attractions are subject to change without prior notice. When the special operation of the corresponding amusement facility is carried out, it will be regarded as a different amusement facility, and this ticket may not be used. If tourists may suffer from aggravated physical diseases due to riding this amusement facility, or cannot maintain the correct riding posture, or cannot sit safely on the seat due to their physique, or cannot use the safety bar to fix the body on the seat, or wear You cannot use this facility if you have plaster or other conditions. Persons with the following conditions should not use this facility: Heart disease, abnormal blood pressure / back, neck, waist, spinal disorders / pregnancy / dizziness / poor physical condition / fear of heights / claustrophobia. Those who use wheelchairs or electric wheelchairs must move to the seats in the facility. Please take off your glasses before boarding. Those who use prosthetic limbs or wear wigs, please inform the staff in advance. A part of the facility will pass through a dark place. If you are afraid of dark places, please inform the staff in advance. Your belongings are not allowed on board this facility. Please put cameras, video recorders, and any other items on the shelves, or hand them over to relatives and friends who have not taken the rides for safekeeping.
globaltix_product_data.address: 2-chōme-1-番33号 Sakurajima, Konohana Ward, Osaka, 554-0031, Japan

We are sorry for the inconvenience this may cause. ※JAWS 3/07~3/29 Out of operation Please refer to the official website for the designated attraction time This Express Pass includes the Area Timed Entry Ticket : Super Nintendo World™,THE WIZARDING WORLD OF HARRY POTTER™ ☆ Choose one attraction for each ①Mario Kart: Koopa's Challenge Guest experience: Approx. 5 minutes Area: SUPER NINTENDO WORLD™ ②Harry Potter and the Forbidden Journey™ Guest experience: Approx. 5 minutes Area: The Wizarding World of Harry Potter™ ※ Harry Potter and the Forbidden Journey™　- Precautions Height Requirement: You must be at least 122 cm tall. ③Despicable Me Minion Mayhem Guest experience: Approx. 25 minutes Area : Minion Park ※Despicable Me Minion Mayhem - Precautions Guests must be at least 122 cm tall (if unaccompanied) to experience this attraction, or at least 102 cm tall if accompanied by an escort. ④JAWS™ / Jurassic Park - The Ride ☆
options.termsAndConditions: Notices: One booklet per person is required. Please note that cancellations will not be accepted for individual purchases. A separate admission ticket is required to enter the park. Attractions may be closed on certain days for maintenance. Each Express Pass for closed attractions allows you to experience one of the designated attractions. Operation of attractions is subject to change without prior notice or liability. Not applicable if the attraction is separately ticketed for special operations or hours. Other - Precautions Guests will not be admitted if they suffer from conditions that could be aggravated by taking part in this attraction, cannot maintain the proper seating position, cannot use the seat due to their build, cannot firmly attach the restraints, or are wearing a cast. Guests matching any of the following will not be admitted: Guests with heart disease or blood pressure abnormality, guests with back, neck, hip, or spinal disorders, expectant mothers, guests with motion sickness or vertigo, guests with poor physical health, guests suffering from a fear of heights, guests suffering from claustrophobia Wheelchair or electric wheelchair users will be required to switch to the seats used within the attraction. Remove glasses before boarding the ride. Please speak to a crew member if you are wearing a prosthetic limb or a wig. The ride will pass through darkness at certain points. Please speak to a crew member if this is a concern. Baggage/carried items may not be brought onto the ride. Please store cameras, video cameras, or any other carried possessions on the shelves, or ask a member of your group not using the attraction to hold on to them for you. Other - Precautions Guests who should not use the attraction Guests with conditions that may be aggravated by experiencing this attraction or with the following conditions are not admitted. heart/blood pressure disorders, neck, back & spine disorders, expectant mothers, motion sickness, dizziness, Guests suffering from a fear of heights, claustrophobia, poor physical condition ▪ Guests who have symptoms that may be exacerbated on the ride, ▪ Those unable to board properly, unable to sit in the seat due to physique, or unable to secure themselves in the seat with the safety bar, are prohibited from this attraction. This attraction uses the following special effects. Guests with health conditions that may be aggravated by these special effects may not use the attraction. loud sounds, pitch black, Strong smells, Strobes, Fog Safe boarding For your safety, please follow the instructions given by the crew. Additionally, guests who engage in violent or otherwise troublesome behavior will be asked to leave the park by the crew. Please sit firmly on the seat and keep your back against the backrest at all times. Guests who use wheelchairs or electric wheelchairs will be required to switch to the seats used on the ride. Please speak with a crew member beforehand if you have a prosthetic arm or leg. Please speak with a crew member beforehand if you have a plaster cast. Please consult a crew member if you have medical equipment such as an assisting tool or prosthesis that is not firmly attached. Smoking within the premises is prohibited. Photography or video recording within the premises is prohibited. Eating or drinking within the premises is prohibited. Guests who require an escort (one who is mentally/physically healthy, of junior high school age or older, and meets our usage requirements) Guests who may have difficulty during an emergency Guests with mental disabilities Guests with visual disabilities Guests who require wheelchairs For guests with other disabilities, please ask a crew member.
howToUse: Show Mobile Ticket: at the entrance of ride in Universal Studios Japan.

globaltix_product_data.description: Energize your spirit with non-stop thrills and excitement! Experience the world's first* Mario-themed area and Mario Kart: Koopa's Challenge™ attraction, both of which received Thea Awards, considered an enormous honor around the globe in the themed entertainment industry. And don't miss The Wizarding World of Harry Potter™, Minions, and other magnificent worlds enjoyed by kids and adults alike! Exhilarate your senses with a day of play in a park full of endless excitement and thrills! Unleash your passion to play at the invincible 5th anniversary of SUPER NINTENDO WORLD™—where you can team up and power up together! Your anticipation builds as you step through the Warp Pipe with anniversary-exclusive Super Star decorations. Awaiting you are a special Meet-Up just for the 5th anniversary, an adventure in the Mushroom Kingdom with Mario and his friends, collaboration merchandise that lights up, anniversary-exclusive food, and lots of other exciting fun! You'll find Bowser’s Castle, Mount Beanpole, the Golden Temple, and more in this vast world of Mario and Donkey Kong, so plunge right in and team up for wild and exciting play experiences! Go all out for fun at the 5th anniversary of SUPER NINTENDO WORLD™!
highlights: Get your first taste of butterbeer at Hog’s Head in the Wizarding World of Harry Potter.
Immerse yourself with thrills the whole family can enjoy at the world's first* SUPER NINTENDO WORLD™.
Enjoy the adventures of magic at the The Wizarding World of Harry Potter™ ride crowned the world's best attraction in the past years.
Hop on high-tech, exciting rides inspired by Despicable Me, Jurassic Park, and Spider-Man.
