options.name: Universal Studios Japan 2 Day Pas [Available From September] - Tier 3
options.description: About Universal Studios Japan Universal Studios Japan is wholly owned by Comcast NBCUniversal. Universal Studios Japan located in Osaka, Japan, has succeeded in establishing its position as a prominent entertainment and leisure landmark drawing many guests from distant areas in Japan as well as overseas. "Bringing You the Best of the World" - a theme park where its guests can have the world’s best experiences and create the world’s best memories, Universal Studios Japan offers world-class entertainment such as authentic attractions and shows, based not only on Hollywood blockbusters but also popular entertainment brands, and a variety of seasonal events entertaining its guests to the fullest. Universal Studios Japan has continued to evolve since its opening and has recently accelerated its growth with the launch of world-class entertainment experiences such as the The Wizarding World of Harry Potter, The Flying Dinosaur, Minion Park, and SUPER NINTENDO WORLD, a new area where guests can unleash their passion to play in an immersive environment based on world-renowned Nintendo characters and their worlds. Bookinginform 1.Confirmation message will be sent to the appointed email address after the booking is made. 2.Please download and save QRCODE for enter the park within validity period. Opening Hours Daily opening hours are different, please refer to the official website: http://www.usj.co.jp/e/ Park Safety Guidelines At Universal Studios Japan, please cooperate with measures to enhance sanitation. For details, please visit the official website of Universal Studios Japan. https://www.usj.co.jp/web/en/us/service-guide/safety
options.termsAndConditions: Notice This ticket valid after 3:00 pm on and all day the following day. This ticket must be used on two consecutive days. Please present the same ticket for admission on the second day and keep it in a safe place. Lost tickets cannot be reissued. There are two types of tickets: those that can be changed and those that cannot. If you hold a ticket that allows date changes and you are unable to visit on your original admission date, please contact the travel agency or the official website where you purchased. Please note that the ticket type, quantity, age (Adult/Child/Senior), and delivery method cannot be changed. Eligible Tickets: 1 Day / 1.5 Day / 2 Day Studio Pass Limited-time passes can only be changed within their valid admission period. Passes that include Express Passes or other bundled tickets are not eligible. If the new date has a different price, the difference will be charged. Change Period: Date change is available from the purchase date until 90 days after the day following the original admission date. ※If the new admission date is not yet on sale, please wait until sales begin. ※Tickets with limited validity are not eligible for Annual Pass upgrades. ※Once you exit the park, re-entry to the park is not allowed.

[USJ Important Notice] JP Closure for June 5 Due to a system failure in JP (Jurassic Park) today, JP will be temporarily closed on June 5, and the system has also stopped selling Express Pass products, including JP. Therefore, for visitors entering the park on 5 June, other attraction options will be provided by the staff on site.

globaltix_product_data.description: Illumination’s Minions & Monsters Summer Lights, camera, monsters! The Minions are making a movie. Join James and Henry - the newest Minions - as they conjure up chaos in an original live performance. Bite into picture-worthy themed foods and strike your most mischievous pose at the larger-than-life photo ops along Hollywood street. There are countless ways to get your mischief on this summer and it's all yours to enjoy with a standard Universal Studios Singapore One-Day ticket. Also, remember to catch Illumination's Minions & Monsters in cinemas July 1. Experience Southeast Asia’s first and only Universal Studios theme park based on your favourite blockbuster films and television series. Get an adrenaline rush on cutting-edge rides like Battlestar Galactica: HUMAN vs. CYLON™, TRANSFORMERS The Ride: The Ultimate 3D Battle, while the little ones laugh along to Sesame Street Spaghetti Space Chase. And get ready to strike a pose with the stars of DreamWorks Animation’s Kung Fu Panda and your favourite Minions from Illumination’s Despicable Me.
highlights: New York: Walk the sidewalks of the Big Apple and experience the energy of NYC, just as you've seen it in the movies.
Sci-Fi City: Explore this action-packed futuristic metropolis, home to adrenaline rides
Ancient Egypt: Step back into 1920s Egypt and explore ancient obelisks, the riddles of the Sphinx and curse-ridden rides.
The Lost World: Walk with dinosaurs in Jurassic Park and watch death-defying stunts at WaterWorld's sensational water show.
Far Far Away: Step into the fairytale kingdom of Far Far Away with castles, green ogres, a talking donkey and magic potions.

Additional information Non-transferable, not for sale or exchange and non-refundable, including, but not limited to events outside Resorts World Sentosa’s control; governmental acts, acts of God, riots, strikes, natural disasters, haze or inclement weather (regardless of severity). Void if Altered, Tampered or Damaged. Applicable for admission during regular park operating hours, not valid during Special Events. Regular Park operating hours is subject to change without prior notice. Hand stamp and ticket required for same day re-entry into Universal Studios Singapore, S.E.A. Aquarium or Adventure Cove Waterpark only. Please be careful of your safety and belongings at all times, as we shall not be liable for any damage or loss that you may suffer arising from your use of Universal Studios Singapore, S.E.A. Aquarium or Adventure Cove Waterpark, whether such damage or loss is caused by our negligence or otherwise. These premises are under surveillance. For the safety of all of our guests, team members and marine animals, Resorts World Sentosa will be conducting bag checks on all personal and/or hand carry baggage. globaltix_product_data.description: Illumination’s Minions & Monsters Summer Lights, camera, monsters! The Minions are making a movie. Join James and Henry - the newest Minions - as they conjure up chaos in an original live performance. Bite into picture-worthy themed foods and strike your most mischievous pose at the larger-than-life photo ops along Hollywood street. There are countless ways to get your mischief on this summer and it's all yours to enjoy with a standard Universal Studios Singapore One-Day ticket. Also, remember to catch Illumination's Minions & Monsters in cinemas July 1. Experience Southeast Asia’s first and only Universal Studios theme park based on your favourite blockbuster films and television series. Get an adrenaline rush on cutting-edge rides like Battlestar Galactica: HUMAN vs. CYLON™, TRANSFORMERS The Ride: The Ultimate 3D Battle, while the little ones laugh along to Sesame Street Spaghetti Space Chase. And get ready to strike a pose with the stars of DreamWorks Animation’s Kung Fu Panda and your favourite Minions from Illumination’s Despicable Me.

This unique attraction allows visitors to scale the roof of one of the city’s most famous landmarks, offering a thrilling adventure combined with spectacular panoramic views across Lon...
globaltix_product_data.description: Up at The O2 is an exhilarating outdoor climbing experience located at the iconic The O2 in London, United Kingdom. This unique attraction allows visitors to scale the roof of one of the city’s most famous landmarks, offering a thrilling adventure combined with spectacular panoramic views across London’s skyline. Equipped with a safety harness and guided by experienced climb leaders, guests will ascend a purpose-built walkway stretching over the dome. As you reach the summit, you’ll enjoy uninterrupted 360-degree views of landmarks such as the River Thames and Canary Wharf, making it both an exciting and visually rewarding experience. The experience lasts approximately 90 minutes and operates on fixed timeslots throughout the day, including daytime, sunset, and twilight climbs. Guests arrive at the base camp for a safety briefing and gear fitting before beginning their guided climb, following a structured route from start to finish.
highlights: Unique outdoor adventure combining a guided climb with panoramic city views from the summit.
Climb over the roof of The O2 and enjoy breathtaking 360-degree views of London’s skyline.
Perfect for families with older children, groups, and anyone seeking an active city attraction.
Ideal for thrill-seekers, couples, and travelers looking for a memorable London experience.
Includes climbing suit, safety harness, shoes, and guided climb with professional instructors.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Embark on an exclusive, semi private tour of the Vatican Museums, Sistine Chapel, Raphael Rooms, and historic Papal Apartments in Rome, enjoying priority access to all sites with a maximum of just 10 guests. Delight in the breathtaking masterpieces from the vast collection curated by the Catholic Ch...
globaltix_product_data.description: Embark on an exclusive, semi private tour of the Vatican Museums, Sistine Chapel, Raphael Rooms, and historic Papal Apartments in Rome, enjoying priority access to all sites with a maximum of just 10 guests. Delight in the breathtaking masterpieces from the vast collection curated by the Catholic Church over centuries. Your journey begins as you step into the Vatican Museums, a treasure trove of some of the Western world’s most celebrated art. Wander through the awe-inspiring Gallery of the Maps, Gallery of the Tapestries, and Gallery of the Candelabra, and stand in the presence of iconic sculptures like the Belvedere Torso and Laocoön. Admire the architectural elegance of the Greek Cross Room, the artistic brilliance of the Raphael Rooms, the historic grandeur of the Old Papal Apartments, and so much more. The highlight of your tour awaits in the Sistine Chapel, where Michelangelo’s genius shines through his monumental works. Gaze in wonder at the dramatic Last Judgment adorning the altar wall and the iconic Creation of Adam gracing the magnificent ceiling fresco, leaving an indelible mark on your memory. After visiting the Sistine Chapel, we will take a tour guide passage out of the Chapel (when passage is open) to finish the tour directly in front of St. Peter's Basilica, where you will have an explanation of the Basilica from the outside. All guests are then free to enter the church afterwards if you chose, wait times may vary to enter the Basilica. Discover the enduring wonders of the Eternal City, tracing her origins from the grandeur of classical antiquity, through the delicate artistry of the Renaissance, to the lavish baroque opulence of the Counter-Reformation.

globaltix_product_data.description: Versailles conjures up notions of a grand palace and vast landscaped gardens. But did you know there's also a third part? With this all-area-access ticket, you'll be able to explore the Hameau de la Reine, Marie Antoinette's private compound where she played pretend as a humble peasant. The main palace and gardens are extravagant beyond belief. It boasts more than 700 rooms, 18th-century French art, an opera house, and a 75-meter-long hall of mirrors lined with statues and busts. The gardens feature all manner of luxuries and follies that a European monarch just couldn't do without: meticulously manicured lawns and ornate baroque fountains.But that's not all, Marie Antoinette also had her own compound away from the main palace. These are located near the Grand Trianon and Petit Trianon, which already existed on the edge of the grounds. Her idyllic village came to be known as The Queen's Hamlet, and was a fully-functioning village!
highlights: Walk through Marie Antoinette's private compound, the rustic Queens Hamlet modeled after a real French village
Amble through the landscaped gardens, the stunning Hall of Mirrors, the Royal Opera, and the Petit and Grand Trianon
Admire French Art and furniture in the baroque and Rococo style. Check out the many chests by André Charles Boulle!

globaltix_product_data.summary: The Kunsthistorisches Museum (Museum of Art History) is a sumptuous feast of art by Europe's finest artists and artisans. globaltix_product_data.description: The Kunsthistorisches Museum (Museum of Art History) is a sumptuous feast of art by Europe's finest artists and artisans. The collection, amassed by the now extinct House of Habsburg, features many essential Renaissance masterpieces, all contained under an elegant dome.In 1891, Hapsburg Emperor Franz Joseph I opened the on Vienna’s Ringstrasse. The new neoclassical building finally allowed the enormous (and enormously enviable) Habsburg art collection to be housed under one roof. Filled to the brim with masterpieces by some of Europe’s finest artists, it's an experience not to be missed while in Vienna. The building itself is a feast for the eyes - with marbles floors, frescoes, gold leaf and elegant staircases deserve to display awe-inspiring works. And they do.Collected over six hundred years, the artworks here span five millennia. In fact, this museum is every bit the equal of Europe's other 'top line museums' - the Vatican Museums, El Prado, the Louvre. Spanning Ancient Egypt, Classical Rome, and right up to the Renaissance, this collection is a testament to the exquisite taste and formidable power of the House of Habsburg. And with an afternoon here, you'll reap the reward of their diligent art collecting.If you're short on time, head straight for the Picture Gallery, with highlights such as Pieter Bruegel the Elder's , Giuseppe Arcimboldo's , and Raphael's . The mirror image building, across the Maria-Theresien-Platz is the Naturhistorisches Museum (Natural History Museum). It was opened at the same time as its twin - because the accumulated wealth of the Habsburgs required the space. If you can spare it, each museum deserves at least half a day of your time.
highlights: Skip the lines and get two-for-one instant access to two of Vienna's cultural highlights
Admire the Habsburg emperor's world-class art collections, spanning a staggering five millenia of history
See masterpieces by Caravaggio, Raphael, Vermeer, Titian, Rembrandt and more

globaltix_product_data.description: With your Vienna Pass, you'll get to skip the line to 22 popular attractions, including Schönbrunn Zoo (the world's oldest zoo) and the Albertina Museum. You'll also get unlimited hop-on, hop-off bus travel and loads of discounts. This is the best way to do Vienna! There's free admission to 90 top attractions, including the Imperial Palace, Schönbrunn Zoo, the Natural History Museum, and many more. If you're short on time to get your historical fixes, your Vienna PASS lets you bypass those annoying queues for must-sees, like the Imperial Treasury, mumok (Museum of Modern Art), and Albertina – home to over 65,000 drawings and roughly 1 million old master prints. In fact you can skip the line to 22 attractions! Get in just as quick to the Kunsthistorisches Museum Vienna (Museum of Art History), the Museum of Technology and the Museum of Natural History. You can also take a spin on the Giant Ferris Wheel and visit over 700 species of animals at Schönbrunn Zoo. Getting around is easy too, thanks to the inclusive unlimited travel on the hop-on hop-off sightseeing buses. The Vienna PASS is your literal ticket to the best of The Imperial City. You'll even get a free guidebook to help you explore the city and plan your visit! If you plan on exploring a lot of the city, you can opt for a travelcard for Vienna's public transport network – valid across the tram, tube, and bus networks. The city was once home to Mozart, Beethoven and Sigmund Freud, so it's no surprise that the Austrian capital oozes culture, history and sophistication, no matter when you visit. It provides an excellent chance for children to explore their desired professions at VinKE while also offering a captivating journey into the enigmatic unde...
globaltix_product_data.description: VinKE and Vinpearl Aquarium, located in Vincom Mega Mall Times City, are highly popular among families, particularly those with young children. It provides an excellent chance for children to explore their desired professions at VinKE while also offering a captivating journey into the enigmatic underwater realm at the expansive aquarium. Bring your kids along to engage in interactive activities that simulate their dream jobs and provide thrilling career guidance games. Additionally, you can embark on a tour of the vast aquarium, which houses a wide array of unique sea creatures. Delight in the opportunity to hand-feed fishes and experience sleeping under the sea, all while enjoying the mesmerizing spectacle of 'The Mermaid' show.
highlights: a captivating and educational experience by allowing them to try out their dream jobs.
The enormous aquarium within Vincom Mega Mall Times City is a mesmerizing attraction that showcases a diverse range of marine life.
Visitors can interact with some of the friendly aquatic inhabitants and have a memorable encounter as they offer food directly to the fish.
Unique opportunity to spend a night under the sea.

Travelers can spend the day exploring five themed zones — from heart-pounding rides and a massive water park to hands-on cultural villages and...
globaltix_product_data.description: VinWonders Nam Hoi An is a world-class theme park just 15 km from Hoi An, designed to combine thrills, culture, and nature in one unforgettable destination. Travelers can spend the day exploring five themed zones — from heart-pounding rides and a massive water park to hands-on cultural villages and family-friendly entertainment. One of the park’s signature experiences is Vietnam’s first and only River Safari, where guests board a boat and cruise through natural habitats to see over 550 animals of 50 species, including giraffes, zebras, tigers, and rare birds. It’s an immersive, eco-friendly way to observe wildlife up close while learning about conservation efforts. Whether you’re looking for adrenaline, cultural discovery, or magical photo spots, VinWonders Nam Hoi An offers a full-day adventure that brings together the best of Vietnam in one place.
highlights: Immerse in Culture – Stroll through traditional villages and watch live folk shows.
Cruise the River Safari – Meet giraffes, zebras, and tigers up close on Vietnam’s first boat safari.
Capture the Magic – Wander lantern-lit streets and enjoy spectacular night shows.
Explore Thrilling Rides – Feel the rush on roller coasters and drop towers.
Discover Splash Adventures – Cool off with giant slides, wave pools, and a lazy river.

globaltix_product_data.name: VinWonders Nha Trang
globaltix_product_data.summary: Set on the stunning Hon Tre Island and surrounded by the crystal-clear waters of Nha Trang Bay, VinWonders Nha Trang is one of Vietnam’s most iconic island entertainment destinations, combining world-class attractions, tropical scenery, and vibrant cultural experiences in one unforgettable getaway....
globaltix_product_data.description: Set on the stunning Hon Tre Island and surrounded by the crystal-clear waters of Nha Trang Bay, VinWonders Nha Trang is one of Vietnam’s most iconic island entertainment destinations, combining world-class attractions, tropical scenery, and vibrant cultural experiences in one unforgettable getaway. Accessible by a spectacular overseas cable car ride with panoramic ocean views, the park offers an exciting escape for international travelers looking for adventure, relaxation, and family-friendly fun in Vietnam’s coastal paradise. Spanning across multiple themed zones, VinWonders Nha Trang features thrilling roller coasters, giant splash slides, immersive indoor games, and one of the largest water parks in Vietnam. Visitors can explore the fascinating marine world at the aquarium, stroll through beautifully landscaped gardens, experience interactive attractions, or enjoy live street performances and seasonal festivals throughout the park. As the sun sets, guests can witness the famous Tata Show — a breathtaking multimedia performance combining music, lights, pyrotechnics, and storytelling that rivals international theme park productions. Beyond the rides and entertainment, VinWonders Nha Trang delivers a complete island holiday experience. Travelers can relax on private beaches, enjoy diverse dining options featuring both Vietnamese and international cuisine, shop for souvenirs, and capture stunning photos against the backdrop of turquoise seas and tropical mountains. Whether you are visiting with family, friends, or as a couple, the park offers activities suitable for all ages and travel styles. Perfect for both day trips and full holiday itineraries, VinWonders Nha Trang is more than just a theme park — it is a vibrant seaside destination where adventure, entertainment, and the natural beauty of Vietnam come together to create unforgettable memories for international visitors.
highlights: Enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of Nha Trang Bay while traveling to Hon Tre Island on one of the world’s most scenic oversea cable car systems.
Experience exciting roller coasters, zipline activities, alpine coasters, and adrenaline-pumping attractions suitable for adventure seekers of all ages.
Cool off at one of Vietnam’s largest seaside water parks featuring giant slides, wave pools, lazy rivers, and dedicated family play areas.
Watch spectacular live performances, street entertainment, and the famous Tata Show combining multimedia effects, music, lights, and fireworks.

globaltix_product_data.summary: Adventure World is a unique all-in-one theme park located in Shirahama, Wakayama Prefecture, combining a zoo, aquarium, and amusement park within a single destination on Japan's Kii Peninsula. Home to more than 1,400 animals across 140+ species, the park is best known as one of the few places in Jap...
globaltix_product_data.description: Adventure World is a unique all-in-one theme park located in Shirahama, Wakayama Prefecture, combining a zoo, aquarium, and amusement park within a single destination on Japan's Kii Peninsula. Home to more than 1,400 animals across 140+ species, the park is best known as one of the few places in Japan — and the facility with the most giant pandas in the country — where visitors can see giant pandas up close, having welcomed the birth of 17 panda cubs to date. The park is divided into themed zones: Safari World, where guests ride the Kenya Car (a train-like safari vehicle) through drive-through habitats with lions, elephants, and rhinos; Marine World, featuring daily dolphin, whale, and sea lion performances in an ocean-facing stadium; and Play Zone, offering family-friendly amusement rides including a Ferris wheel. Interactive experiences let visitors feed and interact with animals such as capybaras, penguins, and giraffes, while an optional Adventure Tour allows guests to ride a private jeep through the safari area for a closer wildlife encounter. Built around the theme of connection between people, animals, and nature, Adventure World offers a full-day experience suited to families, couples, and solo travelers alike, typically taking four to six hours to fully explore.

The 4 theme parks on Yas Island (Ferrari World, Warner Bros. World, Yas Waterworld, and SeaWorld) will use a fingerprint collection system to ensure visitor consistency. For multi-park admission tickets, fingerprints will be collected when entering the first park and uploaded to the systems of the other parks as verification for subsequent entries. 4. If you do not wish to provide fingerprint information, you must register for park entry using a valid ID. Your ID information will be linked to the admission ticket, and the registration details will be synchronized with other parks. Entry will be denied if the same ticket is used with inconsistent ID information. Other things to note: 1. Guests entering the park should not wear short shorts or backless clothing, and are not allowed to bring outside food and beverages or any glass items. This includes meals, large snacks, sodas, juices, alcoholic drinks, and similar beverages. 2. Special Reminder: Some attractions at Ferrari World Yas Island may be too intense. globaltix_product_data.description: Escape into a day of non-stop fun at The Amazing Bay Water Park, one of Vietnam's largest water parks, where thrilling water slides, giant wave pools, relaxing lazy rivers, and family-friendly attractions await visitors of all ages. Whether you're looking for adrenaline-pumping rides or a refreshing place to unwind, the park offers the perfect water adventure in a safe and exciting environment. Located next to The Amazing World Theme Park, guests can also enjoy an immersive indoor entertainment experience featuring virtual reality attractions, ATV adventures, a sky bridge, and Vietnam's largest indoor Phoenix Palace. It's the perfect destination for families, friends, and thrill-seekers looking for a full day of unforgettable fun.
highlights: Family-friendly splash zones and interactive water play areas for children.
Conveniently located beside The Amazing World Theme Park for even more entertainment.
Experience giant wave pools, thrilling water slides, and a relaxing lazy river.
Built with international-standard safety facilities for a worry-free visit.
Enjoy one of Vietnam's largest water parks with exciting attractions for all ages.

globaltix_product_data.description: Waterbom Bali is the island’s premier waterpark, which has over a dozen exciting waterslides and water games for all ages. The park covers 38,000 sq m of tropical gardens and pools, as well as onsite dining and leisure facilities. Rides at the waterpark include leisurely pools with mini slides and adrenaline-pumping rides that start from significant heights. Rides for thrill-seekers include 'Fast n' Fierce' and ‘Twin Racers’ where you can challenge your partner for a splashing race down. Some of the rides require specially designed tubes with grips to hold onto.
highlights: Waterbom Bali stands out as the island's top waterpark destination
Spanning across 38,000 square meters of tropical gardens and pools
From leisurely pools with mini slides to heart-pounding rides starting from significant heights
Thrill-seekers can indulge in exhilarating rides such as 'Fast n' Fierce' and ‘Twin Racers
For added safety and enjoyment, some rides require specially designed tubes with grips
inclusions: Non Refundable In Park credit IDR 500,000
globaltix_product_data.termsAndConditions: Admission Ticket is valid on the visit date. Re-entry to the venue is permitted. Show your ticket, wristband, or stamp upon re-entry at the entrance. Admission is at your own risk. Waterbom Bali is not responsible for any injuries or lost or stolen items, even if assistance is provided. Eligibility Children must be aged between 2 – 11 years old. Attraction Access Includes access to the entire park and all slides during operating hours. Additional Information All reschedule requests are subject to Waterbom Bali’s approval. F&B, towel hire, lockers, Euro Bungy, FlowRider, photos, and gazebo rental are charged separately. Locker and towel rentals are available on-site. Muslim-friendly dining is available at Wantilan Food Court (Pork-Free Zone) offering Indonesian, Asian, Western, Italian, Mediterranean, and Middle Eastern cuisine. No outside food or drinks allowed. No pets are permitted. Important Notes What to bring: Comfortable swimwear and extra clothes. Secure your valuables. Waterbom Bali is not liable for lost or stolen items. Waterslides are not recommended for guests with chronic health issues, recent surgery, pregnancy, or severe back or heart conditions. Prohibited items on waterslides include jewelry, metal-decorated clothing, cut-off jeans, and glasses. How to Get There By Car: We recommend taking a taxi directly to Waterbom for the most convenient journey.

globaltix_product_data.description: Located in the most emblematic street of Barcelona, La Rambla, we find the new Wax Museum of Barcelona. A completely renovated Project, both conceptually and in terms of figures, where emblematic characters and the latest technology are combined to make you live an unforgettable experience. The visit offers a tour of 28 scenarios from history and the present day, in which, thanks to the latest technology, the visitor becomes the protagonist. A museum that is in constant movement and updating, offering a collection of more than 160 figures. A tour where you can take part in the most famous heist on television, sing with Rosalía or play with Pau Gasol or Leo Messi. You will also have the opportunity to take a lift from which you will be able to see the city of Barcelona. Don’t forget our last stop, “El Bosc de les Fades”, the emblematic bar, set in an enchanted forest, an authentic oasis in the middle of Barcelona.
